words.mnem: post- (=after) + pon (=put) + e → 置於其後 → 延期，推遲
ex: Well, since not everyone has gotten back to you, why don't you just postpone the trip, you know, until your mom's van is repaired?
哎呀，既然還沒收到所有人的回覆，那你不如推遲旅行，等你媽媽的麵包車修好再說呢？
words.en: to arrange for something to happen at a later time

words.zh: 廢除，廢止
ex: In 1857, in return for a payment of 63 million kronor from other commercial nations, Denmark abolished the Sound toll dues, the fees it had collected since 1497 for the use of the Sound.
1857 年，其他通商國家向丹麥支付了 6300 萬克朗，以此為交換，丹麥廢除了自 1497 年以來對松德海峽通行征收的通行費。
deriv: abolitionist n. 主張廢除……的人
words.en: to officially end a law or system

words.zh: 1. 船運 2. 船舶
ex: This decline can be seen clearly in the changes that affected Venetian shipping and trade.
這一衰落趨勢在影響威尼斯航運與貿易的變遷中清晰可見。
colloc: shipping company 航運公司；船舶公司
words.en: the transport of goods; ships in general

words.zh: 丟棄，拋棄
words.mnem: dis- (=apart) + card (=paper) → 丟棄
ex: This was a society with similarities to a modern one—moving goods on a gigantic scale, manufacturing high-quality containers to do so, and occasionally, as here, even discarding them on delivery.
這是一個與現代社會有相似之處的社會——大規模運輸貨物，為此製造高品質的集裝箱，偶爾也會像這樣，甚至在貨物送達時丟棄這些箱子。
words.en: to throw something away because it is no longer useful

words.zh: v. 1. 毀滅，炸毀 2. 嚴厲批評 3. 發出刺耳的高音，轟鳴（尤指音樂）；n. 1. 爆炸 2. 一陣（疾風等），一股（強烈的氣流）3. 嚴厲的批評
ex: Convinced that railroads burdened them with high taxes and blasted hopes, voters turned against state aid.
選民們堅信鐵路使他們背負了沉重的稅收，毀滅了他們的希望，（因此）轉而反對政府補助。
colloc: (at) full blast 最大音量地；最大馬力地
words.en: a sudden strong explosion or rush of air

words.zh: 1. 聯合會，聯盟 2. 聯邦政府，聯邦共和國
ex: Having an efficient means of transportation, well, that helps the Iroquois to form a federation linked by natural waterways.
有了高效的交通運輸工具，有助於易洛魁人組建一個由天然水道連接的聯盟。
deriv: federal a. 聯邦制的，聯邦政府的
words.en: a group of states or organizations united under a central authority

words.zh: 1. 船桅，桅桿 2. 旗桿
ex: Increased stability made it possible to add multiple masts and sails.
穩定性的提高使得船上可以增加多個桅桿和船帆。
words.en: a tall pole that supports a ship's sails

words.zh: n. 潛艇；a. 海底的，水下的
words.mnem: sub- (=under) + mar (=sea) + -ine → 海底的 → 潛艇
ex: Starting in the 1960s and continuing until the 1980s, sailors in submarines patrolling the North Atlantic and Arctic Ocean would occasionally hear strange sounds.
從 20 世紀 60 年代起一直持續到 80 年代，在北大西洋和北冰洋巡邏的潛艇水兵偶爾會聽到奇怪的聲音。
colloc: submarine pipeline 海底管道，水下管道
words.en: a ship that can operate under water

words.zh: n. 1. 錨 2. 精神支柱，頂樑柱；v. 1. 拋錨，停泊 2. 使固定，繫牢
ex: In fact, it is believed that fishing nets and boat anchors as well as the ripping action of storms have helped the alga spread to new areas.
事實上，人們認為漁網、船錨及風暴的撕扯作用，都促使這種藻類向新區域擴散。
words.en: a heavy object lowered to keep a ship in place

words.zh: n. 1. 通行費 2. 傷亡人數 3. 鐘聲；v. 敲（鐘），鳴（鐘）
ex: Tolls and tax revenues don't often cover all the needed repairs.
通行費和稅收收入往往不足以支付所有必要的維修費用。
colloc: road toll 道路費，養路費
take a toll 產生負面影響；造成損失
deriv: tollbooth n. 收費亭，收費站
words.en: a fee paid to use a road or bridge; the number of deaths

words.zh: n. 艦隊；a. 快速的
ex: The Venetian fleet patrolled the Adriatic Sea, stopped ships, inspected cargo...
威尼斯艦隊在亞得里亞海巡邏，攔截船隻，檢查貨物……
words.en: a group of ships or vehicles

words.zh: v. 1. 短暫拜訪 2.（使）搖擺；n. 1. 改變 2. 擺動，轉動 3. 鞦韆
ex: I'll swing by this weekend after my basketball game.
我這週末打完籃球比賽後會短暫拜訪一下。
colloc: in full swing 處於興盛階段，在熱烈進行中
words.en: to move back and forth; to visit briefly

words.zh: （使）加快，（使）增速
words.mnem: ac- (=to) + celer (=swift) + -ate → （使）加快，（使）增速
ex: Advancements in transportation and communication accelerated progress, laying the foundation for modern society.
交通與通訊領域的進步加速了社會發展進程，為現代社會奠定了基礎。
words.en: to happen or make something happen faster

words.zh: 1. 檢查，查看 2. 視察
words.mnem: in- (=into) + spect (=see) + -ion → 窺視內部 → 檢查，查看
ex: Please be sure to make a full inspection before driving away from the building.
請務必在駛離大樓前進行全面檢查。
deriv: inspect v. 檢查，查看；視察
words.en: careful examination of something

words.zh: v. 1. 調整節奏 2. 踱步；n. 1. 速度 2. 步伐，（一）步
ex: Just make sure you pace yourself.
你只需確保調整好自己的節奏。
colloc: keep pace with sth./sb. 與某物／某人並駕齊驅
words.en: the speed at which something moves or happens

words.zh: 擔心的，憂慮的
words.mnem: ap- (=to) + prehens (=seize) + -ive → 捕捉 →（引申義）擔心的，憂慮的
ex: For instance, flying is statistically safer than driving, yet many are more apprehensive about flying.
例如，從統計數據來看，坐飛機比開車更安全，然而許多人對坐飛機仍更加擔憂。
deriv: apprehend v. 理解，領會；逮捕
words.en: worried that something bad might happen

words.zh: 林蔭大道
ex: Technology's annual inventory audit will be performed on Thursday, April 19, beginning promptly at 8:00 a.m. in the warehouse on Kramer Boulevard.
科技部年度庫存盤點將於 4 月 19 日週四上午 8 點整，在克雷默大道的倉庫準時開始。
words.en: a wide street in a city, often with trees

words.zh: 1. 柴油 2. 柴油車（或船等），內燃機車
ex: One of the main problems with the internal combustion engine is that it relies on petroleum, either in the form of gasoline or diesel fuel.
內燃機的主要問題之一在於它依靠石油運行，無論是以汽油還是柴油的形式。
words.en: a type of heavy oil used as fuel in engines

words.zh: 1. 四輪載重馬車 2.（鐵路）貨車車廂
ex: The chariot was simply a rolling wagon located below the stage on tracks.
戰車只是一輛置於舞台下方軌道上的滾動式馬車。
words.en: a vehicle with four wheels pulled by animals

words.zh: v. 拖，拉；n. 拖運，一次的獲得量
ex: Heavily laden wagons were being hauled by horses along metal rails.
滿載貨物的四輪馬車由幾匹馬拉著在鐵軌上前行。
colloc: haul off 離開；後縮一下
deriv: overhaul v. 徹底檢修；趕上
words.en: to pull something heavy with effort

words.zh: 1. 漁業 2. 漁場
ex: The people of the Netherlands, with a long tradition of fisheries and mercantile shipping, had difficulty in developing good harbors suitable for steamships.
擁有悠久漁業和商船業傳統的荷蘭人，難以建造出適合汽輪使用的優良港口。
words.en: a place or business of catching fish

words.zh: 收費公路
ex: Steam also promised to eliminate a transportation problem not fully solved by either canal boats or turnpikes.
蒸汽動力也有望解決運河船隻和收費公路未能完全解決的運輸難題。
words.en: a toll road

words.zh: n. 船體，船身；v. 去（穀物、豆等的）殼
ex: Since they had relatively shallow hulls, they were unstable when driven by sail or when on rough water.
由於（划槳帆船的）船體相對較淺，它們在揚帆航行或在洶湧的海面上航行時很難保持穩定。
words.en: the main body of a ship

words.zh: 1. 槳帆船，（古希臘和古羅馬的）戰艦 2.（船或飛機上的）廚房
ex: The principal seagoing ship used throughout the Middle Ages was the galley, a long, low ship fitted with sails but driven primarily by oars.
整個中世紀廣泛使用的海船是槳帆船，其低矮狹長的船體，雖配有船帆，但主要靠划槳驅動。
colloc: a galley in a ship 船上的廚房
words.en: an ancient ship driven by oars; a ship's kitchen

words.zh: 二氧化物
ex: Let's focus now on two proposals that governments can consider as they try to reduce carbon dioxide emissions from cars.
現在讓我們重點關注政府在嘗試減少汽車二氧化碳排放時可以考慮的兩項提議。
words.en: a compound with two oxygen atoms

words.zh: 1. 在飛行中的 2. 空氣中的 3. 空降的
ex: One advantage of airships is that for vertical lift (the force that keeps the ship airborne), they use a balloon that floats rather than an engine.
飛艇的一個優勢在於，在實現垂直升力（使飛艇保持懸空的力）時，它們使用可飄浮的氣囊，而非發動機。
words.en: carried by or traveling through the air

words.zh: 互相連接，互相聯繫
words.mnem: inter- (=between) + con- (=together) + nect (=bind) → 互相連接，互相聯繫
ex: Since the northeastern region of North America was interconnected by many streams and waterways, water transportation by vessels like a canoe was most essential.
由於北美東北部地區處在河流和水道交匯地帶，所以通過獨木舟這類船隻的水路運輸方式便非常重要。
words.en: to connect with each other

words.zh: a. 之字形的，曲折的；n. 之字形；v. 曲折前進
ex: He talks about a ship's voyage and this is one of the most famous bits of the essay—how the best voyage is made up of zigzag lines.
他談到了一艘船的航行，而這是他全文中最著名的一段——最好的航程是如何由之字形路線組成的。
words.en: a line with sharp turns from side to side

words.zh: v.（使）停泊，繫泊；n. 荒野，曠野
ex: Most ships in the United States Navy were not moored with steel cables.
美國海軍的大部分船隻都不是用鋼絲繩來停泊的。
deriv: mooring n. 停泊區；繫泊用具
words.en: to fix a ship in place with ropes; an open area of wild land

words.zh: 海員，水手
ex: European seafarers circumvented Middle Eastern merchants.
歐洲海員繞過了中東商人。
words.en: a person who travels by sea

words.zh: a. 陸路的，陸上的；ad. 通過陸路，在陸路上
ex: He probably dominated the overland trade routes that linked Mesopotamia, Anatolia, and the Levant.
他很可能掌控了連接美索不達米亞、安納托利亞和黎凡特的陸上貿易路線。
words.en: across land rather than by sea or air

words.zh: 1. 裝滿的，載滿的 2. 充滿的
ex: In some industrial regions, heavily laden wagons, with flanged wheels, were being hauled by horses along metal rails.
在一些工業地區，載滿重物的、帶有凸緣輪的四輪馬車由幾匹馬拉著在鐵軌上前行。
colloc: laden with grief 滿懷憂傷
words.en: carrying a heavy load

words.zh: 宮殿，豪華住宅
ex: Nearby Unit B was the palace workshop.
附近的 B 單元是宮殿作坊。
words.en: a large grand house where a king or queen lives

words.zh: 1. 建築師 2. 設計師，締造者
ex: Then, well, the architect has to be very practical to think about the people who will actually be living in the house or working in the office building.
那麼，建築師需要從實用的角度出發，考慮到真正在這所房子裡居住或在這座辦公樓裡工作的人們。
deriv: architectural a. 建築方面的，建築學的
words.en: a person who designs buildings

words.zh: 牧場，大農場
ex: I bet it is the ranch-style house.
我打賭這是牧場式的房子。
words.en: a large farm for raising cattle or horses

words.zh: 1. 天花板 2. 最高限度，上限
ex: So, the permanent houses are made of wood, the walls, floors, ceiling, all of wood.
所以，那些永久性房屋是用木頭建造的，牆壁、地板、天花板，全都是木製的。
colloc: hit the ceiling 勃然大怒
words.en: the inside surface at the top of a room
syn: a. 最大的，最高的，最多的

words.zh: 裝飾，裝修
ex: The owners of these grand buildings wanted to decorate the walls to reflect their own affluence and prestige.
這些宏偉建築物的所有者們想要裝飾這些牆壁，以展現自己的富有和威望。
words.en: to make something look more attractive

words.zh: 摩天大樓
ex: There were lots of buildings, tall ones, skyscrapers.
那裡有很多建築，有高樓，還有摩天大樓。
words.en: a very tall building

words.zh: 1. 奇怪的，反常的 2. 偶然出現的，不規律的 3. 奇數的 4. 大約的
ex: This often led to effects that looked odd from a traditional standpoint but that became hallmarks of modern architecture for precisely this reason.
從傳統的角度來看，這常常會導致一些看似奇怪的效果，但也正因如此，這些效果成為了現代建築的標誌。
colloc: the odd man/one out 異類；格格不入
deriv: odds n. 可能的機會，成敗的可能性
words.en: strange; not even
syn: 離奇的，古怪的，不尋常的

words.zh: n. 1. 一行，一排 2. 划船；v. 划（船）
ex: Well, they're like these columns, a row of cylinder shapes like columns supporting the span of the bridge.
嗯，它們就像這些柱子，一排圓柱形的東西，如同支撐橋樑跨度的柱子。
colloc: in a row 連續地；成一行
row over 輕易取勝，一路領先
words.en: a line of things; to move a boat with oars

words.zh: v. 1. 突出，強調 2. 標注記號，使醒目；n. 最好（或精彩）的部分
ex: The legacy of Roman aqueducts continues to influence modern water management systems, highlighting the importance of sustainable engineering practices.
羅馬水道橋這一遺產至今仍在影響現代水資源管理系統，這凸顯了可持續工程實踐的重要性。
colloc: to be a highlight of 為……中最突出的事物
words.en: to emphasize; the best part of something

words.zh: 1. 直接地 2. 立即 3. 正好地
ex: Petra's architecture is unique because much of it was carved directly into the rose red cliffs of the region.
佩特拉的建築獨具特色，因為其大部分建築是在當地的玫瑰紅懸崖上直接雕刻而成的。
words.en: in a straight line; immediately

words.zh: 1.（水、航）通道 2. 渠道，途徑 3. 頻道 v. 輸送，傳送
ex: Workers had to carve channels through mountains and construct bridges over valleys.
工人們需要在山體中開鑿通道，還要在山谷上修建橋樑。
words.en: a passage for water; a TV station; a way of communicating

words.zh: n. 1. 管道，管子 2. 煙斗 3. 管樂器；v. 用管道輸送
ex: We will be repairing a broken pipe in the ceiling.
我們將維修天花板上的一根破裂管道。
words.en: a tube that carries water or gas

words.zh: n. 1. 快樂，愉快 2. 令人高興的事；v. 使高興，使快樂
ex: It is the work of architects to create buildings that are not simply constructions but also offer inspiration and delight.
建築師的職責是讓創造出來的建築物不僅僅是建築物，還要為人們帶來靈感和快樂。
deriv: delighted a. 愉快的，高興的
delightful a. 令人愉快的，可喜的
words.en: great pleasure or joy

words.zh: a. 視覺的，視力的；n. 視覺資料
ex: When they created wallpapers, design reform advocates avoided illusions and visual deceptions.
在設計壁紙時，設計改革倡導者避免使用幻覺和視覺欺騙效果。
words.en: relating to seeing

words.zh: n. 1. 天賦，天才 2. 禮物，贈品；v. 1. 賦予 2. 贈送
ex: So she just had like...unnatural gift for architecture?
所以，她就是有……不同尋常的建築學天賦？
colloc: have a gift for 對……有天賦
deriv: gifted a. 天才的，有天賦的
words.en: something given to someone; a natural talent

words.zh: 驚人的，令人十分驚訝的
ex: The sheer size of space enclosed within buildings like the basilica of London must have been astonishing.
像倫敦大教堂這樣的建築，其內部空間的規模一定令人驚嘆不已。
words.en: extremely surprising

words.zh: 廟宇，寺院，神殿
ex: This remains true even if we follow those interpretations that would prefer "temple" to "palace" as the buildings' prime identification.
即便我們遵循那些更傾向於將這些建築的主要屬性認定為「廟宇」而非「宮殿」的解釋，這一點依然成立。
words.en: a building used for worship

words.zh: 1. 倒下，倒塌 2. 崩潰，瓦解
ex: It collapsed but it's actually now rebuilding.
它曾經倒塌了，但實際上現在正在重建。
colloc: on the verge of collapse 瀕於崩潰
words.en: to fall down suddenly

words.zh: v. [kənˈstrʌkt] 1. 建造，修建 2. 創立，創建；n. [ˈkɑːnstrʌkt] 構想，概念
ex: He constructed buildings for panoramas throughout Europe.
他在歐洲各地建造了用於全景畫展覽的建築。
words.en: to build something

words.zh: 1. 強度，力度 2. 力量，體力，活力 3. 優點，優勢
ex: Metals, which had the tensile strength that masonry materials lacked, were employed in minor and supplementary ways.
具有磚石材料所缺乏的抗拉強度的金屬，曾以次要和輔助的方式被使用。
colloc: on the strength of 憑借
words.en: the quality of being strong

words.zh: 1. 柱，柱狀物 2. 縱行（數字或字）3. 欄，專欄（報刊）4. 長隊
ex: They designed this special type of supporting piers, which were basically like the column shaped ones we've been looking at.
他們設計了這種特殊類型的支撐墩，基本上和我們一直在研究的柱狀支撐墩類似。
words.en: a tall upright post; a regular newspaper article

words.zh: 1. 廣闊的，廣大的 2. 廣泛的，廣博的
ex: The Romans, in particular, mastered the construction of aqueducts, building extensive networks that supplied water to urban centers.
羅馬人尤其精通渡槽的建造，他們修建了龐大的水道網絡，為城市中心供水。
words.en: covering a large area or having a wide range

words.zh: 墳墓
ex: The most famous structure in the city is known as the treasury, but it is actually a tomb.
這座城市最著名的建築被稱為寶庫，但它實際上是一座陵墓。
words.en: a place where a dead person is buried

words.zh: 清楚的，顯然的
ex: This blend of cultures is evident in the various architectural styles seen in the city which include influences from Greek, Roman and indigenous Nabataean designs.
這種文化融合在該城市多樣的建築風格中體現得淋漓盡致，其融合了希臘、羅馬，以及本土納巴泰建築設計的影響。
deriv: evidence n. 證據，根據 v. 證明，表明
words.en: clearly seen or understood

words.zh: 程序，步驟，手續
ex: In the event of an emergency during the maintenance period, please follow the building's evacuation procedures.
在維護期間如遇緊急情況，請遵循大樓的疏散程序。
words.en: a set of actions for doing something
syn: 審核，處理（文件等）2. 加工

words.zh: 1. 遙遠的，久遠的 2. 遠房的 3. 冷漠的
ex: Aqueducts were designed to transport water from distant sources into cities and agricultural areas, and they were crucial engineering feats in ancient civilizations.
渡槽的設計用途是將水從遠處的水源輸送到城市與農業區域，它們是古代文明中至關重要的工程壯舉。
words.en: far away in space or time

words.zh: a. 1. 穩定的，穩固的 2. 沉穩的，穩重的；n. 馬廄
ex: The vents maintain a stable internal temperature, which can be emulated in human architecture.
這些通氣孔能維持穩定的內部溫度，這一特性可在人類建築設計中效仿應用。
deriv: stability n. 穩定性，可靠性
words.en: firmly fixed; not likely to change

words.zh: 1. 原則，原理 2. 行為準則，道德原則 3. 觀念，信條
ex: They no longer use principles from Roman engineering.
他們不再沿用羅馬工程學的原理。
colloc: on the principle of 根據……的原則
stick to one's principles 堅持某人的原則
in principle 原則上，理論上；大體上，基本上
words.en: a basic rule or belief

words.zh: 地下室
ex: And when you're done shopping, don't forget to slow down and check out our newly added basement cafe and enjoy a complimentary cup of coffee.
購物結束後，請記得放慢腳步，光顧我們新開的地下咖啡館，還能免費享用一杯咖啡。
words.en: the lowest floor of a building, below ground

words.zh: n. 1. 梁，橫梁 2.（光線的）束，柱 3. 笑容；v. 1. 眉開眼笑 2. 發出（光），放射（能量）
ex: As a method of spanning space, the arch can support greater weight than a horizontal beam.
作為一種跨越空間的方式，拱形結構能比水平橫樑承受更大的重量。
words.en: a long piece of wood or metal supporting a roof; a ray of light

words.zh: 1. 黏稠度，堅實度 2. 一致性，連貫性
words.mnem: con- (=together) + sist (=stand) + -ency → 站在一起 → 一致 →（引申義）堅實度
ex: Clay daubing and adobe usually decay, but if a structure has been burned, the mud is baked to the consistency of a brick.
塗抹的黏土和土坯通常會腐爛，但如果建築經火燒過，這些泥料就會被烘烤成類似磚塊的堅實度。
deriv: consistent a. 始終如一的；連續的；相符的
inconsistent a. 不一致的；不穩定的
words.en: the quality of always behaving in the same way

words.zh: 1. 網格，網狀物，電網 2.（地圖上的）坐標方格 3.（汽車賽中的）賽車起跑線
ex: It had over...a number of massive religious edifices and a regular grid pattern of streets and buildings.
它已經擁有……許多大型的宗教建築和規整的網格形街道與建築物。
words.en: a pattern of straight lines crossing each other

words.zh: n. 1. 靠墊，坐墊 2. 起緩衝作用的事物；v. 緩衝
ex: Let's see, you could throw bright red cushions on your dark green sofa for example.
我們來看，例如，你可以在深綠色沙發上放置亮紅色靠墊。
words.en: a soft pillow; something that reduces the effect of a shock

words.zh: 直徑
ex: Once it's at least one meter in diameter, it's called a window.
一旦它的直徑至少達到一米，被稱為「窗口」。
words.en: a straight line passing through the center of a circle

words.zh: 煙囪
ex: So one important thing was that the rooms were arranged around a chimney in the center of the house.
因此，重要的一點是房間都圍繞房屋中央的煙囪排布。
words.en: a tube through which smoke leaves a building

words.zh: 1. 大量的，重大的 2. 結實的，牢固的 3. 實質性的
words.mnem: sub- (=under) + stant (=stand) + -ial → 在下方站立的，支撐的 → 結實的 →（引申義）重大的
ex: They stopped building substantial structures.
他們停止建造大型建築。
words.en: large in amount; solid and strong

words.zh: 限制，約束，強制
words.mnem: con- (=together) + strain (=draw tight) + -t → 限制，約束
ex: How engineers have to consider special demands like a budget and time constraints when they're designing buildings and other structures.
工程師在設計建築物及其他結構時，必須考慮諸如預算和時間限制等特殊要求。
deriv: constrained a. 被約束的，被迫的
words.en: something that limits what you can do

words.zh: 區分，區別
words.mnem: dif- (=apart) + fer (=carry) + ent + i + -ate → 分開拿 → 區分，區別
ex: It seems likely that Minoan people had two different types of buildings, palaces and temples, with clearly differentiated functions.
米諾斯人似乎擁有兩種不同類型的建築——宮殿和廟宇，它們各自具有明確的功能區分。
colloc: differentiate between good and evil 分清善惡
words.en: to see or show the difference between things

words.zh: 發出，射出，散發
words.mnem: e- (=out) + mit (=let go) → 發出，射出
ex: As the sides of these structures emit their stored heat, a portion is re-radiated between buildings rather than upward.
當這些建築的外牆釋放其儲存的熱量時，部分熱量會在建築之間重新輻射，而不是向上散發。
deriv: emission n. 放出，排放，射出
words.en: to send out light, heat, sound or gas

words.zh: n. 拱，拱門；v.（使）成弓形
ex: The arch was used by the early cultures of the Mediterranean area chiefly for underground drains.
地中海早期文化中主要用拱形結構來建造地下水渠。
words.en: a curved structure over an opening

words.zh: n. 水壩，攔河壩；v. 築壩
ex: Other human undertakings, such as mining and dam building, have brought results neither anticipated nor intended.
其他人類活動，如採礦和修建水壩，所帶來的結果既非預期也非本意。
words.en: a wall built across a river to hold back water

words.zh: 紀念
ex: We've already looked at portrait sculptures which are busts created to commemorate people who had died.
我們已經探討過那些用來紀念逝者的半身像雕塑。
deriv: commemoration n. 紀念，紀念儀式
words.en: to remember an important person or event with a ceremony

words.zh: 走道，人行通道
ex: Well, design doesn't necessarily include things like sculptures or decorative walkways or even eye-catching window displays.
其實，設計未必包括像雕塑、裝飾性走道或甚至引人注目的櫥窗展示之類的事物。
words.en: a path for people to walk along

words.zh: 圓屋頂，穹頂
ex: But when the dome was rotated, the birds changed their direction to match the artificial sky.
但當屋頂被轉動時，鳥兒們就會改變方向來適應這一人造天空。
words.en: a round roof shaped like half a ball

words.zh: 整修，修復
words.mnem: re- (=again) + nov (=new) + -ate → 翻新 → 整修，修復
ex: In an effort to counteract the trend, the college has announced a plan to renovate its on-campus housing.
為扭轉這一趨勢，校方宣布了一項整修校內宿舍的計劃。
words.en: to repair and improve an old building

words.zh: 1. 地球引力，重力 2. 嚴肅，莊嚴
words.mnem: grav (=heavy) + -ity → 地球引力，重力
ex: These structures used a combination of gravity and meticulously calculated gradients to ensure a steady flow of water.
這類水利設施結合了重力與精確計算的坡度，以此確保水流穩定。
deriv: gravitational a. 引力的，重力引起的
words.en: the force that pulls objects toward the earth

words.zh: 壯舉，功績
ex: In addition to its architectural and engineering feats, Petra is significant for its cultural exchanges.
除了在建築與工程方面的成就外，佩特拉的重要性還體現在文化交流方面。
words.en: an impressive achievement

words.zh: 冰屋
ex: What did the igloo and the wood house have in common?
冰屋和木屋有哪些共同之處？
words.en: a round house built from blocks of snow

words.zh: 堡壘，要塞
ex: The imposition of a military base involved the requisition of native lands for both the fort and the territory needed to feed and exercise the soldiers' animals.
建立軍事基地需要徵用當地的土地，既用於建造堡壘，也用於滿足士兵牲畜的飼養與放牧所需。
words.en: a strong building used for defense

words.zh: 大理石
ex: So you'd have wallpaper that actually looked like marble or wood grain or maybe like aged leather.
所以，你會擁有看起來酷似大理石、木紋或者可能像老化皮革的壁紙。
colloc: white marble 漢白玉，白色大理石
deriv: marbled a. 有大理石花紋的
words.en: a hard smooth stone used in building and sculpture

words.zh: 1. 樓層 2. 故事
ex: Steel construction, on the other hand, can support a building of 50 or 100 stories without difficulty.
另一方面，鋼結構可以毫不費力地支撐起 50 或 100 層的建築。
words.en: a floor of a building; an account of events

words.zh: 重於，大於，超過
ex: Despite these challenges, the benefits of aqueducts far outweighed the difficulties.
儘管存在這些挑戰，渡槽帶來的益處遠大於其建造過程中面臨的困難。
words.en: to be more important or greater than something

words.zh: 草皮
ex: And they laid the sod on the frame of the house, and it would stay in place because of the way the frame was slanted.
他們把草皮鋪在房屋的框架上，由於框架是傾斜的，草皮就會固定在原位。
words.en: a piece of grass and earth

words.zh: 華美的，富麗的
words.mnem: orn (=decorate) + -ate → 華美的，富麗的
ex: Home decoration became very popular and this led to the popularity of mass produced carpets and wallpaper in all sorts of ornate patterns and bright colors.
家居裝飾變得極為流行，這使得大量生產的地毯和牆紙也廣受歡迎，它們有著各式各樣華麗的圖案和鮮豔的色彩。
words.en: decorated with many complicated details

words.zh: 1. 進入，穿透，滲透 2. 洞察，發現
ex: It penetrates most quickly in urban areas with the tallest buildings.
它在擁有最高建築物的城市地區傳播得最快。
colloc: penetrate into/through sth. 進入或穿過某物
deriv: penetrating a.（聲音）響亮的；銳利的；深刻的
words.en: to go through or into something

words.zh: n. 1. 殘留物 2. 吃剩的食物；a. 剩餘的
ex: Look at this picture. These are stumps leftover from a structure.
看這張照片，這些是一座建築遺留下的樁基。
words.en: remaining after the rest has been used

words.zh: 偏遠的，邊遠的
ex: The vertical walls of office buildings, stores, and apartments do not allow radiation to escape as readily as in outlying rural areas where surfaces are relatively flat.
辦公樓、商店和公寓的垂直牆壁不像地勢相對平坦的偏遠農村地區那樣容易讓輻射散逸。
words.en: far from the center of a city or country

words.zh: 普通的，平庸的，平常的
words.mnem: medi (=middle) + -ocre → 中間的 → 普通的，平庸的
ex: The mediocre design of many contemporary buildings can be traced to both clients and architects.
許多當代建築設計平庸的根源在於客戶和建築師。
words.en: neither good nor bad; not very good

words.zh: 天窗，艙口
ex: People walked around on the roofs and entered the house through a hatchway on the roof, down a wooden ladder.
人們在屋頂上來回走動，而且可以通過屋頂上的天窗爬下木梯進入房間。
words.en: an opening in a floor, roof or ship's deck

words.zh: 窯
ex: Pottery workshops seem to have been further afield, situated near the fuel for the kilns rather than within palace confines.
陶藝工坊似乎在更遠的地方，它們位於窯爐燃料附近，而非宮殿範圍內。
words.en: an oven for baking pottery or bricks

words.zh: 大都會，大城市
words.mnem: metro- (=mother) + polis (=city) → 大城市
ex: The salt administration also maintained Venice's palatial public buildings and the complex hydraulic system that prevented the metropolis from washing away.
鹽務管理部門還負責維護威尼斯宏偉的公共建築和複雜的水利系統，以防止這座大都市被沖垮。
deriv: metropolitan a. 大都會的，大城市的
words.en: a very large and important city

words.zh: 在遠方，遠離（尤指家鄉）
ex: Pottery workshops were located further afield.
陶藝工坊地處更為偏遠的地方。
words.en: far away from home

words.zh: 1. 柱，柱子 2. 核心，支柱
ex: From a practical aspect this protected the figures against breakage and psychologically gave the images a sense of strength and power, usually enhanced by a supporting back pillar.
從實用角度而言，這樣可以保護人像不受破壞，而且從心理上給人一種力量感，這種力量感通常會通過其後部的柱子得以強化。
colloc: from pillar to post 從一處到另一處，到處奔波
pillar industry 支柱產業，主要工業
words.en: a tall upright post that supports a building

words.zh: 全景
words.mnem: pan- (=all) + orama (=view) → 全景
ex: He designed a building suitable for viewing panoramas.
他設計了一座適合觀賞全景的建築。
words.en: a wide view of a large area

words.zh: n. 1. 石膏，灰泥 2. 膏藥；v. 1. 塗灰泥 2. 張貼
words.mnem: plast (=form) + -er → 成型的物體 → 石膏，灰泥
ex: Well, for example, some gardens had plaster or marble birds that sang when water flowed through them.
例如，一些公園裡有石膏或大理石製成的小鳥，當有水流經它們時，這些小鳥就會發出鳴叫聲。
words.en: a soft mixture used to cover walls

words.zh: 擴大，增大
ex: He determined how to enlarge miniature panoramas.
他找到了放大微型全景圖的方法。
colloc: enlarge sb.'s knowledge 擴大某人的知識面
words.en: to make something bigger

words.zh: 1. 入口 2. 手段，途徑
ex: Other statues were designed to be placed within an architectural setting, for instance, in front of the monumental entrance gateways to temples.
其他雕像被設計放置在建築群中，比如，在廟宇宏偉的入口正前方。
words.en: an entrance; a way to reach something

words.zh: 起居室，客廳
ex: The paper in my parlor contains four kinds of birds of paradise besides bridges and pagodas.
我客廳的牆紙除了有橋和塔圖案外，還有四種天堂鳥的圖案。
words.en: a sitting room in a house

words.zh: v. 1. 使……模糊，隱藏 2. 使費解；a. 1. 無名的，鮮為人知的 2. 難以理解的，費解的
ex: Only when European decorative themes were introduced did these meanings become obscured or even lost.
當歐洲的裝飾題材被引進後，這些寓意就變得模糊，甚至消失。
words.en: not well known; difficult to understand

words.zh: 證明，證實
words.mnem: cert (=sure) + -ify → 證明，證實
ex: ...wood products ecologically certified by an independent organization with an international reputation for trustworthiness.
……這些木質產品獲得了一家享有國際公信力聲譽的獨立機構所做的生態學認證。
deriv: certification n. 證明，鑒定；證書
words.en: to officially state that something is true

words.zh: n. [ˈɔːrnəmənt] 裝飾，裝飾物；v. [ˈɔːrnəment] 裝飾
words.mnem: orna (=decorate) + -ment → 裝飾
ex: They're basically thick pads made from sticks and leaves surrounded by ornaments.
它們基本上是由樹枝和樹葉製成的厚墊子，周圍環繞著裝飾物。
words.en: a decorative object

words.zh: 渡槽，高架渠
ex: In addition to providing water for drinking and irrigation, aqueducts were integral to public health and sanitation.
除為飲用和灌溉供水之外，渡槽對公共衛生與環境衛生也至關重要。
words.en: a bridge-like structure that carries water

words.zh: 工業化
ex: Industrialization in the nineteenth century revolutionized building materials.
19 世紀的工業化給建築材料帶來了革命性的變化。
deriv: industrial a. 工業的，產業的
words.en: the development of industries in a country

words.zh: 顯著的，顯而易見的
words.mnem: not (=mark) + -ice + -able → 標誌 → 顯著的，顯而易見的
ex: Prior to the nineteenth century, the structural presence of iron in architecture was scarcely noticeable.
在 19 世紀之前，鐵在建築結構中的存在幾乎難以察覺。
words.en: easy to see or notice

words.zh: 旋轉，環繞
words.mnem: re- (=again) + volve (=roll) → 旋轉，環繞
ex: However, its position with respect to the surroundings could be changed by revolving either the inner cage containing the birds or the outer walls, which served as the background.
然而，其相對於周圍環境的位置卻可以變動，只需旋轉裝鳥的內籠或者充當背景的外牆即可。
colloc: revolve around 圍繞……轉動，以……為中心
words.en: to move in a circle around a central point

words.zh: 1. 空間，餘地 2. 房間，室 3. 可能性，機會
ex: These factors shape our choices, leaving little room for true free will.
這些因素左右著我們的選擇，幾乎沒有為真正的自由意志留下（發揮）空間。
colloc: make room for 讓地方（或位置）給……
deriv: roomful n. 滿房間（東西或人）
words.en: space; a part of a building; opportunity

words.zh: 1. 個性 2. 名人 3. 特色
ex: They appear to be born with resilient personality traits.
他們似乎天生就具有堅韌的個性特質。
words.en: the qualities that make a person different from others

words.zh: 1. 識別，辨認 2. 認可，賞識
ex: Very young children cannot recognize themselves in a mirror.
非常年幼的兒童無法在鏡子中認出自己。
words.en: to know someone or something because you have seen them before

words.zh: 1. 結果，後果 2. 重要（性），意義
ex: Because they fear failure or some other unpleasant consequence, children are sometimes afraid to engage in certain behaviors that could be beneficial to them.
由於害怕失敗或其他一些不愉快的後果，孩子們有時不敢去做某些對他們可能有益的行為。
colloc: bear/take the consequences 承擔後果
words.en: a result of something that happened

words.zh: 1. 聯繫，使有關聯 2. 講述，敘述
ex: We're going to talk today about a couple of experiments related to learning in infants or babies.
今天我們將討論幾個與嬰兒學習相關的實驗。
words.en: to connect or show a connection between things

words.zh: 變體，變種，版本
ex: I've used a version of this technique with my children.
我已經把這種方法的一種形式用在了我的孩子們身上。
words.en: a particular form of something

words.zh: 1. 履行，執行 2. 表演，演出
ex: With this technique, children are encouraged to perform gradually increasing amounts of the feared behavior.
通過這種方法，孩子們被鼓勵逐漸增加對其恐懼行為的實踐次數。
colloc: perform in the role of 扮演……的角色
words.en: to do an action or task; to entertain an audience
syn: 製作，做成（藝術品）2. 執行，履行 3. 處決

words.zh: 1. 下定義，解釋 2. 明確，界定
ex: Instead, we exist first and then define ourselves through our actions and choices.
相反，我們先存在，然後通過自身的行動與選擇來定義自我。
colloc: define sth. as sth. 把……定義為……
words.en: to say exactly what something means

words.zh: 實際的，實用的，實踐的
ex: Support from family and friends can provide emotional comfort and practical assistance during difficult times.
在困境時期，家人與朋友的支持既能提供情感慰藉，也能給予實際幫助。
colloc: practical value 實際價值，實用價值
practical work 社會實踐，實習作業
deriv: practically ad. 實際上；幾乎，差不多
words.en: useful in a real situation rather than in theory

words.zh: 1. 決定，確定 2. 查明，測定
ex: Some argue that free will is an illusion and that our choices are determined by factors beyond our control, such as genetics and environment.
一些人認為，自由意志是一種幻覺，且我們的選擇由基因、環境等自身無法控制的因素所決定。
colloc: determine on sth./to do sth. 決定做某事
words.en: to decide or find out exactly

words.zh: 1. 顯然的，明白的 2. 表面上的，貌似（真實）的
ex: And here, it becomes apparent that the infant is intentionally trying to communicate its desires and interests.
而在這一階段，很明顯嬰兒正有意嘗試表達自己的需求和興趣。
colloc: for no apparent reason 莫名其妙地
words.en: easy to see or understand; seeming real but not

words.zh: 盯著看，凝視
ex: And we know that when a baby is surprised by something...it stares at where the noise or light is coming from.
而且我們知道，當嬰兒被某物驚到時……他會盯著聲音或光束投來的方向。
colloc: stare someone down 盯得某人轉移目光
words.en: to look at something for a long time without moving your eyes

words.zh: 保留，保持
ex: Babies retain information better when learning involves physical actions.
嬰兒在學習過程中涉及身體動作時，能更好地記住信息。
words.en: to keep something; to continue to have

words.zh: n. 強烈的慾望，衝動；v. 1. 驅趕，鞭策 2. 強烈要求，力勸
ex: Both children and adults demonstrate behaviors that are the results of their urge to restore freedom.
兒童和成人的行為表現都源於他們重獲自由的內在渴望。
colloc: urge sb. to do sth. 催促／力勸某人做某事
urge sb. on 鼓勵，為……加油
urge sth. (on/upon sb.) 大力推薦
words.en: a strong wish; to strongly encourage someone to do something

words.zh: 1. 抵制，阻擋，反抗 2. 不受……影響，抗，耐
ex: But they resist that temptation and still triumph in the end.
但他們抵制住了那種誘惑，最終依然取得了勝利。
deriv: resistant a. 抵抗的；阻止的；抗……的
words.en: to refuse to accept something; to fight against

words.zh: 繼續進行，繼續下去
ex: But what I meant to say is that physical growth as a whole may proceed at a different rate from, say, mental development.
但我想說的是，總體而言，身體發育的速度可能與智力發展不同的速度推進。
colloc: proceed against sb. 起訴，控訴某人
words.en: to continue to do something after stopping

words.zh: a. 1. 最終的，最後的 2. 極端的，最好（或、偉大、重要等）的；n. 最好的事物
ex: Even more important to their ultimate success in the world, young infants are capable of making the fine discriminations.
對嬰兒們未來在社會上的最終成功而言，更為重要的是，他們具備做出細微辨別的能力。
words.en: being or happening at the end; the best or most extreme

words.zh: 不確定，不可靠
ex: Generally, there is uncertainty as to whether very young children can distinguish between fantasy and reality in advertising.
總的來說，關於低齡兒童能否分辨廣告中的幻想與現實，目前還不確定。
words.en: the state of not being sure

words.zh: 1. 有根據的，正確的 2.（法律上）有效的
ex: If you have a solid base for your knowledge claims, then your knowledge structure is more likely to be strong, valid and true.
如果你的知識儲備擁有堅實的基礎，那麼你的知識結構也會更加堅固、準確、真實。
deriv: validate v. 使有法律效力
validity n.（法律上的）有效；正確
words.en: logical and reasonable; legally acceptable

words.zh: 1. 視角，觀點，看法 2. 遠景，景觀 3. 透視法
ex: It can offer them a new perspective or a sense of possibility in their lives.
它能為他們提供一種全新的視角，或是讓他們感受到生活中的各種可能性。
words.en: a particular way of thinking about something

words.zh: 1. 闡明，澄清 2. 淨化
ex: It could help the student clarify her career goals.
這有助於該學生明確自己的職業目標。
words.en: to make something easier to understand

words.zh: 1. 意識到的 2. 神志清醒的 3. 有意的
ex: It is developed more by conscious effort than by instinct.
它更多地是通過有意識的努力而非本能發展起來的。
colloc: be conscious of 知道，意識到
deriv: consciously ad. 有意識地，清楚地
words.en: aware of something; deliberate

words.zh: a. 1. 智力的，腦力的，理智的 2. 有才智的；n. 知識分子，腦力勞動者
ex: It's not so clear for intellectual development.
對於智力發展而言，情況就沒那麼明晰了。
deriv: intellectually ad. 智力上；理智地
words.en: relating to the ability to think and understand

words.zh: a. 主要的，首要的；n. 1. 本金，資本 2. 校長 3. 主角，關鍵人物
ex: For principal number three, now you may already know that there are specific stages in an infant's development.
關於主要的第三條原則，現在你可能已經知道嬰兒的發展過程存在特定的階段。
words.en: most important; the head of a school

words.zh: n. 順序，次序；v. 按順序排列
ex: That's because development follows in orderly sequence.
這是因為發育是循序漸進的。
words.en: a set of things that happen in a particular order

words.zh: 推論，推斷
ex: Yeah, we're assuming that we're inferring beliefs from behavior.
是的，我們假定正在從行為中推斷出信念。
words.en: to form an opinion from evidence

words.zh: 結果，後果
ex: After they are repeatedly exposed to the behavior and experience no negative consequences, they gradually become confident that a negative outcome is unlikely.
在反覆接觸該行為且未遭遇負面結果後，他們會逐漸相信負面結果不太可能發生。
words.en: the result of an action or process

words.zh: 1. 地位，身分 2. 情形，狀況
ex: With a good education, individuals can acquire the knowledge and skills needed to access better job opportunities and improve their social status.
接受良好的教育後，個人能夠掌握獲取更好就業機會和提升自身社會地位所需的知識與技能。
words.en: a person's position or rank in society

words.zh: 1. 判斷，評價 2. 審判，判決
ex: While external influences play a role, people can still exercise their own judgment and take actions that are not predetermined by their circumstances.
儘管外部影響會發揮作用，但人們依然可以運用自身的判斷力，採取並非由自身處境預先決定的行動。
deriv: judge n. 法官；裁判員 v. 審判；評判
words.en: the ability to make good decisions; a legal decision

words.zh: 加強，增強
ex: Next, we will discuss various strategies that individuals can use to build and strengthen their resilience over time.
接下來，我們將探討個人可以採用的各種方法，以長期培養並增強自身的心理韌性。
deriv: strength n. 力氣；強度；優勢
words.en: to become or make something stronger

words.zh: 1. 全面的，詳盡的 2. 完全的，徹底的
ex: This knowledge is valuable not just personally, but also professionally, as businesses and organizations can benefit from more objective and thorough decision making practices.
這類知識不僅在個人層面具有價值，在職業發展層面亦有意義——因為企業和組織能從更客觀、更全面的決策實踐中獲益。
deriv: thoroughgoing a. 全面的；仔細的
words.en: complete and careful

words.zh: 情況，環境，條件
ex: Our inappropriate behavior was due to events or circumstances beyond our control.
我們的不當行為是由超出自身控制的事件或環境造成的。
colloc: in/under no circumstances 決不，無論如何也不
words.en: a condition that affects a situation

words.zh: 1. 使適應，調整 2. 改寫，改編
ex: Resilience refers to the ability to adapt and recover from adversity or stress.
韌性指的是在面對逆境或壓力時，個體能夠適應環境並從中恢復的能力。
deriv: adaptive a. 適應的，有適應能力的
words.en: to change in order to deal with a new situation
look: 只差一個字母，最常搞混

words.zh: 傾向，趨勢
ex: This refers to people's tendency to rely heavily on the first piece of information they receive, the anchor, when making decisions.
這指的是人們在做決策時，往往會過度依賴最先接收到的信息——即所謂的「錨點」——的傾向。
deriv: tend v. 傾向、趨於、易於
tendentious a. 傾向性的，有偏見的
words.en: a likelihood of behaving in a certain way

words.zh: 欺騙，蒙騙
ex: For instance, Sartre spoke extensively about the concept of bad faith where individuals deceive themselves to escape the anxiety of freedom by conforming to societal expectations, or denying their own potential.
例如，Sartre 曾深入探討過「自欺」這一概念——即個體通過屈從於社會期待，或否定自身潛能來欺騙自己，從而逃避因自由而產生的焦慮。
deriv: deceitful a. 不誠實的，騙人的
words.en: to make someone believe something that is not true

words.zh: 特點，特徵，特性
ex: Research has shown that certain traits and behaviors can enhance resilience.
研究表明，某些特質和行為能夠增強韌性。
colloc: traits of character 性格特徵
words.en: a particular quality in someone's character

words.zh: 緊密相關的，切題的，適宜的
ex: The availability heuristic is another bias that involves making decisions based on the information that is most readily available, rather than all relevant information.
可得性啟發法是另一種認知偏差，指的是人們依據最容易獲取的信息來做決策，而非所有相關信息。
words.en: connected with what is being discussed

words.zh: 暫時的，臨時的
ex: For instance, people who maintain a positive outlook are better equipped to handle setbacks because they tend to see challenges as temporary and surmountable.
例如，保持積極心態的人更有能力應對挫折，因為他們往往會把挑戰看作是暫時的、可以克服的。
words.en: lasting for only a limited time

words.zh: 1. 必要（性），需要 2. 必需品
ex: Parents should encourage their teenagers to take part-time jobs to help them learn to be responsible, even if it is not an economic necessity for the teenagers to work.
即使青少年並非出於經濟需要而工作，父母也應該鼓勵他們去做兼職，以幫助其培養責任感。
colloc: by necessity 不得已，必然地
of necessity 必定，不可避免地
out of necessity 出於需要，必定
deriv: necessary a. 必要的；不可避免的
words.en: something that you must have

words.zh: n. 嬰兒，幼兒；a. 1. 供嬰幼兒用的 2. 初期的
words.mnem: in- (=not) + fant (=speak) → 不會說話的 → 供嬰幼兒用的
ex: And studies have shown that even six-month-old infants are able to use this sense to some extent.
而且研究表明，即使是 6 個月大的嬰兒也能在一定程度上使用這種感官能力。
colloc: infant industry 新生工業，新興產業
deriv: infancy n. 嬰兒期；初創期
words.en: a very young child

words.zh: 認知的，感知的
words.mnem: cogn (=know) + it + -ive → 認知的，感知的
ex: Understanding cognitive biases is crucial for improving decision making processes.
理解認知偏差對於改進決策過程至關重要。
words.en: relating to mental processes such as thinking

words.zh: n. 新生兒；a. 新生的
ex: As support for this conjecture, researchers point to the fact that newborns do not show a preference for their fathers' voices over other male voices.
為支持這一猜想，研究人員指出，新生兒對父親的聲音並不比對其他男性的聲音更偏愛。
words.en: a baby that has just been born

words.zh: 1. 忽視，忽略 2. 俯視，眺望
ex: As time passes, they will overlook the option's disadvantages, eventually even forgetting them.
隨著時間的流逝，他們將忽略這種選擇的劣勢，甚至最終將其遺忘。
colloc: overlook a fault 寬容過失
words.en: to fail to notice; to have a view over

words.zh: 清楚的，明確的
words.mnem: ex- (=out) + plic (=fold) + -it → 向外疊的 → 清楚的，明確的
ex: Babies develop explicit memory abilities earlier than previously believed.
嬰兒外顯記憶能力的發展比之前認為的更早。
words.en: stated clearly and exactly

words.zh: 被動的，消極的
words.mnem: pass (=suffer) + -ive → 被動的，消極的
ex: Families feel more connected while working together rather than while doing passive activities, such as watching TV.
與一起看電視這類被動活動相比，家庭成員在共同協作時會感覺更親密。
words.en: accepting what happens without taking action

words.zh: 1. 懷疑的，不確定的 2. 拿不準
ex: He is doubtful that he has enough time.
他懷疑自己是否有足夠的時間。
deriv: doubt v. 懷疑，不相信 n. 疑問，疑慮
words.en: not sure or unlikely

words.zh: 報復，復仇
words.mnem: re- (=again) + venge (=avenge) → 報復，復仇
ex: He was interested in revenge and wealth—and those are less admirable goals.
他貪圖復仇與財富，而這些目標可不怎麼值得讚賞。
words.en: harm done to someone in return for harm they did

words.zh: 1. 堅定的信念，堅信 2. 定罪，判罪
words.mnem: con- (=thoroughly) + vict (=conquer) + -ion → 完全征服，說服 → 堅信；判罪
ex: It's a bit abstract but he's very into each person believing his or her own thought, believing in yourself, the thought or conviction that's true for you.
這有些抽象，但是他非常推崇每個人堅持自己的想法，相信自己，相信你認為正確的想法或信念。
deriv: convict v. 證明……有罪，宣判……有罪
words.en: a strong belief; a legal decision of guilt

words.zh: 養育子女
ex: One major survey found that experiences like education, jobs, and parenting can alter personality and generally for the good.
一項重要的調查發現，諸如教育、工作和育兒之類的經歷能夠改變個性，且通常是有益的。
words.en: the process of raising a child

words.zh: 可信的，可靠的
words.mnem: cred (=believe) + -ible → 可信的，可靠的
ex: Children accept such characters as credible sources of nutritional information.
孩子們會把這類角色視為可信的營養信息來源。
deriv: credibility n. 可靠性，可信性
words.en: able to be believed or trusted

words.zh: 1. 差別，區別 2. 優秀，卓越 3. 榮譽，獎賞
words.mnem: di- (=apart) + stinct (=prick) + -ion → 挑刺 → 差別，區別
ex: So that distinction between two different kinds of memory is important in this debate about memory in infants.
所以，在關於嬰兒記憶的這場爭論中，兩種不同記憶類型之間的區別很重要。
deriv: distinctive a. 獨特的，特別的
words.en: a clear difference between two things

words.zh: 謹慎的，小心的
ex: Some people enjoy taking risks and trying new things. Others are not adventurous: they are cautious and prefer to avoid danger.
有些人喜歡冒險並嘗試新事物，而另一些人則不愛冒險，他們很謹慎，傾向於規避危險。
deriv: caution n. 謹慎；警告 v. 警告
cautionary a. 警告的，告誡的
words.en: careful to avoid danger or mistakes

words.zh: 吮吸，吸
ex: The infants sucked significantly longer when the voice was that of their mother than when the voice was that of a stranger.
當聽到母親的聲音時，嬰兒吮吸的時間明顯比聽到陌生人的聲音時要長。
colloc: suck up (to sb.) 奉承，巴結
words.en: to pull liquid into the mouth; to be very bad

words.zh: 講（故事），敘述
ex: The opportunity to hear chronologically narrated stories may help three-year-old children produce long-lasting memories.
有機會聆聽按時間順序講述的故事，可能有助於 3 歲兒童形成持久的記憶。
deriv: narration n. 敘述；旁白，解說
narrative n. 敘述 a. 敘事的
narrator n. 解說員；敘述者
words.en: to tell a story

words.zh: 從業者
ex: They have often failed in their attempts to become reflective practitioners.
他們嘗試成為反思型從業者，卻經常以失敗告終。
colloc: a general practitioner 全科醫生
words.en: a person who works in a profession such as medicine

words.zh: v. 使痛苦，使苦惱，使憂傷；n. 1. 悲痛，憂慮 2. 貧困，窮迫
words.mnem: di- (=apart) + stress (=draw tight) → 強行拉走 → 使痛苦，使憂傷
ex: We like having choices and think that having more choices should please us; but instead, it causes us distress.
我們喜歡擁有選擇，並且認為選擇越多越能讓我們開心。但事實恰恰相反，過多的選擇反而讓我們苦惱。
deriv: distressed a. 苦惱的，憂慮的
words.en: extreme worry or pain; to upset someone

words.zh: 1. 笨拙的，不靈巧的 2. 難用的
ex: Well, sometimes during adolescence, when children are growing so quickly, they may seem to feel awkward and clumsy.
其實，青春期的孩子們有時成長得非常迅速，這時他們可能會感覺自己舉止尷尬、笨手笨腳。
words.en: moving or doing things in an awkward way

words.zh: 1. 成就，成績 2. 完成，實現 3. 技能，才藝
words.mnem: ac- (=to) + com- (=thoroughly) + pli (=fill) + sh + -ment → 完成 → 成就
ex: Working toward a common goal, such as planting a garden, helps families create happy memories and feel a sense of accomplishment.
為共同目標而努力（比如種植花園），有助於家庭成員創造美好的回憶並獲得成就感。
words.en: something achieved successfully

words.zh: 面對，對抗
words.mnem: con- (=together) + front (=forehead) → 一起站在前面 → 面對，對抗
ex: This can lead to feelings of anxiety or existential angst as individuals confront the freedom and burden of shaping their own lives.
當個體在面對塑造自我人生的自由與重負時，這可能會導致產生焦慮或存在性焦慮的情緒。
colloc: confront sb. with sb./sth. 使面臨……，使對付
words.en: to deal with a difficult situation or person

words.zh: 看護者
ex: But with everything we've talked about so far, the babies are mostly reacting to what their caregiver does.
但結合我們目前討論的所有內容來看，嬰兒主要是對其照護者的行為做出反應。
words.en: a person who looks after someone who is sick or young

words.zh: v. [əˈtrɪbjuːt] 把……歸因於；n. [ˈætrɪbjuːt] 品質，屬性
words.mnem: at- (=to) + tribut (=bestow) + -e → 把……歸因於
ex: One way to account for inappropriate behavior is to attribute it to something beyond our control.
解釋不當行為的一種方式是將之歸因於我們無法控制的因素。
words.en: to say that something is caused by something else; a quality

words.zh: 學步的兒童
ex: While such repression may occur, people cannot remember ordinary events from the infant and toddler periods, either.
儘管這種壓抑可能存在，人們也無法記住嬰兒期和幼兒期的普通事情。
words.en: a very young child who is learning to walk

words.zh: 1. 行動，行為 2.（~s）（尤指房產）契約，證書
ex: Sentimental theorists claim that evil deeds happen because people are led astray by bad influences.
情感主義理論家認為，惡行的發生是因為人們受到不良影響而誤入歧途。
colloc: deeds of heroism 英雄事跡
words.en: something that someone does; a legal document

words.zh: 1. 嬰兒期 2. 初創期
words.mnem: in- (=not) + fanc (=speak) + -y → 不會說話 → 嬰兒期
ex: More puzzling is why, after infancy, children's ability to hear very high and low frequencies gradually declines.
更令人費解的是，為什麼在嬰兒期之後，兒童聽到極高頻和極低頻聲音的能力會逐漸下降。
deriv: infant n. 嬰兒 a. 供嬰幼兒用的；初創期的
words.en: the period when someone is a baby

words.zh: 1. 清醒的，理智的 2. 合理的
words.mnem: rat (=reason) + -ion + -al → 清醒的；合理的
ex: By recognizing these biases, individuals can work to mitigate their effects, leading to more rational and effective decisions.
通過認識到這些偏見的存在，人們便可以努力減輕其影響，從而做出更加理智且有效的決策。
colloc: rational choice 理性選擇，理性抉擇
words.en: based on reason; able to think clearly

words.zh: 固有的，內在的
words.mnem: in- (=in) + her (=stick) + -ent → 附著於體內的 → 固有的，內在的
ex: Human beings have inherent characteristics.
人類具有固有的特質。
words.en: existing as a natural part of something

words.zh: 不顧（despite, notwithstanding）
ex: Others believe that individuals have the ability to make free choices regardless of external influences.
另一些人認為，無論外部影響如何，個體都有能力做出自由選擇。
words.en: despite everything

words.zh: 本能，直覺，天性
words.mnem: in- (=in) + stinct (=prick) → 內部刺激 → 直覺
ex: That's right, and they said you do this by appealing to a person's natural instincts.
確實如此，他們表示，實現這一目標的方法是通過激發一個人的自然本能。
deriv: instinctive a. 本能的，直覺的，天生的
words.en: a natural way of behaving that you do not need to learn

words.zh: 1. 似乎有道理的，可信的 2. 花言巧語的
words.mnem: plaus (=clap) + -ible → 令人不禁鼓掌的 → 似乎有道理的，可信的
ex: Another seemingly plausible explanation—that infants do not form enduring memories at this point in development—also is incorrect.
另一種看似合理的解釋——即這個發育階段的嬰兒（對發生的事情）無法形成持久記憶——並不準確。
colloc: a plausible excuse 看似有理的藉口
words.en: seeming reasonable or likely to be true

words.zh: 1. 有適應力的，可迅速恢復的 2. 有彈性的
words.mnem: re- (=back) + sil (=leap) + i + -ent → 跳回來 → 有彈性的 → 有適應力的
ex: Resilient people don't generally feel like victims or feel sorry for themselves or complain a lot when things go wrong.
堅韌的人通常不會認為自己是受害者，也不會自怨自艾，遇到事情不順利時更不會繁繁抱怨。
words.en: able to recover quickly after difficulties

words.zh: 逆境，不幸
words.mnem: ad- (=to) + vers (=turn) + -ity → 轉向反方向 → 逆境
ex: When resilient people face adversity, they generally refuse to be discouraged.
堅韌的人在面對逆境時，通常不會氣餒。
deriv: adverse a. 不利的，有害的
words.en: a difficult or unlucky situation
look: 只差一個字母，最常搞混

words.zh: 聽覺的
words.mnem: audi (=hear) + -tory → 聽覺的
ex: Because they have had some practice in hearing before birth, it is not surprising that infants have reasonably good auditory perception after they are born.
由於嬰兒在出生前已經有過一定的聽覺練習，因此他們出生後具有相當好的聽覺感知能力並不令人驚訝。
words.en: relating to hearing

words.zh: a. [əˈdept] 擅長的，熟練的；n. [ˈædept] 高手，老手
ex: Children may not be adept enough to realize that what they are viewing is unreal.
小孩可能不夠老練，從而無法意識到他們所看到的並非是真實的。
words.en: skilled at doing something
look: 只差一個字母，最常搞混

words.zh: 新生兒，初生嬰兒（尤指出生不滿四週的）
words.mnem: neo- (=new) + nat (=born) + -e → 新生兒
ex: For example, if a uniformly moving pattern of some sort is passed across the visual field of a neonate, repetitive following movements of the eye occur.
例如，如果某種勻速移動的物體經過新生兒的視野，其眼睛會反覆跟著移動。
colloc: neonate psychology 新生兒心理學
words.en: a baby in the first four weeks after birth

words.zh: 持久的
ex: However, intrinsic motivation is generally considered to be more long-lasting than the other.
但是，內在動機通常被認為比外在動機更持久。
words.en: continuing for a long time

words.zh: 無知的，不了解的
words.mnem: i- (=not) + gnor (=know) + -ant → 無知的，不了解的
ex: In other words, people deliberately choose to remain ignorant of the differences because learning about them is not worth the time or energy.
換句話說，人們故意選擇對這些差異保持無知，因為了解它們並不值得花費時間和精力。
words.en: not knowing about something

words.zh: 成熟
ex: It is not fully clear what leads to the improvement during infancy in sensitivity to sounds, although it may be related to the maturation of the nervous system.
目前尚不完全清楚是什麼導致嬰兒期的聲音敏感度出現提升，儘管這可能與神經系統的成熟有關。
deriv: mature a. 成熟的 v. 成熟
words.en: the process of becoming fully developed

words.zh: 連結，相關
ex: Our ties with people often deepen as we interact with them and gradually evolve interlocking habits and interests.
當我們和他人進行互動並且逐漸形成相互交織的行為習慣和興趣愛好時，我們之間的聯繫往往就會加深了。
words.en: to fit tightly together

words.zh: 遺傳
words.mnem: her (=heir) + -ed + -ity → 遺傳
ex: The first general principle is that development is influenced by both heredity and environment.
第一條普遍原則是，發展受遺傳和環境的雙重影響。
deriv: hereditary a. 遺傳的；世襲的
words.en: the passing of characteristics from parents to children

words.zh: 有效力的，有影響力的，強有力的
words.mnem: pot (=power) + -ent → 有效力的，有影響力的
ex: The third, and most potent, limitation is that it is not possible to be certain that the infant's response was due to the stimulus presented.
第三點，也是最有影響力的局限性在於，我們不可能確定嬰兒的反應是由所呈現的刺激引起的。
deriv: potential n. 潛力，潛能 a. 潛在的，可能的
words.en: having a strong effect

words.zh: 過於籠統地講
ex: Care must be taken not to overgeneralize from the data or to rely on one or two studies as conclusive evidence of a particular perceptual ability of the infant.
必須注意避免對數據進行過於籠統的概括，也不可將一兩項研究作為嬰兒某種認知能力的決定性證據。
words.en: to apply a general idea too widely

words.zh: 1. 使傾向於 2. 使易於患（某種病）
words.mnem: pre- (=before) + dis- (=apart) + pos (=put) + -e → 預先放置 → 使傾向於
ex: Think of resilience as a set of personality traits that predisposed someone to approach a difficult situation as a challenge that can be overcome.
不妨將韌性視為一系列的個性特質，這些特質使人們傾向於把困境當作可以克服的挑戰。
words.en: to make someone likely to behave in a certain way

words.zh: 占主導地位的，顯著的
words.mnem: pre- (=before) + domin (=rule) + -ant → 在前面進行統治的 → 占主導地位的，顯著的
ex: Well, historically, the predominant view was that personality was pretty much set by age 30.
從歷史上看，主流觀點認為人格在 30 歲左右就基本定型了。
deriv: predominance n. 優勢；主導地位
words.en: most common or noticeable

words.zh: 1. 抑制，壓抑 2. 鎮壓
words.mnem: re- (=back) + press (=press) → 壓抑；鎮壓
ex: Well, once a popular explanation was that childhood memories are always repressed.
曾經一種流行的解釋認為童年的記憶總是受到壓制。
words.en: to control a feeling or stop something from happening

words.zh: 1. 堅持不懈 2. 持續存在
words.mnem: per- (=through) + sist (=stand) + -ence → 始終屹立 → 堅持不懈
ex: What I'm talking about is persistence, coming back again and again after repeated failures.
我所說的是堅持不懈，即在屢遭失敗後仍一次次重新嘗試。
deriv: persistent a. 堅持不懈的；持續的，反覆出現的
words.en: the quality of continuing to try despite difficulty

words.zh: 認識，認知
words.mnem: cogn (=know) + it + -ion → 認識，認知
ex: That's because abilities like cognition and perception may develop at different rates and reach their maximum development at different times.
這是因為諸如認知和感知等能力可能以不同的速度發展，而且在不同的時期達到其發展峰值。
deriv: cognitive a. 認識的，認知的
words.en: the process of knowing and understanding

words.zh: 不一致，不和諧
words.mnem: dis- (=apart) + son (=sound) + -ance → 聲音分散 → 不一致
ex: When faced with a difficult choice, people often experience dissonance after making a decision, particularly if the chosen option has downsides.
人們在面臨艱難抉擇後，尤其是當所選方案存在弊端時，常會體驗到決策後的心理不適感。
colloc: cognitive dissonance theory 認知失調理論
deriv: dissonant a. 不協調的，不相稱的
words.en: a lack of agreement or harmony

words.zh: 不成熟
ex: Rational appeals in advertising are certainly limited by children's emotional immaturity and the indirect nature of their associations.
廣告中的理性訴求必定因兒童情感上的不成熟和聯想的間接性而受到限制。
deriv: mature a. 成熟的 v. 成熟
words.en: lack of mature behavior

words.zh: a. [əˈprɑːksɪmət] 近似的，大約的；v. [əˈprɑːksɪmeɪt] 1. 概略估算 2. 近似，接近
ex: I mean, if someone's born with good approximate number sense, does that cause them to be good at math?
我的意思是，若一個人天生具備良好的近似數感，那麼這會使他擅長數學嗎？
words.en: close to but not exactly right

words.zh: 不重要的，瑣碎的
ex: It may sound trivial, but newborn infants don't seem to have it.
這聽起來可能微不足道，但新生兒似乎並不具備這一點。
colloc: trivial matters 無關緊要的事情
deriv: trivia n. 瑣事，細枝末節
words.en: not important or serious

words.zh: 1. 眨眼睛 2.（燈光）閃爍
ex: Similarly, changes in the infant's general level of motor activity—turning the head, blinking the eyes, crying...
同樣的，嬰兒身體活動的總體水平也會改變，比如搖頭、眨眼、哭鬧……
colloc: on the blink 失靈，出毛病
in the blink of an eye 一眨眼工夫，瞬間
words.en: to close and open your eyes quickly

words.zh: 傾向，癖性
words.mnem: pre- (=before) + dis- (=apart) + pos (=put) + it + -ion → 預先放置 → 傾向，癖性
ex: Our decisions are heavily influenced by factors such as our upbringing, social environment, and biological predispositions.
我們的決策深受多種因素影響，例如家庭教養、社會環境，以及生物性傾向。
deriv: predispose v. 使傾向於，使受……的影響
words.en: a tendency to behave or be affected in a certain way

words.zh: n. 鋼，鋼鐵；v. 使堅強地做（或面對）
ex: But the mass production of steel required further technological innovations to rid the metal of weakening impurities.
但鋼鐵的大規模生產需要進一步的技術創新，以去除金屬中會削弱其性能的雜質。
words.en: a strong metal made from iron and carbon

words.zh: n. 1. 金屬絲 2. 電線，導線 3. 電報；v. 1. 給……安裝電線 2. 發電報給
ex: Copper is also a superb conductor of electricity so you can stretch it into wires which go into appliances and even car motors.
銅也是一種極佳的電導體，你可以把它拉成銅絲，用到電器甚至汽車發動機上。
colloc: wire sth. up 在……裡裝設電線
deriv: wireless a. 無線的 n. 無線電報
words.en: a thin metal thread; to connect with electric cables

words.zh: v. 1. 鑄造 2. 投擲，投射 3. 分配角色，選派角色；n. 1. 全體演員 2. 鑄模，模子
ex: It was cast in metal from a mold and so could be renewed without difficulty.
它是用模具鑄造成的金屬，因此可以毫不費力地重新利用。
colloc: cast about 搜尋；苦苦思索
cast doubt on 對……產生懷疑
cast sb./sth. out 驅逐，逐出
words.en: to make something by pouring liquid into a mold; to throw

words.zh: n. 混凝土；a. 1. 有形的，實在的 2. 確實的，具體的
ex: The first is the heat capacity of the materials that constitute the city, which is typically dominated by concrete and asphalt.
第一個（因素）是建設城市的材料的熱容，這通常以混凝土和瀝青為主。
words.en: a hard building material made from cement; real and specific
look: 只差一個字母，最常搞混

words.zh: n. 罐子，廣口瓶；v. 1. 撞擊，震動 2. 不和諧，相衝突
ex: Redi filled three jars with decaying meat and sealed them tightly.
Redi 將腐爛的肉放入三個罐子中，並將它們密封嚴實。
words.en: a glass container with a wide top

words.zh: 1. 絲綢，絲織物 2. 蠶絲
ex: The silk road is an ancient trade route that connected the east and west.
絲綢之路是一條連接東西方的古老貿易路線。
deriv: silken a. 絲綢的；柔和的
words.en: a fine soft cloth made from the thread of a silkworm

words.zh: n. 1. 水泥 2. 膠合劑；v. 1. 粘結，膠合 2. 鞏固，加強
ex: After you spread plaster on a surface, it'll harden, like cement does.
你在表面塗上灰泥後，它會變硬，就像水泥一樣。
words.en: a gray powder used to make concrete; to make something firm

words.zh: 1. 容器 2. 船，艦 3. 血管，脈管，導管
ex: And we're going to focus on ceramic cooking vessels from just one part of the world.
並且我們將著重講來自世界某地的陶瓷烹飪器具。
words.en: a container for liquid; a ship; a tube in the body

words.zh: a. 1. 粗略的，粗糙的 2. 天然的，未加工的 3. 粗魯的；n. 原油，石油
ex: Cast iron is the crudest form, containing the most impurities and thus being extremely brittle.
鑄鐵是最粗糙的鐵製品形態，含有最多的雜質，因此極其硬脆。
words.en: simple and rough; in a natural state

words.zh: n. 1. 齒輪，傳動裝置 2. 排擋；v. 使適合
ex: Inside the box, bronze gears would have rotated the displays.
在箱子裡，青銅齒輪會帶動顯示器旋轉。
words.en: a toothed wheel in a machine; equipment

words.zh: 鞋帶
ex: It is sort of like the plastic tip on each end of shoelace.
它有點兒像鞋帶兩端的塑料頭。
words.en: a cord used to fasten a shoe

words.zh: n. 1. 線 2. 思路，貫穿的主線 3. 線狀物；v. 穿（過），通過
ex: It may not help you tie your shoe, but that little plastic tip keeps the rest of the shoelace, the shoe-string from unraveling into weak and useless threads.
它或許不能幫你繫鞋帶，但那個小塑料頭能防止鞋帶的其餘部分鬆散成不結實且無用的線。
deriv: threadbare a. 磨薄的，破舊的
words.en: a long thin piece of cotton or silk used for sewing
look: 只差一個字母，最常搞混

words.zh: 微妙的，細微的，巧妙的
ex: Jade is a dense stone that can be ground to smooth, soft surfaces and glows in subtle greens, grays, and browns.
玉是一種質地緻密的石材，其表面可被打磨得光滑細膩，並且會呈現出淡淡的綠色、灰色或棕色。
words.en: not obvious; delicate

words.zh: v. [ˈkɑːmplɪment] 補足，補充；n. [ˈkɑːmplɪmənt] 補充物，補足物
words.mnem: com- (=together) + ple (=fill) + -ment → 補足，補充
ex: Their properties complemented those of concrete.
它們的特性與混凝土的特性形成互補。
colloc: complement each other 相輔相成
deriv: complementary a. 補充的，互補的
words.en: something that completes or improves another thing
look: 只差一個字母，最常搞混

words.zh: 陶器
ex: They stopped making fine pottery.
他們不再製作精美的陶器。
words.en: objects made from baked clay

words.zh: 1. 成分，構成 2. 作品 3. 創作，作曲
words.mnem: com- (=together) + pos (=put) + it + -ion → 放在一起 → 成分，構成
ex: This tool can distinguish between different materials that look the same to the eye, but have different compositions.
這種工具能夠區分在肉眼看來相同，但成分不同的各種材料。
deriv: compose v. 組成；作曲；使鎮定
words.en: the parts that something is made of; a piece of music or writing

words.zh: 亞麻布
ex: Members of poor peasant families spun or wove cloth and linens at home for scant remuneration in an attempt to supplement meager family income.
為了補貼微薄的家庭收入，貧苦農民家庭的成員在家紡織衣料或亞麻布來換取少量的報酬。
words.en: a cloth made from the flax plant

words.zh: （尤指家用的）器皿，用具
ex: And this waterproof quality of the bark made it useful for making things like cooking containers and a variety of utensils.
該樹皮的這種防水特性使得它可以用來製作烹飪器具和各種各樣的器皿。
words.en: a tool used in the house, especially for cooking

words.zh: 1. 實用的 2. 功能的，機能的 3. 運轉的
words.mnem: funct (=perform) + -ion + -al → 實用的；機能的；運轉的
ex: They were provided directly by nature and used in their natural or near-natural state, only cut, shaped, and dried into the functional forms of timbers, stone blocks, and clay bricks.
它們直接取自大自然，並以天然或近乎天然的狀態被使用，僅經過切割、塑形和乾燥處理，製成木材、石塊和泥磚等具有實用功能的形態。
deriv: function v. 運轉；起作用 n. 功能，機能，作用
malfunction n. 故障 v. 發生故障
words.en: designed to be practical and useful; working properly

words.zh: 1. 銅 2. 銅幣 3. 紫銅色
ex: This method produced detailed images on silver-plated copper.
該方法可在鍍銀的銅板上生成精細的圖像。
words.en: a reddish-brown metal

words.zh: 1. 珠子 2.（液體的）小滴
ex: Furthermore, artifacts such as metal tools, jewelry, and glass beads have been found in some of the jars.
此外，在一些罐子中還發現了金屬工具、珠寶和玻璃珠等人工製品。
words.en: a small round piece of glass or wood with a hole through it

words.zh: 1. 硬但易碎的 2. 脆弱的
ex: Bronze was expensive as well as brittle.
青銅既昂貴又易碎。
colloc: as brittle as thin glass 如薄玻璃般易碎
words.en: hard but easily broken

words.zh: v. 堆放，堆積；n. 一大堆，大量
ex: Furthermore, their regular and standardized shapes would have made them simple to stack and store.
此外，它們的形狀規則且標準，極易堆放和儲藏。
colloc: a stack of 一堆，一摞
stack up 堆積；累計，加起來
stack up against 爭勝負，較量
words.en: a pile of things on top of each other; to arrange in a pile

words.zh: 1. 複雜巧妙，高水平 2. 世故
words.mnem: soph (=wise) + -ist (=person) + -ic + -ation → 智者 → 世故 →（引申義）複雜巧妙
ex: It's really striking how they achieved such remarkable sophistication, with such basic tools.
僅用如此簡陋的工具，他們的（技藝）竟能達到如此卓越的精湛程度，實在令人驚嘆。
deriv: sophisticated a. 精於世故的；複雜巧妙的
sophisticate n. 見多識廣的人
words.en: the quality of being experienced and having good judgment; complexity

words.zh: 1. 實用的 2. 功利的 3. 實用主義的
ex: Many objects were not art in even the broadest sense and comprised utilitarian items of clothing, utensils and equipment.
許多物品即使從最寬泛的意義上說也並非藝術品，而是一些實用的東西，如衣物、器皿和工具。
deriv: utility n. 效用；公用事業
words.en: designed to be useful rather than attractive

words.zh: 1. 張力的，拉力的，抗張的 2. 可伸展的
words.mnem: tens (=stretch) + -ile → 張力的；可伸展的
ex: Metals, which had the tensile strength that masonry materials lacked, were employed in minor and supplementary ways.
金屬具備磚石材料所欠缺的抗拉強度，當時僅以次要且輔助的方式被使用。
words.en: relating to stretching or pulling

words.zh: 1.（油井的）井架，鑽塔 2. 轉臂起重機
ex: Samples were recovered using a diamond-studded drill bit that headed a great length of rotating steel pipe from a drilling derrick.
樣本通過鑲有金剛石的鑽頭採集獲得，該鑽頭位於鑽井架上一根長旋轉鋼管頂端。
words.en: a tall machine used to lift heavy objects; a frame over an oil well

words.zh: n. 1.（容器的）嘴，口 2. 水流，水柱；v. 1. 噴出，流出 2. 滔滔不絕地講
ex: The Chinese themselves adapted many specific vessel forms from the West, such as bottles with long spouts.
中國人自己也從西方借鑒了許多獨特的器皿造型，比如帶長壺嘴的瓶子。
colloc: up the spout 無可挽回；落空；在困難中
words.en: a tube through which liquid pours out

words.zh: 1. 有限的，受限制的 2. 保密的
words.mnem: re- (=back) + strict (=draw tight) + -ed → 拉回原處 → 受限制的
ex: The optimum material is steel, which incorporates a restricted amount of carbon for hardness.
最佳材料是鋼，它含有一定量的碳用於提升硬度。
deriv: restrictive a. 限制性的，約束的
words.en: limited in size, amount or range

words.zh: v. 1. 製模，塑造 2.（使）長霉；n. 1. 模型，模子 2. 霉菌
ex: The latter material was cheap, easily molded into large structural forms with great compressive but little tensile strength.
後一種材料價格低廉，易於模製成大型結構件，抗壓強度高，但抗拉強度低。
words.en: a hollow container used to shape something; a fungus

words.zh: v. 抵消，補償，彌補；a. 膠印的
ex: The widespread use of concrete would not have been possible without iron and steel to offset its low tensile strength.
如果沒有鋼鐵來彌補混凝土的低抗拉強度，混凝土就不可能得到廣泛應用。
colloc: offset printing 膠印，平版印刷
words.en: to balance something so that the effect is canceled

words.zh: v. 使工作過度，使過度勞累；n. 過度操勞，過度工作
ex: Those printers got overworked and now they all have paper jams or some other problem.
那些打印機已經超負荷運轉了，現在它們全部出現了卡紙或其他故障。
deriv: overworked a. 工作過多的，勞累過度的
words.en: to work too hard

words.zh: 1.（物）堅固的 2.（人）強壯的，健壯的
ex: Zircon is a particularly sturdy mineral.
鋯石是一種特別堅硬的礦物。
words.en: strong and not easily damaged

words.zh: 耐用的，持久的
words.mnem: dur (=last) + -able → 耐用的，持久的
ex: This material is very durable.
這種材料極其耐用。
colloc: durable consumer goods 耐用消費品
words.en: able to last a long time without being damaged

words.zh: 1. 電線 2. 細繩，粗線
ex: You can borrow my charging cord.
你可以用我的充電線。
words.en: a thick string; an electric cable

words.zh: n. 小薄片，（尤指）碎片；v. 1. 剝落 2. 使成薄片
ex: At seven sites he found that 57 percent of the flakes were right-oriented, and 43 percent left, a pattern almost identical to that produced today.
在 7 個遺址中，他發現 57% 的碎片是右側朝向，43% 是左側朝向，這一分佈模式與如今的產物幾乎完全一致。
words.en: a small thin piece of something; to come off in small pieces

words.zh: 1. 可鍛造的，易成型的 2. 易受影響的
ex: In the second half of the nineteenth century, it became possible to mass produce steel that was both strong and malleable.
在 19 世紀後半葉，人們實現了對既堅固又具延展性鋼材的大規模生產。
words.en: able to be hammered into shape without breaking

words.zh: 熔爐
ex: Unlike in the Americas, Africans had iron from a relatively early date, developing ingenious furnaces to produce the high heat needed for production.
與美洲不同，非洲在相對較早的時期就開始使用鐵器，並發明了精巧的熔爐，以產生煉鐵所需要的高溫。
words.en: a large enclosed fire used to heat buildings or melt metals

words.zh: 1. 象牙 2. 象牙製品 3. 象牙色，乳白色
ex: They were designed to take advantage of the natural shape of the ivory.
它們的設計利用了象牙的天然形狀。
words.en: the hard white substance of an elephant's tusks

words.zh: 1. 玉，翡翠 2. 玉製品，玉器 3. 翡翠色，綠玉色
ex: Made in jade, the tools were not for daily use but for displays of status and power.
這些玉製器具並非拿來日常使用，而是用於彰顯地位與權力。
words.en: a hard green stone used in jewelry

words.zh: 瓷，瓷器
ex: They created a market for Chinese silk and porcelains in the Philippines.
他們在菲律賓開拓了中國絲綢和瓷器的市場。
colloc: antique pottery and porcelain 陶瓷古玩
words.en: a hard white material used to make dishes

words.zh: 冒煙的，煙霧瀰漫的
ex: Coal gas rivaled smoky oil lamps and flickering candles.
煤氣燈可以與冒煙的油燈和閃爍的蠟燭相媲美。
words.en: filled with smoke

words.zh: 1. 不透明的 2. 難理解的，隱晦的
ex: That might be one reason that opaque bottles haven't really caught on.
這可能就是不透明瓶子未能真正流行起來的一個原因。
colloc: in an opaque manner 以難懂的方式
deriv: opaquely ad. 不透明地，無光澤地
words.en: not allowing light to pass through; difficult to understand

words.zh: 1. 較差的，次的 2. 低等的，低級的
ex: A tool may be lost or thrown out for being of inferior quality during manufacture.
在製造過程中，一件工具可能因質量欠佳而被丟棄或扔掉。
words.en: lower in quality or position

words.zh: 1. 給予，賦予 2. 捐款，資助
words.mnem: en- (=make) + dow (=give) → 給予，賦予
ex: Iron and steel, on the other hand, were expensive, difficult to shape, yet endowed with extreme tensile strength.
另一方面，鐵和鋼價格昂貴，難以成型，但卻具有極高的抗拉強度。
colloc: be endowed with sth. 生來具有（某種特性、品質等）
endow sb./sth. with sth. 認為……具有某種品質；賦予
words.en: to give a quality or ability to someone; to give money

words.zh: n. 1. 火把，火炬 2. 手電筒；v. 放火燒，縱火燒（建築物或汽車）
ex: And each time you'd have to bring along torches to light your way.
而且每次你都要帶上火把照明。
colloc: flash a torch 打手電筒
words.en: a flaming stick used for light; a flashlight

words.zh: n. 對立面，對立物；a. 相反的，對面的；prep.（表示位置）在……的對面
ex: You'd think that adding color would help make details clearer in a picture, but it's just the opposite.
你可能會認為添加色彩能讓圖片中的細節更清楚，但事實恰恰相反。
deriv: oppositely ad. 相反地，對立地
words.en: completely different; facing something across a space

words.zh: n. 1. 電影 2. 畫，圖畫 3. 照片；v. 1. 描繪 2. 構想，想像
ex: The shift from silent to sound film at the end of the 1920s marks, so far, the most important transformation in motion picture history.
20 世紀 20 年代末期，無聲電影向有聲電影的轉變，是迄今為止電影史上最重要的變革。
colloc: picture sb./sth. as sth. 把某人或某物描述成……
words.en: a painting, drawing or photograph; a movie

words.zh: n. 1. 畫筆，刷子 2. 輕拂，掠過；v. 1.（用刷子）刷，塗抹 2. 拭去，除去 3. 擦過，掠過
ex: The early painters in oil laid the paint down in thin layers with brush strokes that were so delicate that they were practically invisible.
早期油畫家用非常細膩的筆觸將顏料薄薄地塗抹在畫布上，以至於這些筆觸幾乎看不見。
colloc: brush past sb./sth. 擦身而過，掠過某人／某物
brush up on 溫習，複習
words.en: a tool with bristles for painting or cleaning

words.zh: v. 1. 反映 2. 反射，映照；n. 1. 鏡子 2. 寫照
ex: The new attention paid to improving instruments and systematizing tuning mirrored the efforts of scientists and philosophers to bring precision and uniformity to the tools and methods for scientific inquiry.
對改進樂器與系統化調音的新關注，反映了科學家和哲學家為科學探究的工具與方法賦予精確性和一致性的努力。
words.en: a glass surface that shows your reflection

words.zh: a. 1. 特指的 2. 特別的 3. 挑剔的；n. 詳情，細節
ex: For example, some might perceive specific colors when hearing particular musical notes or chords.
例如，有些人在聽到特定音符或和弦時，可能會感知到特定的顏色。
colloc: be particular about/over sth. 對某事物挑剔
deriv: particularize v. 逐一列舉，詳細說明
words.en: special or specific; fussy

words.zh: 垃圾，廢物
ex: Yeah, if only I could have been using that technique to think of all the photographs I've taken that might have ended up on the wall instead of in the trash can.
是啊，要是我當時一直用那種技巧來審視我拍過的照片就好了，說不定那些照片就不會被扔進垃圾桶，而是能掛在牆上展示了。
words.en: things that are thrown away

words.zh: 1. 喜劇 2. 幽默
ex: You know, a fast number for a chase, deep bass notes for danger, something light and humorous for comedy.
你知道，節奏明快的音樂適配追逐場景，低沉的貝斯音符烘托危險氛圍，輕快幽默的旋律對應喜劇情節。
words.en: a funny play or film

words.zh: 1. 工具，載體，手段 2. 交通工具，車輛
ex: Books became major vehicles for artistic expression.
書籍成為藝術表達的主要載體。
deriv: vehicular a. 車輛的，供車輛等使用的
words.en: a machine for transport; a means of expressing something

words.zh: 1. 方法，訣竅 2. 食譜，烹飪法
ex: But Van Eyck had a secret recipe for his oil paint.
但 Van Eyck 有一份油畫顏料的秘方。
colloc: be a recipe for 是……的秘訣
words.en: a set of instructions for cooking a dish

words.zh: 勸說，說服，使相信
ex: He persuaded the court in Baghdad to use rounded styles instead of more angular scripts in their documents.
他說服巴格達的法院在文書中使用圓體字體而不是方正字體。
deriv: persuasive a. 有說服力的，令人信服的
words.en: to make someone agree to do something

words.zh: 1.（藝術家的）工作室，畫室 2. 電影製片廠，電影公司 3. 攝影室（棚），播（錄）音室
ex: There's a sporting goods store, just a few blocks from the studio.
這裡有一家體育用品店，離工作室只有幾個街區遠。
words.en: a room where an artist works; a place for making films

words.zh: 永遠地
ex: In particular, and quite logically, the art of painting was forever changed, though not always in the ways one might have expected.
尤其合乎邏輯的是，繪畫藝術被永久地改變了，雖然並不總是以我們預期的方式。
words.en: for all time

words.zh: 雕塑品，雕像，雕刻品
ex: Unfortunately, the sculpture hall is currently under renovation.
遺憾的是，雕塑展廳目前正在翻新中。
deriv: sculptural a. 雕刻的，雕塑的
words.en: a work of art made by carving or shaping

words.zh: n. 1. 鑲邊，飾邊 2. 邊界，邊境；v. 與……接壤，和……毗鄰
ex: There was no appearance of a frame or border at the top or bottom.
頂部和底部均無畫框或邊沿。
colloc: border on sth. 與……接壤／毗鄰
words.en: the line between two countries or areas

words.zh: 1. 欣賞 2. 欽佩
ex: The painters admired the beauty of these large animals.
繪畫者們欣賞這些大型動物的美麗。
words.en: to respect and like someone or something

words.zh: a. 新奇的，精美的，別致的；n. 想像力；v. 想要，喜歡
ex: Wheatley also decided to incorporate some fancy production techniques and stage effects.
Wheatley 還決定融入一些奇特的製作技術與舞台效果。
colloc: catch/take sb.'s fancy 討某人喜歡，迎合某人的口味
deriv: fanciful a. 想像的，空想的
words.en: elaborate and decorative; to like or want

words.zh: 假裝，佯裝
ex: Before Stanislavski, acting meant forgetting about yourself and pretending to be someone else.
在 Stanislavski 之前，表演意味著忘卻自我，假裝成他人。
deriv: pretender n. 覬覦者，冒充者
words.en: to behave as if something is true when it is not

words.zh: （特定場合的）服裝，戲裝
ex: He was followed by somebody else banging on a big drum and someone dressed in a robot costume jumping up and down.
他身後跟著敲大鼓的人，還有穿著機器人服裝、蹦蹦跳跳的人。
words.en: clothes worn by actors or in a special event

words.zh: 1. 畫像，肖像 2. 詳細的描寫，描繪
ex: The new exhibit of self portraits is very popular.
這場新的自畫像展覽非常受歡迎。
deriv: portraiture n. 畫像，肖像；畫像技法
words.en: a painting or photograph of a person

words.zh: 1. 表現，描繪 2. 代表，象徵，表示
ex: Their artworks represent deities or ancestral spirits.
他們的藝術作品描繪了神靈或祖先的靈魂。
deriv: representation n. 表現；代表；陳述
representative a. 有代表性的 n. 代表
words.en: to be a sign or example of something; to act for someone

words.zh: 1. 引文，引語，語錄 2. 報價
ex: Someone might walk out on the stage and say lyric quotation.
有些演員會走上舞台，說那些抒情的台詞。
words.en: words repeated from a book or speech; a price estimate

words.zh: n. 鼓，鼓聲；v. 擊鼓
ex: If you make a constant noise inside the chamber, maybe by steadily beating drum at certain rate, a particular frequency of sound will resonate.
如果你在室內持續製造噪音，可能是以一定的頻率不斷地敲鼓，那麼某種特定頻率的噪音便會形成共振。
colloc: drum sth. up 招攬（顧客）
words.en: a musical instrument you hit

words.zh: 熟悉的，常見到的
ex: You are probably all familiar with Jazz music.
你們可能都對爵士樂很熟悉。
colloc: be familiar to sb. 為……所熟知，了解
be familiar with sth. 對……通曉，熟悉
words.en: well known; having good knowledge of something

words.zh: 技術，技能
ex: The techniques used to create cave art were advanced for the time.
用於創作洞穴藝術的技術，在當時而言是相當先進的。
deriv: technical a. 技術的；專業的
words.en: a particular way of doing something

words.zh: v. 1. 分開，劃分 2. 分裂 3.［數學］除，除以；n. 1. 分歧，不同 2. 分水嶺
ex: Cubism can be divided into two phases, analytical cubism and synthetic cubism.
立體主義可分為兩個階段，即分析立體主義和綜合立體主義。
colloc: divide and conquer 分而治之
deriv: divisible a. 可分的；可除盡的
division n. 除法；部門；分割
words.en: to separate into parts

words.zh: 1. 聲稱，斷言 2. 要求 3. 索賠
ex: A number of famous musicians have reported experiencing synaesthesia, which they claim helps them in composing and performing music.
許多著名音樂家都表示曾經歷過聯覺，他們稱這種感知能力對其音樂創作和演奏有所幫助。
words.en: to say that something is true without proof; to ask for something

words.zh: n. [ˈɪmpækt] 1. 影響，作用 2. 衝擊，撞擊；v. [ɪmˈpækt] 1. 有影響 2. 衝撞，衝擊
ex: Despite its benefits, not all music has a positive impact.
儘管音樂益處良多，但並非所有音樂都能產生積極影響。
colloc: impact crater 隕石坑，撞擊坑
words.en: a strong effect; the force of one object hitting another

words.zh: 1. 摒棄，拋棄 2. 拒絕，不同意 3. 排斥（移植的器官等）
ex: It rejected traditional perspective, presenting multiple viewpoints at once.
該藝術流派摒棄傳統透視法，採用多視角並存的表現方式。
words.en: to refuse to accept or agree with something

words.zh: 分析
ex: Actors perform best when they do not consciously analyze the character they are playing.
演員在不刻意分析自己所扮演的角色時表現最佳。
words.en: to study something carefully to understand it

words.zh: v. [kənˈtræst] 1. 形成對比 2. 對比，對照；n. [ˈkɑːntræst] 對比，差別
ex: This contrasts with classical music where compositions are typically played as written.
這與古典音樂截然不同——後者通常需要嚴格遵循樂譜演奏。
words.en: a clear difference between two things

words.zh: 排演，排練
ex: His performance before the live audience probably would have been different if there had been more time spent on rehearsal.
如果當時花更多時間排練，他在現場觀眾面前的表演可能會有所不同。
words.en: a practice of a performance before the real one

words.zh: n. 1. 一堆，一疊 2. 大廈，建築群；v. 堆起，堆疊
ex: A theater owner would just buy a pile of sheet music and musicians would play it, no matter what it was.
劇院老闆只需買來一堆樂譜，音樂家就會演奏出來，不管那是什麼曲子。
colloc: make a/one's pile 賺大錢，發財
words.en: a number of things on top of each other

words.zh: n. 1.（塗在陶器上的）泥釉 2. 失誤 3. 紙條 4. 下降；v. 1. 滑動，滑行 2. 滑倒，滑落
ex: Motifs were outlined in a raised trail of slip.
以泥釉凸紋來展現圖案輪廓。
colloc: let slip 錯過；無意中吐露；放走
slip away 逃走，悄悄溜走
deriv: slippery a.（指物體表面）滑的；狡猾的
words.en: to slide by accident; a small mistake

words.zh: a. 1. 喜劇的 2. 滑稽的，有趣的；n. 1. 喜劇演員 2. 連環漫畫
ex: Roles developed for comic potential in rehearsal may be received soberly by an audience and lose their comedic aspect entirely.
在排練中，為挖掘喜劇效果而塑造的角色可能會被觀眾平淡接受，並完全失去其喜劇色彩。
deriv: comical a. 滑稽的，可笑的
words.en: funny; a person who makes people laugh

words.zh: 1. 偏離，違背 2. 離開，出發
ex: This particular exhibit departs from the standard ways in which art from the Bauhaus is often presented.
本次特展突破了包豪斯藝術的慣常展陳模式。
words.en: to leave a place, especially to start a journey

words.zh: 管弦樂隊
ex: You know about the orchestra festival in the music building that day right?
你知道那天在音樂樓裡舉辦的管弦樂節吧？
deriv: orchestral a. 管弦樂的，管弦樂隊的
words.en: a large group of musicians playing together

words.zh: 1. 委員會，地方議會，理事會 2. 會議
ex: And then individual states throughout the country started to establish their own state arts councils to help support the arts.
之後，全國各州相繼開始設立各自的州藝術委員會來支持藝術事業。
colloc: security council（聯合國）安全理事會
words.en: a group of people chosen to make decisions for a city or organization

words.zh: 1. 傑出的，顯著的 2. 未解決的
ex: But good jazz is more than just outstanding individual performances, isn't it?
但優秀的爵士樂不僅僅是精彩的個人演奏，對吧？
words.en: extremely good; not yet paid or solved

words.zh: a. [dɪˈlɪbərət] 1. 蓄意的，有意的 2. 沉著的，從容不迫的；v. [dɪˈlɪbəreɪt] 仔細考慮
ex: The placement of the art in hard-to-reach areas suggests creating these images was a deliberate act.
藝術品被擺放在難以觸及的區域，這表明創作這些圖像是一種蓄意之舉。
deriv: deliberately ad. 故意；小心翼翼地
deliberation n. 仔細考慮，商議
deliberative a. 審議的，商議的
words.en: done on purpose; to think carefully

words.zh: n. 相遇，邂逅；v. 遇到，遭遇
ex: Early in the 19th century, encounters with Aboriginal rock art tended to be infrequent and open to speculative interpretation.
19 世紀早期，人們遇到土著岩石藝術品的情況比較罕見，大多是猜測性的解釋。
colloc: an unexpected encounter 不期而遇
words.en: to meet unexpectedly; an unexpected meeting

words.zh: 合唱隊，唱詩班
ex: I came from the choir.
我來自合唱隊。
words.en: a group of people who sing together

words.zh: n.（大規模）製造，生產；v. 1. 生產，製造 2. 編造，捏造
ex: In the seventeenth century, northern Italy was the world center for the manufacture of violins.
在 17 世紀，意大利北部是世界小提琴製造中心。
words.en: to make goods in large numbers using machines

words.zh: 1. 作曲 2. 組成，構成 3. 使鎮定
ex: Instrumental music was composed as an independent means of artistic expression.
器樂作品被創作成為一種獨立的藝術表達形式。
colloc: compose oneself 鎮靜下來，安下心來
deriv: composition n. 構造；作文；作品
words.en: to write music; to make up something

words.zh: a. [ˈæbstrækt] 抽象的；n. [ˈæbstrækt] 1. 抽象派藝術作品 2. 摘要，梗概；v. [æbˈstrækt] 1. 提取，抽取 2. 寫……的摘要
ex: Found in caves across Europe, Asia, and Africa, these artworks depict animals, human figures, and abstract symbols.
這些藝術品發現於歐洲、亞洲和非洲各地的洞穴中，描繪的內容包括動物、人類形象與抽象符號。
deriv: abstraction n. 抽象，抽象概念
words.en: existing as an idea rather than a physical thing

words.zh: 1. 堅硬的 2. 堅強的 3. 艱苦的，困難的 4. 粗暴的
ex: Most Roman pottery is light and smooth to touch and very tough, although, like all pottery, it shatters if dropped on a hard surface.
大多數羅馬陶器質地輕盈、手感光滑且非常堅韌，不過像所有陶器一樣，掉在堅硬的地面上也會破碎。
deriv: toughen v. 使堅韌，使堅強
words.en: strong and hard to break; difficult

words.zh: v. 發起，贊助，倡議；n. 贊助者，發起者，主辦方
ex: Next semester the music department will begin sponsoring a series of free concerts featuring student performers.
下學期，音樂系將開始主辦一系列由學生表演者擔綱的免費音樂會。
deriv: sponsorship n. 資助，贊助（款）；主辦，倡議
words.en: a person or company that gives money to support an event

words.zh: n. 1. 歌詞 2. 抒情詩；a. 抒情的
ex: Such music was written without consideration for the associational content traditionally provided by a set of sung lyrics.
這類音樂的創作並未考慮傳統上由一組歌詞所賦予的聯想性內容。
words.en: a short poem expressing feelings; the words of a song

words.zh: 使……分心，分散，轉移（注意力等）
ex: The audience wants to avoid distracting the actor.
觀眾希望避免分散演員的注意力。
colloc: distract from 轉移；使從……分心
deriv: distraction n. 使人分心的事，分散注意力的事
distracted a. 注意力分散的
words.en: to take someone's attention away from something

words.zh: 名聲，名望
ex: The Berlin screenings with live music helped to bring the film its wide international fame.
在柏林，配有現場音樂的放映活動，助力這部影片贏得了廣泛的國際聲譽。
words.en: the state of being known by many people

words.zh: v. [prəˈdʒekt] 1. 放映，投射 2. 計劃，規劃 3. 預測，推想 4. 投擲，發射；n. [ˈprɑːdʒekt] 1. 方案 2. 課題，項目，工程
ex: It began in the early nineteenth century with the invention of the camera obscura, a device that projected images onto a surface.
攝影史的開端可追溯至 19 世紀早期，其起點是暗箱的發明——這種設備能將圖像投射到平面上。
deriv: projectile n. 發射物，投擲物
words.en: a planned piece of work; to show an image on a screen

words.zh: 節奏，規律性變化
ex: Jazz musicians also use syncopation, which involves shifting the normal accents in the rhythm to create an unexpected and exciting sound.
爵士音樂家也會運用切分音法，這種技法通過改變節奏中常規的重音位置，從而營造一種出人意料且激動人心的音效。
colloc: the rhythm of the tides 潮汐的漲落
deriv: rhythmic a. 有節奏的，有韻律的
words.en: a regular pattern of sound or movement

words.zh: 1. 期望，預期 2. 先於……做，早於……行動
ex: Actors, even when they are well rehearsed, can never fully anticipate how well they will perform before an actual audience.
即便演員們排練充分，他們也永遠無法完全預料自己在真正的觀眾面前表現得如何。
deriv: anticipation n. 預期，期望，預料
words.en: to expect something to happen and be ready for it

words.zh: 1. 承認 2.（公開）感謝 3. 認可 4. 致意
ex: It is the quality of an actor who takes the stage and acknowledges, in some inexplicable yet indelible manner, that he or she is there to be seen.
這是一種演員登台時所展現出的特質，他們以一種難以言喻卻不可磨滅的方式，承認自己站在舞台上就是為了被觀眾看見。
words.en: to accept that something is true or exists

words.zh: 1. 把……強加於，迫使 2. 採用，推行
ex: Of course, the major criticism of that kind of restoration is that it imposes the contemporary aesthetic on the original work.
當然，對那種修復工作的主要批評在於，它將當代審美強加於原作之上。
colloc: impose a fine 處以罰款
deriv: imposing a. 使人印象深刻的
imposition n. 不合理的要求；實施
words.en: to force a rule or opinion on someone

words.zh: 修改，更改，修飾
ex: The design of the TEDs can be modified easily without affecting the way it functions.
TEDs 的設計可以在不影響其功能的情況下輕易被修改。
words.en: to change something slightly

words.zh: a. 1. 錄音的 2. 聽覺的，聲音的；n. 音頻信號，聲音
ex: The author suggested that disclaimers are more readily comprehended when presented in both audio and visual formats.
作者表示，當免責聲明以音頻和視頻形式呈現時，更容易被理解。
words.en: relating to sound that is recorded or broadcast

words.zh: 1. 推測，猜測 2. 投機
ex: We speculate that if the Dorsets feared or respected a particular animal, they were more likely to present it in a stylized way.
我們推測，如果多塞特人懼怕或敬重某種動物，他們便更有可能以一種風格化的方式來呈現它。
colloc: speculate in stocks 股票投機
deriv: speculation n. 推測，猜測；投機買賣
words.en: to form an opinion without having all the facts

words.zh: 排演，排練
ex: Roles rehearsed in all solemnity can suddenly turn comical in performance.
排練時一本正經的角色，在演出中可能會突然變得滑稽可笑。
words.en: to practice a play or piece of music before performing

words.zh: 延伸，擴展
ex: The impact of cubism extended beyond visual arts, influencing literature, architecture, and even music.
立體主義的影響超越了視覺藝術領域，影響了文學、建築，甚至音樂。
deriv: extensive a. 廣泛的；廣闊的
words.en: to make something longer or larger

words.zh: v.（使）破碎或分裂；n.（某物的）碎片
ex: Cubism fragmented objects into geometric shapes, and presented multiple angles simultaneously.
立體主義將物體拆解為幾何形狀，並同時呈現多個視角。
deriv: fragmentary a. 零碎的，片段的，不完整的
words.en: a small piece broken off something

words.zh: 進化，逐步發展
ex: Over time, Jazz continued to evolve in part by incorporating elements from other musical traditions and cultures.
久而久之，爵士樂持續演變，部分原因是它融入了來自其他音樂傳統與文化的元素。
deriv: evolutionary a. 逐漸發展的，進化的
words.en: to develop gradually over time

words.zh: 傳統的，依照慣例的，常規的
ex: This technique challenged conventional perspectives and provided a more dynamic and complex representation of the subject matter.
這種技法挑戰了傳統視角，並為研究對象提供了更具動態性與複雜性的呈現方式。
deriv: convention n. 大會；習俗；公約
words.en: following traditional methods

words.zh: 1. 投入 2. 俯衝 3. 跳水 4. 潛水 5. 驟降
ex: Today we'll dive into the world of cubism.
今天我們將深入探討立體主義的世界。
words.en: to jump into water headfirst; to go down quickly

words.zh: 暴露，揭露，曝光
ex: They required shorter exposure times than heliographs did.
它們所需的曝光時間比日光蝕刻法更短。
deriv: exposed a. 易受攻擊的，無保護的
words.en: the state of being in contact with something harmful; the amount of light on film

words.zh: 1. 提出 2. 建議 3. 打算 4. 求婚
ex: Others propose the art taught younger generations about animals.
其他人認為，這類藝術向年輕一代傳授了關於動物的知識。
words.en: to suggest a plan; to ask someone to marry you

words.zh: n. 1. 聯繫，聯結 2. 債券；v. 1.（使）結合 2. 建立關係
ex: Music makes the bonds between people more powerful.
音樂讓人與人之間的聯繫更加緊密。
words.en: a connection between people; a certificate of debt

words.zh: 1. 賦予靈感，啟發思考 2. 鼓舞，激勵 3. 激發，喚起
ex: Its emphasis on abstraction and multiplicity of perspectives inspired artists and thinkers to explore new ways of expressing ideas and interpreting the world.
它對抽象性與視角多元性的強調，啟發了藝術家和思想家探索表達思想、解讀世界的新方式。
colloc: inspire sb. to do sth. 激勵某人做某事
deriv: inspiration n. 靈感；鼓舞人心的人（或事物）
inspirational a. 啟發靈感的，鼓舞人心的
inspired a. 品質優秀的；受……影響的
inspiring a. 啟發靈感的，鼓舞人心的
words.en: to fill someone with the desire to do something

words.zh: 革新的，創新的
ex: Today we'll dive into the world of cubism, an innovative art movement that revolutionized the way we perceive and represent reality.
今天，我們將深入探討立體主義的世界，這是一場革新性的藝術運動，徹底改變了我們感知與再現現實的方式。
words.en: using new ideas or methods

words.zh: 1. 非凡的，卓越的 2. 顯著的，值得注意的
ex: Music has the remarkable ability to influence our emotions, behavior, and physical health.
音樂具有影響人類情緒、行為乃至身體健康的非凡能力。
words.en: unusual and worth noticing
