ex: So, it's been claimed that as much as 1 billion years passed between earth formation and the origin of life on this planet.
所以，有人聲稱，地球形成與這顆星球上生命起源之間相隔長達 10 億年。
deriv: form n. 表格；形式；形狀 v. 形成，組成
words.en: the process of forming something; a particular arrangement

words.zh: n. [ˈkɑːmpaʊnd] 化合物，混合物；a. 複合的；v. [kəmˈpaʊnd] 1. 混合 2. 加劇 3. 由……構成
ex: These bacteria excrete organic compounds that are then utilized by other types of bacteria.
這些細菌分泌有機化合物，隨後這些化合物被其他種類的細菌利用。
words.en: a substance made of two or more elements; to make worse

words.zh: 1. 小部分，少量 2. 分數，小數
ex: They were amazed to find that only a fraction of it, maybe 20–30%, converts into meaningful genetic information.
他們驚奇地發現，只有其中一小部分，大約 20%—30%，能轉化為有意義的遺傳信息。
colloc: fraction defective 不合格率，廢品率
deriv: fractional a. 部分的；分數的
words.en: a small part of something; a number that is not whole

words.zh: 生態，生態學
ex: Schwenk proposes a solution that encompasses observations from several fields—animal behavior, ecology, sensory physiology, and neuroanatomy.
Schwenk 提出了一個綜合了多個領域觀察結果的解決方案，這些領域包括動物行為學、生態學、感覺生理學和神經解剖學。
words.en: the study of the relationship between living things and their environment

words.zh: v. 1. 誘捕，困住 2. 使陷入困境；n. 1. 陷阱，圈套 2. 困境
ex: Subsurface bacteria do not just rely on nutrients trapped within the rock or carried there by groundwater.
地下細菌並非僅依賴於岩石中封存的營養物質或由地下水攜帶至此的營養物質。
words.en: to catch an animal; a device for catching animals

words.zh: 生物，有機體
ex: An ecosystem is a local environment with its complex community of organisms functioning together as a unit.
生態系統是指在一個區域環境中，複雜的生物群落作為一個整體協同運作。
deriv: organic a. 生物的；有機的
words.en: a living thing

words.zh: 1. 獲得，得到 2. 存在，流行
ex: Unlike plants, fungi do not photosynthesize; instead, they obtain energy by breaking down dead plants and animals.
與植物不同，真菌不進行光合作用，相反，它們通過分解死亡的動植物來獲取能量。
words.en: to get something

words.zh: n. 礁；v. 收帆
ex: This process also disrupts the symbiotic relationships between corals and algae, further harming reef ecosystems.
這一過程還會破壞珊瑚與藻類之間的共生關係，進一步損害了珊瑚礁生態系統。
words.en: a line of rocks or coral near the surface of the sea

words.zh: 演變，進化，發展
ex: Fossil evidence has been crucial in understanding the process of evolution, showing how species have changed and adapted over millions of years.
化石證據對於理解進化過程至關重要，它向我們揭示了物種在數百萬年間如何發生變化並適應環境。
deriv: evolutionary a. 進化的，逐漸發展的
evolve v. 進化，逐步發展
words.en: the gradual development of living things

words.zh: 1. 化石 2. 思想僵化的人
ex: Paleontology is the scientific study that deals with the history of life through the analysis of fossil records.
古生物學是一門通過對化石記錄的分析來研究生命歷史的科學。
words.en: the remains of an ancient animal or plant preserved in rock

words.zh: 蛋白質
ex: Scientists study bioluminescence to develop new technologies, exploring bioluminescent proteins for medical imaging and environmental monitoring.
科學家研究生物發光現象以開發新技術，他們探索將生物發光蛋白用於醫學成像與環境監測。
words.en: a substance in food such as meat and eggs that the body needs

words.zh: 營養物，滋養物
ex: Fungi play a crucial role in ecosystems, often working behind the scenes to decompose organic matter and recycle nutrients.
真菌在生態系統中發揮著關鍵作用，它們常常在幕後工作，分解有機物並循環利用養分。
words.en: a substance that living things need to grow

words.zh: 1. 現象 2. 非凡的人（或事物）（複數 phenomena）
ex: Today we're discussing the fascinating phenomenon of bioluminescence, the ability of certain organisms to produce light.
今天我們將探討奇妙的生物發光現象——即某些生物能夠產生光的能力。
deriv: phenomenal a. 了不起的，非凡的
words.en: an event or thing that can be observed

words.zh: 有益的，有利的
ex: While many fungi are beneficial, others can cause diseases in plants, animals, and humans.
雖然許多真菌是有益的，但有一些則會在植物、動物和人類身上引發疾病。
colloc: be beneficial to 對……有益的
deriv: beneficially ad. 有利地，有用地
benefit n. 益處；救濟金 v. 有助于；得益于
words.en: having a good effect

words.zh: 1. 繁殖 2. 乘，使相乘 3.（使）增加
ex: Rising sea temperatures and changing salinity levels create ideal conditions for these bacteria to multiply.
海水溫度升高與鹽度變化為這類細菌的繁殖創造了理想條件。
deriv: multiple a. 多個的 n. 倍數
words.en: to increase greatly in number; to calculate by multiplying

words.zh: 分子
ex: Bioluminescence occurs through a chemical reaction that involves the enzyme luciferase, which interacts with a molecule called luciferin.
生物發光現象通過一種化學反應產生，該反應涉及螢光素酶與名為螢光素的分子相互作用。
words.en: the smallest unit of a substance

words.zh: 1. 溶液 2. 解決辦法
ex: Pasteur demonstrated that microorganisms are present in the air and can contaminate sterile solutions.
Pasteur 證明了空氣中存在微生物，這些微生物會污染無菌溶液。
words.en: an answer to a problem; a liquid with something dissolved in it

words.zh: 顯微鏡
ex: They are tiny organisms and you need a microscope to see them.
它們是微小的生物體，需要借助顯微鏡才能看見。
words.en: an instrument used to look at very small things

words.zh: 1. 指南針，羅盤 2. 圓規 3. 範圍
ex: They seemed to be using the Sun as a compass to determine direction.
它們似乎正以太陽為指南針來確定方向。
colloc: within the compass of 在……的範圍內
words.en: an instrument for finding direction

words.zh: n. 1. 空氣阻力 2. 累贅；v.（緩慢費力地）拖，拉，拖動
ex: If these little shellfish adhere to the hull of a ship, it produces drag, slowing the vessel down.
如果這些小型貝類附著在船體上，就會產生阻力，使船只減速。
colloc: drag one's feet 故意拖拉
drag by（時間）過得很慢，拖沓地進行
words.en: to pull something along the ground; air resistance

words.zh: v. [ˈestɪmeɪt] 1. 估計，估量 2. 估價；n. [ˈestɪmət] 1. 估計 2. 估價
ex: By the late 1980s, the number of raccoons in North America was estimated to be at least 15 to 20 times the number that existed during the 1930s.
到 20 世紀 80 年代末，北美地區的浣熊數量估計至少是 20 世紀 30 年代的 15—20 倍。
words.en: to guess the amount or value of something

words.zh: 1.（動植物）已滅絕的，絕種的 2.（火山）不再活躍的
ex: By studying them, scientists can learn about the physical characteristics, behavior, and environments of extinct species.
通過研究它們，科學家能夠了解已滅絕物種的生理特徵、行為方式及生存環境。
deriv: extinction n. 滅絕，絕種，消亡
words.en: no longer existing

words.zh: 1. 遺傳而得 2. 繼承
ex: All lizards inherit these features from a common ancestor, and that's why they are classified as lizards.
所有蜥蜴都從共同的祖先那裡遺傳了這些特徵，這就是它們被歸類為蜥蜴的原因。
deriv: inheritor n. 繼承人，後繼者
words.en: to receive property or characteristics from someone before you

words.zh: 哺乳動物
ex: Seasonal migration is another form of escape, especially for large mammals or birds.
季節性遷徙是另一種逃離方式，特別是對大型哺乳動物和鳥類而言。
words.en: an animal that feeds its young with milk

words.zh: 爬行動物
ex: Now it so happens that among reptiles, like our dinosaurs, the gender of the young depends upon the temperature of the eggs.
巧的是，在爬行動物中，比如我們所說的恐龍，幼崽的性別取決於蛋所處的溫度。
words.en: an animal such as a snake that has cold blood

words.zh: 1. 傳送，輸送 2. 傳播，傳染
ex: Scientists believe that masking impedes animals' ability to transmit or receive biologically important signals that are essential for survival.
科學家認為，掩蔽會妨礙動物傳遞或接收對生存至關重要的生物學關鍵信號的能力。
colloc: transmit sth. to 把……傳遞到……
deriv: transmitter n. 傳送者，傳播者
words.en: to send something from one place to another

words.zh: 保存，保護
ex: Other heat conservation measures include huddling together, recovering heat from exhaled breath, and recovering heat from the extremities of the body.
其他的保暖措施包括抱團取暖、回收呼出氣體中的熱量，以及回收身體四肢的熱量。
deriv: conservationist n. 自然環境保護主義者
conserve v. 保存，保護；節省，節約 n. 果醬，蜜餞
words.en: the protection of nature or resources

words.zh: 1. 表達，傳達 2. 運輸，轉移
ex: This dance is used by worker bees to convey information about the location of food sources to other members of the hive.
這種舞蹈被工蜂用來向蜂巢中其他成員傳遞食物源的方位信息。
words.en: to communicate a message; to carry something

words.zh: n. 一瞥，掃視；v. 1. 一瞥，掃視 2. 瀏覽，粗略地看
ex: At first glance, the relationship between pinyon pine trees and the pinyon jay does not appear to be one of coevolution.
乍看之下，矮松與藍頭鴉之間的關係似乎並非協同進化的關係。
colloc: at a glance 看一眼；立刻
words.en: a quick look

words.zh: 忍受，容忍，容許
ex: In more temperate regions, they may have to tolerate several months of winter.
在氣候更為溫和的地區，它們可能需要忍受長達數月的冬季。
deriv: tolerant a. 容忍的，寬容的
words.en: to accept something unpleasant without complaining

words.zh: n. 1.（動、植物的）品系，品種，（疾病的）類型 2. 拉力，壓力 3. 擔憂，緊張；v. 1. 使不堪承受 2. 過濾 3. 拉傷 4. 竭力 5. 用力推（或拉）
ex: Over time, some strains of Vibrio have developed mechanisms to evade the effects of commonly used antibiotics.
隨著時間的推移，一些弧菌品種進化出了能夠避開常用抗生素作用的機制。
deriv: strained a. 憔悴的；緊張的；勉強的
words.en: a physical or mental pressure; a type of plant or virus

words.zh: 1. 隔離 2. 孤獨
words.mnem: isol (=island) + -ation → 孤島 → 隔離；孤獨
ex: In short, Pacific ecosystems were different from continental ones on account of their isolation.
簡而言之，由於其孤立性，太平洋生態系統與大陸生態系統有所不同。
deriv: isolated a. 孤立的；單獨的
words.en: the state of being separate from others

words.zh: n. 1. 袋子，一袋（的量）2. 解僱；v. 1. 解僱 2. 破壞，劫掠
ex: Chromatophores consist of tiny sacks filled with color dye.
色素細胞是由充滿色素的小袋子組成的。
colloc: hit the sack 上床睡覺
words.en: a large bag; to fire someone from a job

words.zh: n. 外部，外表；a. 外部的，外表的
words.mnem: exter (=out) + -ior → 外部，外表
ex: The cell walls can accommodate the deformations caused by water freezing on the exterior of the cell.
細胞壁能夠承受由細胞外部水分凍結冰所引起的形變。
words.en: the outside part of something

words.zh: 1. 干擾，妨礙 2. 騷動，騷亂 3. 紊亂，失調
words.mnem: dis- (=apart) + turb (=turn) + -ance → 干擾，妨礙
ex: As a rule of thumb, the further from Indonesia, the more impoverished the plant and animal life and, in consequence, the less stable and resilient in the face of disturbance.
一般來說，距離印度尼西亞越遠，動植物種類就越匱乏，因此，面對干擾時就越不穩定，恢復力也越弱。
words.en: something that interrupts or upsets

words.zh: 據說，據傳
words.mnem: sup- (=under) + pos (=put) + -ed + -ly → 在下面提出 → 假設 → 據說
ex: Organisms that were supposedly found at great depths were actually from the surface layers.
據說，在深層發現的生物，實際上來自表層。
deriv: supposed a. 所謂的，誤信的
words.en: according to what people believe

words.zh: 有困難的，成問題的
ex: These similarities had been recognized since the mid-nineteenth century, but they had been made newly problematic by Darwin's theory of evolution.
自 19 世紀中葉起，這些相似之處就已為人所知，但達爾文的進化論卻使它們引發了新的問題。
words.en: difficult to deal with

words.zh: n. 爭論，爭議，糾紛；v. 質疑，爭論
words.mnem: dis- (=apart) + put (=think) + -e → 意見不統一 → 爭論，爭議
ex: But their origin and evolution have been under considerable dispute.
但它們的起源和演化一直存在很大爭議。
colloc: beyond dispute 毫無爭議的（地）
deriv: disputable a. 有討論餘地的，可商榷的
words.en: an argument or disagreement; to question something

words.zh: 1. 彌補，補償 2. 抵消
words.mnem: com- (=together) + pens (=weigh) + -ate → 把東西放在一起衡量，然後彌補不足 → 補償
ex: For certain straight-thorned species, kudu compensated partially for their slow eating rates by spending more time gathering the leaves.
對於某些長著直刺的植物物種，捻角羚會花更多時間採集葉子，部分彌補了其進食速度慢的問題。
words.en: to make up for something bad

words.zh: 標本，樣本
words.mnem: spec (=see) + i + -men → 被看的東西 → 標本，樣本
ex: One problem with electron microscopes is that they cannot be used to study living specimens because the specimen must be held in a vacuum chamber.
電子顯微鏡存在的一個問題是它們不能用於研究活體標本，因為活體標本必須處於真空室中。
words.en: a sample taken for study

words.zh: v. 過濾（液體、光等）；n. 過濾器
ex: Organisms were filtered into the soil from ocean sediments.
生物體從海洋沉積物中濾入土壤。
colloc: filter tip（香菸的）過濾嘴；過濾嘴香菸
words.en: a device that removes unwanted things from a liquid or gas
syn: n. 1.（動、植物的）品系，品種，（疾病的）類型

words.zh: 1. 生殖，繁殖 2. 複製
words.mnem: re- (=again) + pro- (=forward) + duct (=lead) + -ion → 再生產 → 生殖，繁殖
ex: I should explain that a spore is a dormant structure formed by some organisms for reproduction or to help in survival.
我應該解釋一下，孢子是某些生物體為了繁殖或輔助生存而形成的一種休眠結構。
deriv: reproductive a. 繁殖的，生殖的
words.en: the process of producing offspring; a copy

words.zh: 進化的，演變的
words.mnem: e- (=out) + volut (=roll) + -ion + -ary → 向外轉動 →（引申義）進化的，演變的
ex: The discovery of transitional fossils helps to fill gaps in the evolutionary record.
過渡性化石的發現有助於填補進化記錄中的空白。
words.en: relating to the gradual development of living things

words.zh: 1. 合成 2. 綜合，綜合體
words.mnem: syn- (=together) + thes (=put) + -is → 放在一起 → 合成
ex: This experiment has long been recognized as a landmark for understanding a process that must have been one of the important steps in the evolution of life on Earth, the natural synthesis of amino acids.
這項實驗長期以來被視為里程碑，它有助於我們理解地球上生命演化過程中的一個重要步驟——氨基酸的自然合成。
words.en: the combining of things to make something new

words.zh: 1. 嚴酷的，惡劣的 2. 粗糙的 3. 刺耳的，刻薄的
ex: The fossil was not exposed to harsh weather conditions that could have damaged it.
這塊化石並未暴露在可能對其造成損害的惡劣天氣條件下。
deriv: harshly ad. 粗糙地；刺耳地
words.en: unpleasantly rough or severe

words.zh: 1. 演替，更迭 2. 一連串，一系列 3. 繼承，繼承權
words.mnem: suc- (=under) + cess (=go) + -ion → 跟在……之後而去 → 演替，更迭
ex: Clements and other early ecologists saw almost law like regularity in the order of succession, but that has not been substantiated.
Clements 和其他早期生態學家從演替的順序中觀察到了類似定律的規律性，但這一規律性還沒有得到證實。
words.en: a number of things coming one after another

words.zh: a. [ˈɪntɪmət] 1. 密切的，親密的 2. 私人的，隱私的 3. 幽靜怡人的；n. 密友，知己；v. [ˈɪntɪmeɪt] 透露，暗示
ex: Such intimate relationships are examples of coevolution.
這種親密關係是協同進化的範例。
words.en: very close and personal

words.zh: 真菌，黴菌（複數 fungi）
ex: Certain fungi, like the ghost fungus, glow in the dark to attract insects that help disperse their spores.
某些真菌（比如幽靈真菌）會在黑暗中發光，以此吸引能幫助傳播其孢子的昆蟲。
words.en: a living thing such as a mushroom that feeds on other things

words.zh: 1. 抵抗力，耐藥性 2. 抵抗，反對 3. 阻力
words.mnem: re- (=against) + sist (=stand) + -ance → 站在對立面 → 抵抗，反對
ex: One of the most concerning aspects of Vibrio bacteria is their increasing resistance to antibiotics.
弧菌最令人擔憂的方面之一，是其對抗生素的耐藥性正日益增強。
words.en: the ability to resist something

words.zh: 揭開，揭露
words.mnem: un- (=not) + cover (=cover) → 揭開，揭露
ex: Ongoing research aims to uncover more about how organisms produce light and why this ability evolved.
正在進行的研究旨在進一步揭示：生物體如何發光，以及這種能力為何會進化而來。
deriv: uncovered a. 暴露的，無覆蓋的
words.en: to remove a cover; to discover something hidden

words.zh: 突破，重大進展
ex: This has led to breakthroughs in several scientific fields, including genetics and biotechnology.
這促成了包括遺傳學和生物技術在內的多個科學領域的突破。
colloc: a medical breakthrough 醫學上的突破
words.en: an important discovery or achievement

words.zh: a. 潮濕的；v. 使潮濕；n. 潮濕，濕氣
ex: If the organism is living in a wet or damp environment, ice is likely to make contact with its surface when its surroundings freeze.
如果生物體生活在潮濕的環境中，當周圍環境結冰時，冰很可能會接觸到其體表。
colloc: damp off（因過於潮濕而）枯萎，腐敗
words.en: slightly wet

words.zh: 1. 腐爛，腐朽 2. 衰退，衰落
ex: The broth in the flasks did not decay and showed no signs of life, even after months.
即使過了幾個月，燒瓶裡的肉湯也沒有變質，並且沒有顯示出任何生命跡象。
colloc: fall into decay 腐爛；衰敗
words.en: to be slowly destroyed by natural processes

words.zh: 非決定性的，不確定的
words.mnem: in- (=not) + con- (=together) + clus (=close) + -ive → 不能結束的 → 非決定性的
ex: In fact, there have been several studies on the relative influence of heredity and environment, but they've been largely inconclusive.
事實上，已經有多項關於遺傳和環境相對影響的研究，但大多沒有定論。
words.en: not leading to a firm conclusion

words.zh: n. 頂點，極點，高潮；v. 達到極點（或高潮）
ex: The final stage of a succession, called the climax by Clements and early ecologists, is likewise not predictable or of uniform composition.
演替的最終階段被 Clements 和早期生態學家稱為頂級群落，它同樣不可預測，組成也不單一。
words.en: the most exciting or important point

words.zh: 1. 途徑，手段 2. 大街
ex: One hopeful avenue is biological control.
一個充滿希望的途徑是生物防治。
colloc: avenue of appeal 上訴途徑
words.en: a way of approaching a problem; a wide street

words.zh: 生物多樣性
words.mnem: bio (=life) + di- (=apart) + vers (=turn) + -ity → 生物多樣性
ex: Agroforestry helps maintain soil fertility and supports biodiversity, providing habitats for various species.
農林複合系統有助於維持土壤肥力、支持生物多樣性，並為各類物種提供棲息地。
words.en: the variety of plant and animal life in an area

words.zh: 1. 生理機能 2. 生理學
words.mnem: physio (=nature) + logy (=study of) → 生理學 → 生理機能
ex: The strategy that an organism uses depends on the structure and physiology it has developed during its evolutionary history and on the particular demands of its environment.
生物體所採用的策略，取決於其在進化歷程中形成的結構與生理機能，以及所處環境的特定需求。
deriv: physiological a. 生理的；生理學的
words.en: the way living things work; the study of this

words.zh: 1. 繼承，遺傳 2. 遺產，繼承物
words.mnem: in- (=in) + her (=heir) + it (=go) + -ance → 繼承
ex: They were the first to integrate the concepts of natural selection and inheritance.
他們是最先將自然選擇和遺傳的概念相結合的人。
deriv: inherit v. 繼承；遺傳而得
inheritable a. 可遺傳的，有遺傳性的
words.en: money or property received from someone who has died; the passing of genes

words.zh: 興旺，繁榮
ex: Despite occasional dangers, rainfall is essential for maintaining ecological balance, ensuring that plants and animals thrive in diverse climates around the world.
儘管偶有風險，降雨對維繫生態平衡至關重要——它保障著全球不同氣候條件下動植物的繁衍生息。
words.en: to grow or develop well

words.zh: v. 1. 突然出現 2. 發出砰的響聲 3. 爆裂；n. 1. 流行音樂 2. 砰的一聲；ad. 砰的一聲；a. 流行的，通俗的
ex: When you try to imagine a fungus, you'd probably picture a mushroom popping up out of the ground.
當你試著去想一種真菌時，腦海中浮現的可能是一朵蘑菇從地裡冒了出來。
colloc: pop off（非正式）突然離開，突然死亡
words.en: to make a short sharp sound; popular music

words.zh: v. 1. 繁殖，孕育 2. 飼養，培育 3. 引起，釀成；n. 品種，種類
ex: The surviving scales would then breed, and the resistant genes would become more common in the following generations.
存活下來的介殼蟲會繁殖，其抗藥性基因在後續世代中會變得更為普遍。
deriv: breeding n. 生育，繁殖；飼養
words.en: to produce young animals; a type of animal

words.zh: 1. 缺乏，不足 2. 缺點，缺陷
words.mnem: de- (=apart) + fic (=do) + i + -ency → 做得不充分 → 缺乏，不足
ex: Wildlife biologists have long been concerned that the loss of forests may create nutritional deficiencies for deer.
野生動物學家一直擔心森林的減少可能會引起鹿群的營養不足。
deriv: deficient a. 缺乏的，不足的
words.en: a lack of something that is needed

words.zh: 徹底破壞，摧毀
words.mnem: de- (=fully) + vast (=waste) + -ate → 使完全荒廢 → 徹底破壞，摧毀
ex: For example, the chytrid fungus has devastated amphibian populations worldwide.
例如，壺菌已對全球範圍內的兩棲動物種群造成了嚴重破壞。
deriv: devastating a. 破壞性的，毀滅性的
words.en: to destroy something completely

words.zh: 新陳代謝
ex: It helps the animal to adjust its metabolism.
它有助於動物調節自身的新陳代謝。
words.en: the chemical processes in a living body that produce energy

words.zh: 遷移，遷徙
words.mnem: migr (=remove) + -ation → 遷移，遷徙
ex: For animals, it influences migration, hibernation, and breeding cycles.
對於動物而言，它會影響遷徙、冬眠和繁殖周期。
words.en: the movement of people or animals from one place to another

words.zh: 臭名昭著的，聲名狼藉的
words.mnem: not (=know) + ori + -ous → 眾所周知的 →（引申義）臭名昭著的，聲名狼藉的
ex: Rats are notorious for eating just about anything that's available whether it's a plant or an animal.
老鼠以幾乎能吃任何找得到的東西而臭名昭著，無論是植物還是動物。
words.en: famous for something bad

words.zh: 寄生生物，寄生蟲
words.mnem: para- (=beside) + site (=food) → 食物旁邊 → 寄生生物，寄生蟲
ex: A second strategy is to introduce parasites that naturally control the spread of Northern Pacific sea stars in their native habitat.
第二種策略是引入寄生蟲，這些寄生蟲在北太平洋海星的原生棲息地能自然地控制其擴散。
words.en: an animal or plant that lives on another

words.zh: 1. 捕食者 2. 剝削者，掠奪者
words.mnem: pred (=prey) + -ator → 捕食者；剝削者，掠奪者
ex: It is primarily used to warn off predators.
它主要用於驅趕捕食者。
deriv: predation n. 捕食，捕食行為
predatory a. 捕食性的；掠奪性的
words.en: an animal that hunts other animals

words.zh: 生殖的，繁殖的
words.mnem: re- (=again) + pro- (=forward) + duct (=lead) + -ive → 再生產 → 生殖的，繁殖的
ex: In their native environment, male sea stars are infected by parasites that specifically attack their reproductive system.
在它們的原生環境中，雄性海星會受到專門攻擊其生殖系統的寄生蟲的感染。
words.en: relating to producing young

words.zh: n. 1. 獵物 2. 受害者，受騙者；v. 1. 捕食 2. 坑害
ex: Some deep-sea organisms use bioluminescence for hunting, emitting light to attract prey.
一些深海生物會利用生物發光進行捕獵，通過發光來吸引獵物。
colloc: fall prey to 成為……的犧牲品，深受……之害
words.en: an animal hunted by another animal

words.zh: 1. 遺骸，遺體 2. 剩餘物，殘留物 3. 古跡，遺跡
words.mnem: re- (=back) + main (=stay) + -s → 留下來的部分 → 遺骸，遺體；殘留物
ex: These preserved remains of ancient organisms are typically found in sedimentary rocks.
這些保存完好的古代生物遺骸，通常存在於沉積岩中。
deriv: remaining a. 剩餘的，剩下的
words.en: what is left of something

words.zh: 非常有趣的，引人入勝的
words.mnem: in- (=in) + trigu (=obstacle) + -ing → 使遭遇阻礙 → 複雜神祕的 → 非常有趣的
ex: Today's topic is the intriguing behavior of honey bees and their communication methods within the hive.
今天的主題是蜜蜂在蜂巢內有趣的行為及其交流方式。
deriv: intrigue v. 引起……的興趣；密謀 n. 密謀，陰謀
intrigued a. 著迷的，感興趣的
words.en: very interesting because it is strange or mysterious

words.zh: 兩棲動物
words.mnem: amphi- (=on both sides) + bi (=life) + -an → 兩棲動物
ex: This diversity has been linked to the sustainability of amphibian populations.
這種多樣性與兩棲動物種群的可持續性密切相關。
words.en: an animal that can live both on land and in water

words.zh: 草地，牧場
ex: Seagrass meadows in relatively turbulent waters tend to form a mosaic of individual mounds.
生長於相對湍急水域中的海草草甸，往往會形成一片由草堆構成的拼接狀地區。
words.en: a field with grass and wild flowers

words.zh: 仙人掌
ex: Some members of the cactus family appear to resist freezing during cool nights by radiating heat stored during the day in their thick, moist tissue.
仙人掌科的部分植物，似乎能在涼爽的夜晚通過散發白天儲存在厚實、多汁組織中的熱量來抵禦嚴寒。
words.en: a plant that grows in dry places and has sharp spines

words.zh: 授粉，傳粉
ex: Sometimes only certain insects or birds can pollinate certain plant species.
有時候，只有特定的昆蟲或鳥類才能給特定植物授粉。
words.en: to carry pollen to a plant so it can produce seeds

words.zh: 悠久的，存在已久的
ex: They solve a long-standing mystery involving fossil evidence.
他們解開了一個有關化石證據的長期謎團。
words.en: having existed for a long time

words.zh: 模仿，仿效
ex: Biomimicry is the human practice of learning from and imitating things found in nature in order to create new inventions.
仿生學是人類借鑒並模仿自然界中的事物，以創造新發明的實踐活動。
deriv: imitative a. 模仿的，仿效的
imitator n. 模仿者，效仿者
words.en: to copy the way someone behaves or looks

words.zh: 1. 準確性，精準性 2. 忠實，忠誠
words.mnem: fid (=trust) + el + -ity → 準確性；忠實
ex: To be a successful replicator, there are three key characteristics: longevity, fecundity and fidelity.
要成為一個成功的複製基因，需具備三個重要特徵：壽命長、繁殖力強、精確度高。
words.en: loyalty; the accuracy of something

words.zh: 1. 退化，降解 2. 貶低，侮辱……的人格
words.mnem: de- (=down) + grad (=walk) + -e → 下降 → 退化，降解
ex: An ecosystem could survive the loss of some species, but if enough species were lost, the ecosystem would be severely degraded.
生態系統可以在一些物種消失後繼續存在，但是如果足夠多的物種消失，生態系統將會嚴重退化。
colloc: degrade oneself by doing sth. 做某事貶低自己的身份
words.en: to treat someone without respect; to break down

words.zh: 碎裂，瓦解
words.mnem: dis- (=not) + in- (=not) + tegr (=touch) + -ate → 觸碰 → 碎裂，瓦解
ex: And the protein got degraded, you know, kind of disintegrated in there.
而且蛋白質已經降解了，你知道的，就在那裡面慢慢分解掉了。
words.en: to break into small pieces
syn: a. [ˈseprət] 單獨的，獨立的，分開的

words.zh: n.（一）卷，線圈；v.（使）纏繞，盤繞
ex: Anyway, if we examine these ends of these coils of DNA, we will find a sequence of DNA at each end of every human Chromosome, called a telomere.
不管怎樣，如果我們觀察這些 DNA 螺旋鏈的末端，就會發現每一條人類染色體的末端都有一段被稱為端粒的 DNA 序列。
words.en: a length of rope or wire wound in a spiral

words.zh: 有限的，有限制的
words.mnem: fin (=limit) + -ite → 有限的
ex: But for most species, most of the time, resources are finite.
但對於大多數物種來說，資源很多時候都是有限的。
words.en: having a limit or end

words.zh: （人或動物的）壽命，有效期
ex: But once that land is cleared, the lifespan of local plants and animals is actually probably going to increase.
但一旦那片土地被清理，當地動植物的壽命實際上很可能會延長。
words.en: the length of time something lives or lasts

words.zh: 1. 未受影響的，未被改變的 2. 真誠自然的，不做作的
words.mnem: un- (=not) + af- (=to) + fect (=make) + -ed → 沒有參與製作 → 未受影響的，未被改變的
ex: As a result, there has been a noticeable increase in Vibrio-related infections in regions previously unaffected.
因此，在此前未受影響的地區，弧菌相關感染已出現明顯增加。
colloc: unaffected by time 無始無終的，永恆的
deriv: unaffectedly ad. 自然地，真摯地
words.en: not changed or influenced by something

words.zh: 殘跡，殘留部分
words.mnem: re- (=back) + mn (=stay) + -ant → 殘跡，殘留部分
ex: Holocene sediments contain remnants of more recent plants and animals.
全新世的沉積物中含有更多近期動植物的遺骸。
words.en: a small part that is left after the rest is gone

words.zh: 微生物
ex: The human microbiome consists of trillions of microorganisms living in and on our bodies.
人體微生物組由數萬億個寄居在我們體內外的微生物組成。
words.en: a very small living thing that can only be seen with a microscope

words.zh: 紫外線的
ex: If a microbe is deep enough inside a rock, it'll be protected from ultraviolet light.
如果微生物在岩石內部足夠深的地方，它就能免受紫外線的傷害。
words.en: light with waves shorter than visible light

words.zh: 補充，重新裝滿
words.mnem: re- (=again) + plen (=fill) + -ish → 重新裝滿
ex: In spring they have to eat different plants and replenish what they've lost over the winter.
在春天，它們必須覓食不同的植物，以補充它們在冬季消耗的（營養成分）。
colloc: replenish the stock 補充庫存
words.en: to fill something up again

words.zh: v. [sərˈmaɪz] 推測，猜測；n. [ˈsɜːrmaɪz] 推測，猜測
words.mnem: sur- (=upon) + mis (=send) + -e → 送到上面來 →（引申義）推測，猜測
ex: Kramer surmised, therefore, that they were orienting according to the position of the Sun.
因此，Kramer 推測它們是根據太陽的位置來確定方向的。
words.en: to guess something from the evidence you have

words.zh: n. 機會主義者，投機取巧者；a. 機會主義的，投機的
words.mnem: op- (=near) + portun (=harbor) + -ist → 靠近港口的人 →（引申義）機會主義者
ex: A small percentage of the newcomers are opportunists whose growth is dangerously out of control.
有一小部分外來物種屬於機會主義者，其生長態勢已處於危險的失控狀態。
words.en: a person who takes advantage of any opportunity

words.zh: 1. 適應力強的，能吃苦耐勞的 2.（植物）耐寒的，能越冬的
ex: Most of the older organisms were nearly wiped out, although a few hardy species survived.
大多數古老的生物都幾近滅絕了，不過有少數頑強的物種存活了下來。
words.en: strong and able to survive difficult conditions

words.zh: 吞沒，淹沒
ex: On occasion, animals and plants have been preserved after becoming immersed in tar or quicksand, trapped in ice or lava flows, or engulfed by rapid falls of volcanic ash.
有時，動植物的遺骸陷入焦油或流沙、陷入冰層或熔岩流，或被急速下落的火山灰吞噬才得以保存下來。
words.en: to surround or cover something completely

words.zh: 1. 共生關係 2. 合作關係，互利關係
words.mnem: sym- (=together) + bio (=life) + -sis → 共生關係
ex: Symbiosis? Two different kinds of organisms live together, so it's good for one or both of them.
共生關係？兩種不同的生物體共同生活，這對其中一方或雙方都有益。
words.en: a relationship in which two living things help each other

words.zh: 危及，危害，使遭遇危險
ex: That will endanger our food chain.
那會危及我們的食物鏈。
words.en: to put someone or something at risk

words.zh: 多細胞的
words.mnem: multi- (=many) + cell (=small room) + ul + -ar → 多細胞的
ex: The origin of multicellular forms of life seems a relatively simple step compared to the origin of life itself.
多細胞生命形式的起源相比生命本身的起源來說似乎是一個相對簡單的步驟。
deriv: cellular a. 細胞的；蜂窩狀的
words.en: made up of many cells

words.zh: 微生物
words.mnem: micro- (=small) + be (=life) → 微生物
ex: Antibiotics, while effective against harmful bacteria, can disrupt the balance of beneficial microbes.
抗生素雖然對有害細菌有效，但可能會破壞有益微生物的平衡。
deriv: microbial a. 微生物的，由細菌引起的
words.en: a very small living thing

words.zh: 1. 毀滅，死亡 2. 老化
words.mnem: per- (=thoroughly) + ish (=go) → 走光 →（引申義）毀滅，死亡
ex: The Permian event has attracted much less attention than other mass extinctions because mostly unfamiliar species perished at that time.
二疊紀大滅絕事件引起的關注遠不及其他大滅絕事件，因為當時滅絕的大部分是人們不熟悉的物種。
colloc: perish the thought 打消念頭
deriv: perishable a. 易腐爛的，易變質的
perishing a. 冰冷的，酷寒的
words.en: to die or be destroyed

words.zh: 遺跡，遺物
words.mnem: re- (=back) + lic (=leave) → 遺留下的物品 → 遺跡，遺物
ex: These modern species are relics of this early evolution.
這些現代物種是早期進化的遺留產物。
words.en: an old object or custom that has survived from the past

words.zh: 1. 食肉的 2. 掠奪性的
words.mnem: pred (=prey) + -atory → 捕食的 → 食肉的
ex: As an example, plants make chemicals toxic to fungal and bacterial parasites, along with ones toxic to predatory animals.
比如說，植物可以產生對真菌和細菌類寄生物有毒的化學毒劑，以及對食肉動物有害的化學毒劑。
colloc: a predatory war 掠奪性戰爭
deriv: predator n. 食肉動物，捕食者
words.en: living by hunting other animals

words.zh: 複製品，仿製品
words.mnem: re- (=back) + plic (=fold) + -a → 反覆折疊 → 複製品
ex: A gene is a piece of biological information that gets copied or replicated, and the copy or replica is passed on to the new generation.
基因是一段可以被複製的生物信息，其複製品會遺傳給下一代。
words.en: an exact copy of something

words.zh: 長壽
words.mnem: long (=long) + ev (=time) + -ity → 長壽
ex: To be a successful replicator, there are three key characteristics: longevity, fecundity and fidelity.
要成為一個成功的複製基因，需具備三個重要特徵：壽命長、繁殖力強、精確度高。
words.en: a long life

words.zh: v. 1. 染色 2. 玷污 3. 弄髒；n. 污漬，污點
ex: All organisms contain DNA, and their presence can be revealed by dyes that either stain DNA directly or can be attached to nucleic acid probes.
所有生物體都含有 DNA，它們的存在可以通過染料檢測出來，這些染料要麼直接染色 DNA，要麼可以附著在核酸探針上。
deriv: stainless a. 純潔的，無瑕疵的
words.en: a mark that is difficult to remove; to dye something

words.zh: v. 結集，收集；n. 元帥
ex: He marshaled evidence from the distributions of fossil and living species.
他從化石和現存物種的分佈情況中搜集證據。
words.en: to gather people or things together; a senior officer

words.zh: 侵入的，侵襲的
words.mnem: in- (=into) + vas (=go) + -ive → 進來的 → 侵襲的
ex: Invasive species can displace native ones and irrevocably alter ecosystems.
入侵物種能夠取代本地物種，進而不可逆轉地改變生態系統。
words.en: spreading harmfully into new areas

words.zh: 生物量
ex: It has been estimated that the total biomass of deep subsurface organisms exceeds that of those living on, or just below, the surface.
據估計，深層地下生物體的總生物量超過了那些生活在地表或近地表的生物體的總生物量。
words.en: the total weight of living things in an area

words.zh: 相互依賴的，相互依存的
words.mnem: inter- (=between) + de- (=down) + pend (=hang) + -ent → 掛在對方身上 → 相互依賴的
ex: Two species become so interdependent that they can thrive only in each other's presence.
兩個物種變得高度相互依存，以至於只有在彼此存在的情況下才能蓬勃發展。
words.en: depending on each other

words.zh: 開始，開端
ex: This process of physiological preparation for the onset of winter cold is called frost hardening.
這種為迎接冬季寒潮來臨而進行的生理準備過程被稱為抗凍鍛煉。
words.en: the beginning of something unpleasant

words.zh: 暗示的，間接表明的
words.mnem: sug- (=under) + gest (=carry) + -ive → 拿到下面的 → 暗示的，間接表明的
ex: Plus there're some older rocks that show traces of chemicals that are highly suggestive of life.
此外，還有一些年代更久遠的岩石，它們顯示出某些化學物質的痕跡，這些痕跡強烈暗示著生命的存在。
deriv: suggest v. 建議；表明；暗示
suggestion n. 建議；暗示；跡象
words.en: making you think of something

words.zh: 1. 無菌的 2. 貧瘠的 3. 不孕的
ex: Previous experiments had shown that microbes in the air could contaminate sterile liquids.
此前的實驗表明，空氣中的微生物會污染無菌液體。
words.en: free from germs; unable to have babies

words.zh: 假設的，假定的
words.mnem: hypo- (=under) + thet (=put) + -ical → 放到下面的 → 假設的，假定的
ex: They called this hypothetical process spontaneous generation.
他們將這一假設過程稱為自然發生說。
words.en: based on an idea rather than fact

words.zh: 感受器，受體
words.mnem: re- (=back) + cept (=take) + -or → 受體
ex: This in turn could be sensed by a suitable receptor.
反過來，這可以被一種合適的受體感知到。
words.en: a nerve ending that receives signals from the environment

words.zh: 燒瓶
ex: After he heated nutrient fluids before pouring them into covered flasks, the cooled solutions were soon teeming with microorganisms.
他將營養液加熱後倒入帶蓋的燒瓶中，冷卻後的溶液很快就滋生了微生物。
words.en: a small bottle with a narrow neck used in laboratories

words.zh: 1. 發掘，挖出 2. 發現，找到
ex: Moreover, commercial fossil collectors often destroy valuable scientific evidence associated with the fossils they unearth.
此外，商業化石收藏者常常會破壞與出土的化石相關的寶貴科學證據。
colloc: unearth buried treasure 挖掘深埋的寶藏
words.en: to dig up something from the ground; to discover something

words.zh: 真菌的，由真菌引起的
ex: Still another option is to introduce a fungal parasite that specifically attacks cheatgrass.
還有另一種選擇，即引入一種專門侵襲旱雀草的真菌寄生蟲。
words.en: caused by or relating to a fungus

words.zh: 古生物學家
words.mnem: pale- (=old) + ont (=be) + o + log (=study of) + -ist → 古生物學家
ex: Paleontologists also use fossils to learn about ancient environmental conditions.
古生物學家還會利用化石來研究古代的環境狀況。
words.en: a scientist who studies fossils

words.zh: 生物的，生命的
words.mnem: bio (=life) + -tic → 生物的，生命的
ex: The number of humans, animals, insects or plants living in a given area can vary because of two kinds of factors: biotic and abiotic.
生活在某一地區的人、動物、昆蟲或植物的數量可能因兩種因素而有所不同：生物因素和非生物因素。
colloc: biotic community 生物群落；生物共同體
words.en: relating to living things

words.zh: 根除，消滅
words.mnem: e- (=out) + radic (=root) + -ate → 根除，消滅
ex: Various methods have been tried to eradicate this deadly invader.
人們已經嘗試了各種方法來根除這種致命的入侵物種。
words.en: to completely get rid of something

words.zh: 出現，到來
words.mnem: ad- (=to) + vent (=come) → 出現，到來
ex: The second development was the advent of techniques for identifying microorganisms without having to grow them in culture.
第二項進展是無需進行培養即可鑒定微生物的技術的問世。
words.en: the arrival of an important event or person

words.zh: 1. 說明，闡明 2. 照明，照亮
words.mnem: il- (=into) + lumin (=light) + -ate → 照明，照亮
ex: The study of bioluminescence not only illuminates the wonders of nature, but also opens doors to innovative scientific advancements.
生物發光研究不僅揭示了自然的奇妙之處，還為創新性科學進展開闢了道路。
words.en: to light something up; to make something clear

words.zh: n. 排放口，通風口；v. 1. 排放 2. 表達，發洩
ex: Termite mounds have a complex network of vents.
白蟻丘擁有複雜的通風孔網絡。
words.en: an opening that lets air or gas in or out

words.zh: 生物技術
words.mnem: bio (=life) + techno (=skill) + -logy (=study of) → 生物技術
ex: They were the first to encourage the use of biotechnology in agriculture.
他們是最先鼓勵在農業中使用生物技術的。
words.en: the use of living things to make products

words.zh: 1. 分解 2. 腐爛
words.mnem: de- (=apart) + com- (=together) + pos (=put) + it + -ion → 分解 →（引申義）腐爛
ex: This decomposition process is essential for nutrient cycling.
這一分解過程對養分循環至關重要。
words.en: the process of rotting or breaking down

words.zh: 細菌培養皿，孵化器
words.mnem: in- (=on) + cub (=lie down) + at + -or → 躺在上面 → 孵化器
ex: I think I'll try to phone it in, you know, call the lab and ask someone to take my experiment out of the incubator and stick it in the freezer.
我想我會試著打電話求助，你知道的，給實驗室打電話，讓別人把我的實驗樣本從培養箱裡拿出來，放進冷凍櫃。
words.en: a machine that keeps eggs or cells warm to help them develop

words.zh: v. 1. 利用 2. 套（馬），給……上挽具；n. 1.（全套）馬具 2. 背帶，保護帶
ex: As scientists delve deeper into the mysteries of bioluminescence, they may discover even more ways to harness this natural phenomenon.
隨著科學家對生物發光奧祕的深入研究，他們可能會發現更多利用這種自然現象的方法。
colloc: in harness（尤指休息或假期結束後）做正常工作
words.en: to control and use something; a set of straps for an animal

words.zh: 生物發光
words.mnem: bio (=life) + lumin (=light) + -escence → 生物發光
ex: Bioluminescence is the production and emission of light by living organisms.
生物發光是指生物有機體產生並釋放光的現象。
words.en: light produced by living things

words.zh: 不可或缺的
words.mnem: in- (=not) + dis- (=apart) + pens (=weigh) + -able → 不可或缺的
ex: Their role in nutrient cycling is indispensable for healthy ecosystems.
它們在養分循環中的作用，對於健康的生態系統而言是不可或缺的。
words.en: absolutely necessary

words.zh: v. 充分利用；n. 1. 影響力 2. 槓桿作用
words.mnem: lev (=raise) + er + -age → 用槓桿舉起 → 充分利用
ex: Understanding the diverse roles of fungi in ecosystems can help scientists develop strategies to mitigate their negative effects while leveraging their benefits for environmental sustainability.
了解真菌在生態系統中的多重作用，有助於科學家制定策略，以減輕其負面影響，同時充分利用其益處促進環境可持續發展。
words.en: the power to influence something; to use something to maximum advantage

words.zh: 1. 發展，前進，進程 2. 系列，序列，連續
words.mnem: pro- (=forward) + gress (=walk) + -ion → 發展，前進
ex: Fossil formations like the Burgess Shale show that evolution cannot always be thought of as a slow progression.
像伯吉斯頁岩那樣的化石層表明，進化並非總被視作一個緩慢的過程。
deriv: progress n. 進展，進程 v. 進步，改進；（時間上）流逝
progressive a. 先進的；逐步的
words.en: the process of developing or moving forward

words.zh: 險峻的，嚴峻的，令人生畏的
ex: A few of these spores found a toehold on the dark, forbidding rocks and grew and began to work their transformation upon the land.
一些孢子在漆黑險峻的岩石中找到了立足點，生長起來，並開始改造這片土地。
deriv: forbidden a. 禁止的，不被允許的
words.en: looking unfriendly or frightening

words.zh: 孢子
ex: If a microbe forms a spore, it has an even better chance of survival.
如果微生物形成孢子，它的生存概率會更高。
colloc: an asexual spore 無性孢子
words.en: a tiny cell produced by fungi and plants for reproduction

words.zh: 複製
words.mnem: re- (=back) + plic (=fold) + -ate → 反覆折疊 → 複製
ex: Amino acids cannot replicate themselves, and are not themselves alive.
氨基酸無法自我複製，其本身也不具有生命。
words.en: to copy exactly

words.zh: 1.（使）變異，突變 2. 轉變，轉換
words.mnem: mut (=change) + -ate →（使）變異，突變
ex: Certain kinds are mutating more rapidly than other kinds.
某些種類的突變速度比其他種類更快。
deriv: mutation n.（生物物種的）變異，突變；轉變，改變
words.en: to change into a new form

words.zh: 捕食，捕獵行為
words.mnem: pred (=prey) + -ation → 捕食，捕獵行為
ex: Many plants, however, have turned seed predation into a mechanism for seed dispersal, such as the transport and caching of seeds by squirrels, jays, mice, and ants.
然而，許多植物已將種子捕食（行為）轉化為種子傳播的一種機制，例如松鼠、松鴉、老鼠和螞蟻對種子的搬運和儲存。
deriv: predator n. 捕食者；掠奪者
predatory a. 捕食性的；掠奪性的
words.en: the hunting of animals by other animals

words.zh: 可處理的，可操縱的
ex: This second group's job is to cut the leaves down into smaller more manageable pieces that are easier for them to carry.
第二組的工作是把樹葉切割成更小、更易於處理的碎片，這樣它們搬運起來就更容易。
words.en: able to be dealt with or controlled

words.zh: 天生的，與生俱來的
words.mnem: in- (=in) + nat (=born) + -e → 天生的，與生俱來的
ex: Birds' innate bearings keep them oriented in a direction that is within 15 degrees of the Sun's direction.
鳥類天生的方向感使它們能朝著太陽方位 15° 以內的方向飛行。
words.en: existing from birth

words.zh: 使……失去方向感，使……迷惑
words.mnem: dis- (=away) + ori (=rise) + -ent → 離開太陽升起的方向 → 使……失去方向感，使……迷惑
ex: On overcast days, however, the birds were disoriented and had trouble locating their food box.
然而在陰天時，這些鳥就會迷失方向，難以找到它們的食盒。
deriv: disoriented a. 分不清方向的
words.en: to make someone lose their sense of direction

words.zh: 現存的，尚存的
ex: By the middle or late Miocene, many of the extant horses were at least superficially similar to modern horses.
到中新世中期或晚期，許多現存的馬至少在表面上與現代馬相似。
words.en: still existing

words.zh: 食草動物
words.mnem: herb (=grass) + i + vore (=devour) → 食草動物
ex: The focus of one study has been the extent to which thorns and spines impact what and how African herbivores eat.
一項研究的重點在於，（植物的）刺和棘在多大程度上影響了非洲食草動物的進食對象和進食方式。
words.en: an animal that only eats plants

words.zh: 冬眠，蟄伏
words.mnem: hibern (=winter) + -ate → 冬眠，蟄伏
ex: So in the autumn, bears are busy putting on extra-weight as they prepare to hibernate.
因此到了秋季，熊正忙於增重，為冬眠做準備。
words.en: to spend the winter sleeping

words.zh: 荒謬的，可笑的
words.mnem: pre- (=before) + poster (=after) + -ous → 前前後後反反覆覆 → 荒謬的，可笑的
ex: At the time, this idea seemed preposterous. How could a bird navigate by the Sun when some of us lose our way with road maps?
在那時，這一觀點看似荒誕至極：我們有些人拿著地圖都會迷路，那鳥兒怎麼可能靠太陽導航呢？
words.en: completely unreasonable or silly

words.zh: 1. 分泌 2. 隱匿，隱藏
words.mnem: se- (=apart) + cret (=separate) + -e → 分離開來 → 分泌
ex: ...pheromones, the chemical signals that animals secrete as messages to other animals of their species.
……信息素是動物分泌的化學信號，用於向同類的其他動物傳遞信息。
words.en: to produce a liquid substance; to hide something

words.zh: 經受，承受
ex: Ancient freshwater green algae must have evolved features that enable them to withstand extremes of temperature and periods of dryness.
古老的淡水綠藻必定進化出一些特徵以保證它們能夠耐受極端溫度和乾旱期。
words.en: to resist or survive something

words.zh: 脫水
words.mnem: de- (=away) + hydr (=water) + -ate → 脫水
ex: So, you can see the fresh water contained in the plant will be removed, and the plant will quickly lose all its water and dehydrate.
所以，你會發現植物中所含的水分會流走，並且植物會迅速流失所有水分並脫水。
words.en: to lose or remove water

words.zh: 落葉的
words.mnem: de- (=down) + cid (=fall) + u + -ous → 落到下面 → 落葉的
ex: Spartina alterniflora is a deciduous, perennial flowering plant native to the Atlantic coast and the Gulf Coast of the United States.
互花米草是一種落葉多年生開花植物，原產自美國大西洋沿岸和墨西哥灣沿岸。
words.en: losing leaves every autumn

words.zh: （使）發芽，開始生長
words.mnem: germin (=seed) + -ate →（使）發芽
ex: The seeds can germinate even a few years after falling to the ground.
這些種子即便落地數年之後，仍能夠發芽。
words.en: to start to grow from a seed

words.zh: 植物學的，植物的
ex: The Wilhelma Zoological and Botanical Gardens developed a new variety of C. taxifolia.
威廉瑪動植物園培育出了杉葉藻的一個新品種。
words.en: relating to plants

words.zh: v. 1. 發芽，生長 2. 出現，（使）湧現出；n. 新芽，嫩枝
ex: Those plants are the ones that recover from fires more quickly, because they can sprout from underground buds after a fire.
那些植物能在火災後更快恢復，因為它們能在火災過後從地下芽苞中萌發新枝。
words.en: to begin to grow; a new shoot

words.zh: 1. 稀有，罕見 2. 稀有物，珍品
ex: The rarity of commensal relationships stems from the difficulty of finding relationships that benefit one species without affecting the other.
共生關係的稀有性，源於很難找到那種僅對其中一個物種有利而不影響另一個物種的關係。
deriv: rare a. 稀有的；半生的
words.en: something rare; the quality of being rare

words.zh: n. 1. 薄膜，薄層 2. 影片，電影 3. 膠片，膠卷；v. 拍攝，錄製
ex: Another type of fossilization, known as carbonization, occurs when soft tissues are preserved as thin films of carbon.
另一種類型的石化，稱為「碳化」，即軟組織以薄碳膜的形式被保存下來。
deriv: filmy a. 薄而幾乎透明的
words.en: a thin layer; a movie

words.zh: n. 1. 地帶，地區 2. 皮帶，腰帶；v. 用帶系住
ex: He also related crustal movement and mantle convection to the evolution of mountain belts.
他還將地殼運動和地幔對流與山脈帶的演化聯繫了起來。
colloc: below the belt 不公正的
give sb. a belt 狠揍某人
deriv: belted a.（衣服）束帶的，有腰帶的
words.en: a band worn around the waist; an area with a particular feature
syn: n.（劃分出來的）地區，區域，地帶

words.zh: 1. 板狀物，大陸架 2. 架子，擱板
ex: It had been assumed that the ice extended westward from the Alaskan/Canadian mountains to the very edge of the continental shelf.
人們猜測，冰蓋從阿拉斯加／加拿大山脈向西延伸到大陸架的最邊緣。
colloc: off the shelf 現成有售的，不用訂製的
shelf life 保存期限，貨架期
words.en: a flat board fixed to a wall for things to be put on

words.zh: 1. 薄片，一大片 2. 紙張 3. 床單
ex: Now imagine these sheets of ice floating down the strait.
現在，想像一下這些大片的冰塊沿著海峽漂流而下的情景吧。
words.en: a large piece of cloth or paper; a thin layer

words.zh: 連續的，持續的，不斷的
ex: Guthrie has also demonstrated that the landscape must have been subject to intense and continuous winds, especially in winter.
Guthrie 還證明，該地貌一定受到了強烈而持續的風力作用，尤其是在冬天。
colloc: be continuous with 與……相連，是……的延續部分
deriv: continuity n. 連續性，持續性
words.en: without stopping

words.zh: 1. 論點，論據，理由 2. 爭論，爭吵
ex: It's not clear that cloud seeding is all that effective and there are reasons to question each of the arguments you just read.
目前還不清楚人工降雨是否真的那麼有效，而且我們有理由對你剛才讀到的每一個論點提出質疑。
colloc: argument with sb. about sth. 同某人爭論某事
deriv: argumentative a. 好爭論的，愛辯論的
words.en: a disagreement; a reason given to support an idea

words.zh: 1. 事件，經歷 2.（小說的）片段，插曲
ex: Over the last few decades, the term El Niño has come to be used to describe these exceptionally strong episodes and not the annual event.
在過去幾十年裡，厄爾尼諾一詞逐漸被用來描述這些異常的大型事件，而不是一年一度的規律性事件。
words.en: one event in a series; one part of a TV series

words.zh: v. 1. 標誌，表明 2. 發信號，示意 3. 表達，表示；n. 信號，標誌；a. 顯要的，重大的
ex: The eastward shift signals the beginning of an El Niño.
東移標誌著厄爾尼諾現象的開始。
deriv: signalize v. 引起關注；顯示，表明
words.en: a sign or movement that gives information; to indicate something

words.zh: v. 折疊，對折；n. 折疊的部分，褶痕
ex: The heat released at the time of Earth's formation caused rocks to fold.
地球形成時釋放的熱量導致岩石發生褶皺形變。
words.en: to bend something so one part lies on another

words.zh: 給人印象深刻的，令人讚歎的
ex: This impressive display is clearly visible in the light spectrum illuminating the forest floor.
這一令人驚歎的景象，在照亮林地的光譜中清晰可見。
words.en: making you feel admiration

words.zh: 1. 修正，修改，修訂 2. 複習，溫習
ex: Wegener revised his explanation of the process of continental drift.
Wegener 對大陸漂移理論的相關解釋進行了修改。
words.en: to change something to improve it; to study again before an exam

words.zh: v.（使）結冰，（使）凍結；n. 冰凍，冰凍期
ex: When the top layer of soil freezes in winter, it expands.
當冬季表層土壤結冰時，其體積會膨脹。
colloc: freeze out 凍死；逼走，排擠
deriv: freezing a. 極冷的；冰凍的
words.en: to turn into ice; to stop moving

words.zh: 1.（熱帶）叢林，密林 2. 危險地帶
ex: Let's say you've come across an ancient sculpture in the jungle.
假設你在叢林中偶然發現了一尊古代雕塑。
words.en: a thick tropical forest

words.zh: v. 1. 開礦，採礦 2. 埋雷于，布雷於；n. 1. 礦，礦井 2. 地雷，水雷；pron.（I 的所有格）我的（東西）
ex: So that's the reason people mine rocks that contain a lot of Phosphorus to help with agriculture?
所以，那就是人們開採富含磷元素礦石來幫助農業發展的原因？
words.en: to dig minerals out of the ground; a place where minerals are dug

words.zh: n. 北極，北極地區；a. 北極的，北極地區的
ex: Others may have a cold climate with lots of snow, like the Arctic.
其他地區可能擁有寒冷多雪的氣候，比如北極地區。
words.en: the region around the North Pole

words.zh: 海岸線
ex: Most species are located in the waters along coastlines.
大多數物種生活在沿海岸線的水域。
words.en: the outline of a coast

words.zh: 1. 含沙的，沙質的 2. 沙褐色的，淺棕色的
ex: If it wants to have a smooth texture, it flattens out the papillae, so it can acquire a smooth texture to blend in with the sandy bottom of the sea.
如果想擁有光滑的肌理，它就會把乳突壓平，這樣就能擁有與沙質海底相融合的光滑肌理了。
colloc: sandy soil 砂土，沙質土壤
words.en: covered with or made of sand

words.zh: v. 把……稱為，把……叫作；n. 1. 術語，詞語 2. 學期 3. 期限 4.（~s）條款
ex: But the Maya homeland lies more than sixteen hundred kilometers from the equator, at latitudes 17 to 22 degrees north, in a habitat termed a "seasonal tropical forest."
但瑪雅人的故土距離赤道 1600 多千米，位于北緯 17°—22° 之間一個被稱為「季節性熱帶森林」的地方。
colloc: in terms of/in...terms 談及，就……而言
words.en: a word or phrase; a period of time in school

words.zh: n. 1. 景觀，風景 2. 風景畫；v. 美化……的景觀
ex: These highly intelligent creatures play an important role in their ecosystems, shaping the landscape, creating access to moisture, and spreading seeds.
這類高智商生物在其所處的生態系統中扮演著重要角色，它們既能塑造地貌，又能創造獲取水分的途徑，還能傳播種子。
words.en: all the features of an area of land

words.zh: 1. 次生的，繼發性的 2. 次要的，輔助的 3. 中學的，中等教育的
ex: Clay minerals are called secondary minerals, because their composition has been altered.
黏土礦物被稱為次生礦物，因為它們的成分已經改變。
words.en: less important than the main thing; relating to school after primary

words.zh: n. 1. 地下通道，隧道 2.（動物的）洞穴；v. 挖隧道
ex: As I said earlier, the Northumberland Strait, a big unobstructed area, acts like a natural wind tunnel.
正如我之前所說，諾森伯蘭海峽是一大片開闊無阻的區域，就像一個天然的風洞。
words.en: a passage under the ground

words.zh: a. [ˈfriːkwənt] 頻繁的，經常發生的；v. [friːˈkwent] 經常去，時常出入
ex: It would seem that they are becoming more frequent.
該現象似乎變得越來越頻繁。
words.en: happening often

words.zh: 深度，厚度
ex: For instance, deep sea fish use bioluminescence to attract prey or communicate with potential mates in the dark ocean depths.
例如，深海魚類會利用生物發光在漆黑的海洋深處吸引獵物，或與潛在配偶進行交流。
colloc: in the depth of 在……裡面
words.en: how deep something is

words.zh: n. 1. 斜坡，斜面 2. 傾斜，斜度；v.（使）傾斜
ex: A hill or mountain has a steep slope.
小山或大山都有陡峭的山坡。
colloc: slope failure 邊坡破壞；滑坡
words.en: a surface that goes up or down

words.zh: v.（使）伸展，（使）延長；n. 1. 一段連續的時間或空間 2. 伸展，舒展
ex: Earth's surface expanded and stretched because the planet had become hot.
由於地球溫度升高，其表面發生了擴張和拉伸。
colloc: at a stretch 一口氣地，不休息地
stretch oneself 伸懶腰；盡最大的努力
words.en: to pull something to make it longer

words.zh: 1. 合理的，合乎邏輯的 2. 邏輯（上）的
ex: Because most materials contract as they cool, it seemed logical to assume that Earth had been contracting as it cooled, too.
由於大多數物質冷卻時會收縮，因此假設地球在冷卻過程中也一直在收縮似乎是合乎邏輯的。
words.en: following good reasoning

words.zh: 1. 停留 2. 安家，定居 3. 解決 4. 決定 5.（使）平靜下來
ex: And the sulfur dioxide settled in the clouds fell to the land in droplets of rain and sank into the soil.
停留在雲層中的二氧化硫隨雨水降落到地表，並滲進土壤中。
colloc: settle down 定居下來；靜下心來
words.en: to decide something; to make your home somewhere

words.zh: 例外
ex: Generally speaking, the interiors of plates are geologically uneventful. However, there are exceptions.
一般來說，板塊內部在地質上是相對穩定的，但也有例外。
colloc: with the exception of 除……之外
without/no exception 無一例外，一律
deriv: exceptional a. 傑出的；例外的；異常的
words.en: something that is not included in a general rule

words.zh: 郊區
ex: The suburbs and surrounding countryside experienced average minimum temperatures that were as much as 3.3°C lower.
郊區及周邊鄉村的平均最低氣溫要低 3.3°C 之多。
colloc: an industrial suburb 城郊工業區
words.en: an area on the edge of a city

words.zh: n. 1. 泉，泉水 2. 春天；v. 1. 蹦，跳，躍 2. 突然活動
ex: The aquifer's water comes from underground springs.
蓄水層的水來自地下泉水。
words.en: a season; a place where water comes out of the ground; to jump

words.zh: v. 與……相匹敵，比得上；n. 競爭對手
ex: Indeed, they have been called the marine version of the tropical rain forest, rivaling their terrestrial counterparts in both richness of species and biological productivity.
事實上，它們被稱為海上的熱帶雨林，在物種豐富度和生物生產力方面都能與陸地上的熱帶雨林相媲美。
colloc: a rival in love 情敵
words.en: a person or thing competing with another

words.zh: 弧形的，呈彎曲狀的
ex: Anaximander is credited with drawing up the first world map of the Greeks and also with recognizing that Earth's surface was curved.
Anaximander 被歸功為繪製了希臘人的第一幅世界地圖，並確認了地球表面是弧形的。
words.en: having a bent or rounded shape

words.zh: 使孤立，使隔離
ex: Many factors can isolate a population geographically.
許多因素可以在地理上孤立一個種群。
colloc: isolate sb./sth. from 把某人或某物從……中分離出來
deriv: isolated a. 孤立的，分離的；與世隔絕的
isolation n. 隔離；孤立狀態
words.en: to keep one person or thing away from others
syn: a. [ˈseprət] 單獨的，獨立的，分開的

words.zh: 融化，熔化
ex: The ice would melt in warm weather and would flood the strait.
冰會在溫暖的天氣裡融化，進而淹沒海峽。
colloc: melt into 溶解成；消散在……中
words.en: to change from solid to liquid because of heat

words.zh: 假說，假設
ex: The most serious challenge to the volcanic-formation hypothesis was made in 1893 by the geologist G. K. Gilbert.
1893 年，地質學家 G. K. Gilbert 對火山形成假說提出了最嚴峻的挑戰。
deriv: hypothetical a. 假設的，假定的
words.en: an idea suggested as an explanation

words.zh: 破壞，毀滅
ex: They are usually the primary cause of the destruction that can result from earthquakes affecting densely populated areas.
它們通常是導致人口稠密地區遭受地震破壞的主要原因。
deriv: destructive a. 破壞性的，毀滅性的
words.en: the act of destroying something

words.zh: 1. 假定，設想 2. 承擔，就職 3. 假裝
ex: They assume that there was a change in global climate.
他們假定全球氣候發生了變化。
colloc: assume full responsibility 負完全責任
words.en: to suppose that something is true; to take on responsibility

words.zh: n. 1. 裂縫，裂紋 2.（突然的）爆裂聲；v.（使）爆裂，裂開
ex: They produce the cracks and fissures in the rock.
它們在岩石中造成裂縫和裂隙。
words.en: a thin line on a broken surface; to break without separating

words.zh: n.（劃分出來的）地區，區域，地帶；v. 將……劃分
ex: They think that a new subduction zone might occur at the western edge of the Atlantic Ocean.
他們認為在大西洋的西部邊緣可能會出現一個新的俯衝帶。
colloc: zone out 走神；失去知覺
words.en: an area with a particular use or feature

words.zh: n. 1. 水流，氣流 2. 趨勢，潮流；a. 1. 當今的，現行的 2. 流通的
ex: This results in a warm surface current that moves east to west at the equator.
這就形成了一股在赤道處由東向西移動的表層暖流。
words.en: the flow of water, air or electricity; happening now

words.zh: a. 1. 獨特的，特有的 2. 典型的；n. 特徵，特點
ex: Thus prairies and tundra regions, which have characteristic vegetations, also have characteristic soils.
因此，具有特色植被的草原和苔原地區，也擁有特色的土壤。
deriv: characterize v. 描述（人或物的）特性；以……為特徵
words.en: a typical feature; typical of someone or something

words.zh: 走廊，通道
ex: What used to be one big area of rock is now sort of two smaller areas of rock with a corridor in between.
曾經一大片的岩石區域，如今變成了兩塊較小的岩石區域，中間由一條通道隔開。
words.en: a long narrow passage in a building

words.zh: 礦物，礦物質
ex: Rather than consuming other food available, chemotrophs process some minerals they find in rocks to obtain the nutrients they need.
化能營養生物不依賴其他現有食物，而是通過分解岩石中的部分礦物質來獲取所需營養。
deriv: mine n. 礦，礦井 v. 開礦，採礦
words.en: a natural substance such as coal or salt found in the earth

words.zh: 表明，跡象，象徵
ex: So the question was, were these zircon crystals an indication that the Earth started cooling earlier than we thought?
所以問題在於，這些鋯石晶體是否表明地球開始冷卻的時間比我們之前認為的要早？
deriv: indicate v. 表明；暗示；（儀器等）指示
indicative a. 標示的；陳述的
words.en: a sign that shows something

words.zh: 迅速的，快速的
ex: The runoff of rainwater is more rapid in rural areas than it is in urban areas.
農村地區的雨水徑流速度比城市地區更快。
words.en: happening very quickly
syn: a. 快的，迅速的，敏捷的

words.zh: 以前，早先
ex: With continued cooling, the original continents became unstable and collapsed to form the next generation of ocean floor, and what had formerly been ocean now became dry land.
隨著持續降溫，原始大陸變得不穩定並塌陷，形成了新一代的洋底，而曾經的海洋如今變成了陸地。
deriv: former a. 以前的；前者的
words.en: in the past

words.zh: 1. 猛烈的，強烈的 2. 暴力的
ex: Why does the professor mention the violent processes that the Earth underwent during its early history?
教授為什麼要提及地球在其早期歷史中經歷的劇烈過程呢？
deriv: violently ad. 激烈地；猛烈地
words.en: using physical force to hurt people; very strong

words.zh: 領土，領域，版圖，範圍
ex: It lives out in the open on mud flats and has a very limited territory.
它棲息在開闊的泥灘上，領地範圍非常有限。
deriv: territorial a. 領土的，領域的
words.en: an area of land under the control of a country

words.zh: a. 1. 陡的，陡峭的 2.（價格等）過高的，不合理的；v. 浸泡，沉浸
ex: The hill is not this steep.
這座山沒有這麼陡。
words.en: rising or falling at a sharp angle

words.zh: 熱帶的
ex: Vibrio species thrive in warm, salty environments, making them particularly prevalent in tropical and subtropical regions.
弧菌屬物種在溫暖、鹹水環境中繁殖旺盛，因此在熱帶和亞熱帶地區尤為普遍。
deriv: tropic n. 回歸線；熱帶地區
words.en: relating to the hottest parts of the world

words.zh: 1. 邊緣 2. 餘地
ex: They commonly grow near stream channels, springs, or on the margins of lakes.
這類植物通常生長在河道、泉水附近，或是在湖泊邊緣。
colloc: margin of error 誤差幅度
deriv: marginal a. 不重要的，邊緣的
words.en: the edge of something

words.zh: 地質學
ex: One of the central scientific questions of nineteenth-century geology was the origin of mountains.
19 世紀地質學的核心科學問題之一是山脈的起源。
words.en: the study of the rocks and soil that form the earth

words.zh: 熔岩
ex: Magma rises up from the mantle and erupts as lava on the surface.
岩漿從地幔上升，並在地表噴發成為熔岩。
words.en: hot liquid rock that comes out of a volcano

words.zh: 赤道
ex: High mountains are another place where there is permanent snow and ice, even at the equator.
高山是另一處存在永久性冰雪的地方，即便在赤道地區也是如此。
deriv: equatorial a. 赤道的，近赤道的
words.en: an imaginary line around the middle of the earth

words.zh: 1. 多山的 2.（數量或規模）巨大的，龐大的
ex: It indicates that the mechanism by which all mountainous areas on Earth formed was the same.
這表明地球上所有山地地區形成的機制都是相同的。
colloc: a mountainous country 一個多山的國家
words.en: having many mountains

words.zh: 不穩固的，不結實的，易變的
ex: The polar air mass becomes unstable.
極地氣團變得不穩定。
colloc: unstable situation 不安定的局面
words.en: likely to change suddenly

words.zh: a. 最大的，最高的，最多的；n. 最大量，最大限制，極大值
ex: The maximum differences in temperature between neighboring urban and rural environments are called the heat-island intensity for that region.
城區和毗鄰的鄉村之間的最大溫差被稱為該區域的熱島強度。
deriv: maximal a. 最大的，最高的
maximize v. 使……增至最大限度
words.en: the greatest amount possible

words.zh: v. 剝皮，削皮，剝落；n. 果皮，外皮
ex: The strata appeared to "have been peeled back from the area of the crater, somewhat like petals of a flower blossoming."
這些地層看似「從隕石坑區域向外剝離，有點像綻放花朵的花瓣」。
words.en: to remove the skin of fruit; to come off in thin layers

words.zh: n. 高地，高原；a. 高地的，高原的
ex: Iceland has virtually no trees to hold down soil and so there's been a lot of erosion, especially erosion of soil from the highlands to lower coastal areas.
冰島幾乎沒有任何樹木來固定土壤，因此出現了大量的土壤侵蝕現象，尤其是土壤從高地向地勢較低的沿海地區流失。
words.en: an area of land that is high above sea level

words.zh: 火山的
ex: Volcanic eruptions can create islands, mountains, and other landforms, but they can also be destructive, causing damage to nearby areas.
火山噴發既能形成島嶼、山脈及其他地形，也可能具有破壞性，對周邊地區造成損害。
words.en: relating to volcanoes

words.zh: 噴發，爆發
ex: It probably derives from shallow water-rich magma, a sign that an eruption may be brewing.
這可能源於富含水分的淺層岩漿，預示火山噴發即將發生。
words.en: a sudden release of lava, ash or gas from a volcano

words.zh: 1. 塌方，滑坡 2. 一方占絕對優勢的選舉
ex: You know, some already, like landslides which are dramatic and might get attention in the news.
要知道，有些災害大家本就熟悉，比如山體滑坡，很引人注目，還可能會登上新聞。
words.en: a sudden fall of earth and rocks down a slope

words.zh: 峽谷
ex: Living patterns changed in the 13th century, with large numbers of people moving into large communal dwellings called pueblos, often constructed at the edges of canyons.
13 世紀，人們的居住形態發生改變，大量人口移居到被稱為「普韋布洛」的大型群居村落，這類村落通常建造在峽谷邊緣。
words.en: a deep narrow valley with steep sides

words.zh: 懸崖，峭壁
ex: It consisted mostly of channels carved into cliffs.
它主要由開鑿在懸崖上的水道構成。
words.en: a high steep face of rock

words.zh: n. 1. 覆蓋物，覆蓋層 2. 毯子；v. 覆蓋；a. 通用的
ex: But in the countryside materials have a significantly lower heat capacity because a vegetative blanket prevents heat from easily flowing into and out of the ground.
但是在鄉村，（儲存能量的）物質熱容更低，因為植被覆蓋層會阻止熱量輕易流入和流出地表。
colloc: wet blanket 掃興的人或事
words.en: a thick cover for a bed; a layer that covers a surface

words.zh: 1.（物體某部的）金屬管 2. 桶
words.mnem: barr (=bar) + -el → 棒子 →（物體某部的）金屬管
ex: As they drilled into the core and deepest part of the Mediterranean basin, the scientists took solid, shiny, crystalline salt from the core barrel.
當科學家鑽探到地中海盆地中心最深區域時，從岩芯管中取出了堅硬、閃光的結晶鹽。
words.en: a large round container; the tube of a gun

words.zh: 邊界，分界線
words.mnem: bound (=bind) + -ary → 捆綁，劃定範圍 → 邊界
ex: The boundaries between continents and oceans were most affected by the pressure, and so mountains began to form along continental margins.
大陸與海洋之間的邊界受壓力影響最為顯著，於是山脈開始沿著大陸邊緣隆起。
words.en: a line that marks the limit of something

words.zh: 池塘
ex: For example, a pond in hilly country that maintains a steady water level all through a dry summer in spite of having no streams flowing into it must obviously be seepage dominated.
比如，丘陵地區的一處池塘，即使在整個乾旱的夏天沒有溪水匯入，仍能保持穩定的水位，那麼顯然它是一個滲流主導型池塘。
words.en: a small area of still water

words.zh: 內部（的）
words.mnem: inter- (=among) + -ior → 在……中 → 內部（的）
ex: Most volcanoes that occur in the interiors of plates are believed to be produced by mantle plumes.
大多數發生在板塊內部的火山，被認為是由地幔柱造成的。
words.en: the inside part of something

words.zh: 1.（波濤）洶湧 2. 激增
words.mnem: surg (=rise) + -e → 激增 →（波濤）洶湧
ex: But sometimes, they experience surges, and during these surges, in some places, they can move at speeds as high as 7,000 meters per year.
但有時它們（冰川）會遇到洶湧的波浪，在湧動期間，部分區域的移動速度可高達每年 7000 米。
colloc: a surge of anger/pity 一陣怒氣／憐憫
words.en: a sudden strong movement or increase

words.zh: 密度，濃度
ex: Earth is composed of concentric shells of increasing density from crust to core.
地球由從地殼到地核密度不斷增大的同心圈層構成。
words.en: how closely packed something is

words.zh: 1. 大部分，主體 2. 大體積，大量
ex: The bulk of Earth's crust, however, consists of igneous rocks, such as granite and basalt, which are solidified from molten magma.
然而，地殼的主體由火成岩構成，比如花崗岩和玄武岩，它們是由熔融岩漿凝固而成的。
words.en: the main part; a large amount

words.zh: 1. 描述（人或物）的特性，描繪 2. 以……為特徵
ex: Guthrie applied the term "mammoth steppe" to characterize this landscape.
Guthrie 用「猛獁象草原」這個詞來描述這一景觀。
deriv: characteristic a. 獨特的，典型的 n. 特徵，特點
words.en: to describe the qualities of something; to be typical of something

words.zh: 1. 結晶（體）2. 水晶
ex: And that water vapor condenses directly into ice, into an ice crystal.
水蒸氣直接凝結成冰，形成冰晶。
colloc: crystal clear 清澈透明的；顯而易見的
deriv: crystalline a. 水晶製的；透明的
words.en: a clear mineral; a small regular piece of a solid substance

words.zh: 1. 提及，援引（某理論等作為支持）2. 提出 3. 使產生，喚起 4. 祈求（幫助）5. 激活
words.mnem: in- (=on) + vok (=call) + -e → 大聲呼喚 → 提及，援引
ex: Most of these invoke a change in global climate as an important factor, perhaps the overriding factor.
其中大多數都提及將全球氣候變化視為一個重要因素，甚至可能是首要因素。
words.en: to mention a law or idea to support an argument; to call on someone

words.zh: 堆積，積累，積聚
ex: The slowing of wave action and currents means that seagrass beds tend to accumulate sediment.
波浪作用和洋流的減弱意味著海草床容易堆積沉積物。
words.en: to gradually get more and more of something

words.zh: 1. 地極 2. 柱，桿 3. 磁極，電極
ex: The Sun's energy is more intense near the equator than it is near the poles.
太陽的能量在赤道附近比在兩極附近更強烈。
deriv: polestar n. 北極星；指導原則
words.en: either end of the earth's axis; a long thin post

words.zh: （使）合併，（使）融合
ex: These flow features are extensive systems—sometimes hundreds of kilometers in total length—of interconnecting, twisting channels that seem to merge into larger, wider channels.
這些流動特徵是龐大的系統——有時總長可達數百千米，由相互連通、相互交錯的水道構成——似乎會匯入更加寬大的水道。
deriv: merger n.（機構或企業的）合併，歸併
words.en: to combine together

words.zh: v. 1.（用手指）擠壓，捏 2.（液體）榨出，擠出，擰出 3.（時間或空間）擠進，塞入 4.（金錢）緊縮，削減 5. 勒索，榨取；n. 1. 擠，擠壓 2. 榨出的汁 3. 擁擠
ex: This piling up of air over the city then slowly rises, much like toothpaste does when its tube is squeezed.
這些堆積在城市上空的空氣隨後慢慢上升，就像擠壓牙膏管時牙膏從中湧出一般。
colloc: put the squeeze on 對……施加壓力
squeeze in/into 榨出／擠入，硬塞進……
squeeze through 擠過，勉強通過
words.en: to press something firmly

words.zh: 浸泡，浸透，濕透
ex: Water leaves a lake via outflowing rivers, by soaking into the bed of the lake, and by evaporation.
湖泊中的水經外流河排出，滲透進河床，並通過蒸發作用流失。
colloc: soak up the sun 沐日光浴
words.en: to put something in liquid for a time

words.zh: n. 1. 潮，潮汐 2. 潮流，趨勢；v. 順潮水漂浮
ex: When the tides go in and out, the moving water flows through tunnels in the barrage.
當潮水漲落時，流動的水流經攔河壩中的隧道。
colloc: at high/low tide 在高／低潮時
words.en: the rise and fall of the sea

words.zh: n. [ˈdɪstʃɑːrdʒ] 1. 放電 2. 流出，排放 3. 免職，出院，退伍；v. [dɪsˈtʃɑːrdʒ] 1. 排放，流出 2. 發力，放電 3. 准許離開，解僱 4. 釋放 5. 履行
ex: Electrical discharges took place deep below early Earth's surface.
放電現象發生於早期地表深處的位置。
words.en: to let a liquid or gas flow out; to allow someone to leave

words.zh: n. 1. 熱帶，熱帶地區 2. 回歸線；a. 熱帶的
ex: The tropics contain many more species overall than an equivalent area at the higher latitudes.
熱帶地區的物種總數要比高緯度同等面積區域的多得多。
words.en: either of two lines of latitude north and south of the equator

words.zh: 退化，衰退，惡化
words.mnem: deterior (=worse) + -ation → 退化，衰退，惡化
ex: A cycle of progressive surface deterioration is established.
造成了（土壤）表層不斷退化這一惡性循環。
words.en: the process of becoming worse

words.zh: 緯度
words.mnem: lat (=wide) + -itude → 寬度 → 緯度
ex: Climate is influenced by latitude, altitude, and proximity to water bodies.
氣候受緯度、海拔高度，以及與水體的鄰近程度影響。
words.en: the distance of a place north or south of the equator

words.zh: 1. 灰，灰燼 2. 骨灰
ex: Volcanoes are openings in Earth's crust through which molten rock, ash, and gases are ejected.
火山是地殼上的開口，熔岩、火山灰和氣體通過這些開口噴出。
deriv: ashen a. 灰色的；蒼白的
ashy a. 灰色的；被灰覆蓋的
words.en: the grey powder left after something has burned

words.zh: a. 1. 海的，海產的 2. 海事的，海運的；n.（尤指美國或英國皇家）海軍陸戰隊士兵
words.mnem: mar (=sea) + -ine → 海的，海產的
ex: Finding marine fossils in landlocked areas, for example, suggests that these regions were very likely underwater once upon a time.
例如，在內陸地區發現海洋生物化石，表明這些區域曾經很可能是一片水域。
words.en: relating to the sea

words.zh: 沿海的，靠近海岸的
ex: Vibrio bacteria are a type of bacteria commonly found in coastal waters.
弧菌是一種常見於沿海水域的細菌。
words.en: near or along a coast

words.zh: 潮濕的，多濕氣的
ex: Properly speaking, tropical rainforests grow in high-rainfall equatorial areas that remain wet or humid all year round.
準確地說，熱帶雨林生長在高降雨量的赤道地區，那裡終年都是濕潤或潮濕的狀態。
deriv: humidify v. 使潮濕，使濕潤
words.en: damp and warm in the air

words.zh: 梯田形的
ex: Proponents point to features such as the terraced "beaches" shown in one image, which could conceivably have been left behind as a lake or ocean evaporated and the shoreline receded.
支持者們指出了一些特徵，比如在一張圖片中所顯示的梯田形「海灘」，可能是在湖泊或海洋蒸發、海岸線後退後形成的。
words.en: arranged in flat steps on a hillside

words.zh: 1. 大氣的，大氣層的 2. 激動人心的
words.mnem: atmo (=vapor) + spher (=sphere) + -ic → 地球上的氣體 → 大氣的
ex: Another thing about atmospheric carbon—it keeps us from freezing.
關於大氣碳，還有另一點——它能防止我們陷入冰凍狀態。
colloc: atmospheric pressure 大氣壓力，大氣壓強
words.en: relating to the air around the earth

words.zh: 1. 乾旱的，乾燥的 2. 乏味的，毫無新意的
ex: The city also featured a complex system to manage water, including dams, cisterns, and water channels that allowed it to thrive in the arid region.
這座城市還具備一套複雜的水利管理系統，包括水壩、蓄水池和水渠，這些設施使其得以在乾旱地區繁榮發展。
words.en: very dry

words.zh: n. 爬行，蠕動；v. 1. 躡手躡腳地走 2. 爬行
ex: Avalanches and snow creep can damage or destroy them.
雪崩和積雪蠕動可能會損毀或摧毀它們。
deriv: creepy a. 令人毛骨悚然的
words.en: to move slowly and quietly

words.zh: 1.（風雨等）腐蝕，侵蝕 2. 逐步削弱（權力或信心等）
words.mnem: e- (=out) + rode (=gnaw) → 咬 → 腐蝕，侵蝕
ex: Limestone erodes pretty quickly in the presence of any kind of acid.
石灰岩在任何一種酸的作用下，都會相當快速地被侵蝕。
words.en: to wear away gradually

words.zh: 放射性的
words.mnem: radio (=ray) + act (=act) + -ive → 射線活躍的 → 放射性的
ex: He convinced Wegener that the mantle contained a great deal of radioactive heat.
他使 Wegener 相信地幔中蘊含著大量放射性熱。
words.en: giving off energy in the form of rays

words.zh: 平衡
words.mnem: equi- (=equal) + libr (=balance) + -ium → 平衡
ex: In the Indus plain, the movement of saline (salty) groundwater has still not reached equilibrium after 70 years of being tapped.
在印度河平原上，含鹽地下水的運移在歷經 70 年開採後仍未達到平衡。
words.en: a state of balance

words.zh: v.（使）腐爛，（使）腐朽；n. 腐爛，腐敗變質
ex: In the wetter eastern United States, dead trees rot away more quickly than in the drier West.
在較為濕潤的美國東部，枯樹腐爛的速度比在較為乾燥的西部更快。
words.en: to decay naturally

words.zh: v.（使）斷裂，（使）破裂；n.（尤指骨頭）斷裂
words.mnem: fract (=break) + -ure →（使）斷裂
ex: Others break into splinters or fibers, but most fracture irregularly.
其他會斷裂成碎片或纖維狀，但大多數的斷裂並無規則。
words.en: a break in a bone or rock

words.zh: 1.（使）蒸發 2. 消失
words.mnem: e- (=out) + vapor (=steam) + -ate →（使）蒸發
ex: Rural areas experience greater problems when rainwater evaporates than urban areas do.
當雨水蒸發後，農村地區遭遇的問題比城市地區更為嚴重。
words.en: to change from liquid into gas

words.zh: 1. 高度，海拔 2. 高處，高地
words.mnem: alt (=high) + -itude → 高度，海拔
ex: That's why it's easier to breathe at lower altitudes.
這就是為什麼在低海拔地區呼吸更為容易。
colloc: in one's altitude 自高自大
words.en: the height of something above sea level

words.zh: 1. 貧瘠的，不毛的 2. 不育的，不結果的
ex: The great majority of all Pacific islands were born barren of life.
絕大多數太平洋島嶼形成之初便毫無生命跡象。
colloc: a barren effort 無效的努力
words.en: not able to produce plants or fruit

words.zh: 沉澱物，沉積物
words.mnem: sed (=sit) + i + -ment → 沉澱物，沉積物
ex: The interchangeability of continents and oceans explained the absence of fossils or sediments in oceans.
大陸和海洋的相互更替解釋了海洋中化石或沉積物的缺失。
deriv: sedimentary a. 沉積的，沉澱的
words.en: solid material that settles at the bottom of a liquid

words.zh: 1. 位於……之下 2. 構成……的基礎（或起因）
ex: The likely explanation is that an area of underground freshwater underlies the Yucatan Peninsula.
一種可能的解釋是，尤卡坦半島的地下是淡水層。
deriv: underlying a. 表面下的，下層的；潛在的
words.en: to be the basis of something; to lie under something

words.zh: 抑制，阻止
words.mnem: in- (=into) + hibit (=have) → 握在手中 →（引申義）抑制，阻止
ex: The lower wind speeds decrease the city's ventilation by inhibiting the movement of cooler outside air.
較低的風速抑制了較涼爽的外部空氣的流動，從而降低了城市的通風能力。
colloc: inhibit sb. from doing sth. 阻止某人干某事
deriv: inhibited a. 拘謹的，拘束的
words.en: to prevent or slow something down

words.zh: v. 緩衝；n. 1. 起緩衝作用的人（或物）2. 減震器
ex: The shallow seas on the continents probably buffered the temperature of the nearby air, keeping it relatively constant.
大陸上的淺海可能對其周邊大氣的溫度起到了緩衝作用，以使其保持相對穩定。
words.en: something that reduces the effect of a shock

words.zh: 季風，季風雨
ex: The summer monsoon in China comes from the direction of the Philippine Sea.
中國的夏季風來自菲律賓海方向。
words.en: a seasonal wind that brings heavy rain

words.zh: 1. 火山口 2. 坑（如隕石坑、彈坑等）
ex: Volcanic craters are formed by the explosion of compressed volcanic gases, which blasts out large volumes of fragments.
火山口是由壓縮的火山氣體爆炸形成的，這些氣體爆炸時會噴出大量碎屑物。
words.en: a large hole in the top of a volcano or in the ground

words.zh: 1. 磁體，磁鐵 2. 有吸引力的人（或事物）
ex: Think of earth as a big giant magnet.
將地球想像成一塊巨大的磁鐵。
deriv: magnetic a. 磁鐵的；有吸引力的
words.en: a piece of metal that attracts iron

words.zh: 潮濕，濕氣
ex: In tropical countries, however, old papers are preserved only with great difficulty, for white ants and atmospheric humidity pose serious problems even to modern archivists.
然而，在熱帶國家，古籍文獻極難保存，因為白蟻和空氣濕度即便對於現代檔案管理員而言，也是嚴峻的難題。
deriv: humid a. 潮濕的，濕潤的
words.en: the amount of water in the air

words.zh: 大陸的
ex: Continental drift required a powerful driving force that was created by the combination of Earth's rotation and tidal movements.
大陸漂移需要一種強勁的驅動力，而這一動力由地球自轉與潮汐運動共同作用產生。
words.en: relating to a continent

words.zh: n. 1. 漂流，流動 2. 主旨，要點；v. 漂流，漂移
ex: The theory, called continental drift, was partly motivated by the apparent fit, like puzzle pieces, of the coastlines of South America and Africa.
這一理論被稱為大陸漂移說，其提出部分源自南美洲和非洲的海岸線如拼圖碎片般明顯吻合的現象。
words.en: to move slowly on water or air; the general meaning of something

words.zh: n. 1. 條紋，條痕 2. 性格特徵；v. 1. 使布滿條紋 2. 飛奔，疾馳
ex: Whereas the color of a mineral often varies from sample to sample, the streak usually does not and is therefore the more reliable property.
儘管一種礦物的顏色在不同樣本間常常有所差異，但條痕通常不會變化，因此條痕是更為可靠的特性。
words.en: a long thin line or mark

words.zh: 地形，地勢，地帶
words.mnem: terr (=earth) + -ain → 地形，地勢
ex: The centralized dynasties that ruled ancient China were a product of the terrain and climate of the Asian continent.
統治古代中國的中央集權王朝是亞洲大陸地形與氣候的產物。
colloc: a wavy terrain 起伏不平的地形
words.en: an area of land and its natural features

words.zh: 苔原，凍原
ex: Tundra vegetation does well in nutrient-poor soil.
凍原植被在貧瘠的土壤中生長良好。
words.en: a large flat treeless arctic region

words.zh: a. 1. 有彈性的，有彈力的 2. 可變通的，靈活的；n. 橡皮圈（或帶），鬆緊帶
ex: Primary and secondary waves are the fastest waves, and especially in Earth's interior where rock is elastic.
縱波和橫波是速度最快的波，尤其是在地球內部，那裡的岩石具有彈性。
words.en: able to stretch and return to its shape

words.zh: n. 1. 板塊 2. 盤子，碟子 3.（金屬）板條，板材；v. 1. 覆蓋 2. 電鍍
ex: Studying volcanoes helps scientists understand Earth's internal processes: for example, how volcanoes form at tectonic plate boundaries or over hotspots in the mantle.
研究火山有助於科學家了解地球的內部過程：例如，火山如何在構造板塊邊界處或地幔熱點上方形成。
colloc: on a plate 毫不費力
words.en: a flat dish; a large piece of the earth's crust

words.zh: 1. 地殼 2. 外皮，硬外殼 3. 麵包皮，酥皮
ex: All are slowly moving because the plates float on a denser semi-liquid mantle, the layer between the crust and Earth's core.
所有板塊都在緩慢移動，因為它們都漂浮在密度更大的半液態的介於地殼和地核之間的地幔上。
colloc: earn one's crust 謀生，掙錢糊口
deriv: crusty a. 有外殼的；易怒的
words.en: the hard outer part of something

words.zh: 1. 占主導地位，有重大影響 2.（數量上）占優勢
words.mnem: pre- (=before) + domin (=rule) + -ate → 在前面進行統治 → 占主導地位
ex: And as I said earlier, this cooling effect predominates.
正如我之前說的，這種降溫效應佔主導地位。
colloc: predominate over sb./sth. 支配／統治／左右某人或某事物
words.en: to be the main or most powerful element

words.zh: （冰川的）裂隙，裂縫
ex: And crevasses can form in this upper layer of glacier.
在冰川的上層會形成裂縫。
words.en: a deep crack in a glacier

words.zh: （尤指非洲的）稀樹草原
ex: And savannah trees are separated pretty far apart from one another.
而且稀樹草原上的樹木彼此間距相當遠。
words.en: a flat grassy plain in tropical regions

words.zh: 驚人的，令人憂慮的
words.mnem: al- (=to) + arm (=weapons) + -ing → 去拿武器 → 驚人的，令人憂慮的
ex: And the silting continued at an alarming rate.
而且淤積正在以驚人的速度持續進行。
deriv: alarm v. 使警覺 n. 警報
words.en: causing worry or fear

words.zh: 多孔的，透水的，透氣的
ex: Because they are porous, sedimentary rocks, such as sandstones and conglomerates, are important potential sources of groundwater.
因為沉積岩多孔，比如砂岩和礫岩，因此它們是地下水的重要潛在源頭。
deriv: porosity n. 孔隙度，孔隙率
pore n. 孔 v.（~ over）熟讀，鑽研
words.en: having many small holes that allow liquid to pass through

words.zh: 1. 冰川（期）的 2. 極冷的 3. 冷漠的
ex: Braided streams are common in both deserts and glacial environments because both produce abundant sediment.
辮狀河流在沙漠和冰川環境中都很常見，因為這兩種環境都能產生大量的沉澱物。
words.en: relating to glaciers or ice

words.zh: 1. 使降低 2. 壓抑，使沮喪
words.mnem: de- (=down) + press (=press) → 壓下去 → 使降低；壓抑
ex: But detractors maintain that the terraces could also have been created by geological activity, perhaps related to the geologic forces that depressed the Northern Hemisphere far below the level of the south.
但反對者認為，梯田也可能是由地質活動造成的，或許與致使北半球地勢遠低於南半球的地質作用力有關。
deriv: depressive a. 患抑鬱症的，抑鬱的 n. 抑鬱症患者
depression n. 沮喪；抑鬱症；蕭條；低氣壓
words.en: to make someone sad; to lower the level of something

words.zh: 後退，逐漸遠離，漸漸遠去
words.mnem: re- (=back) + cede (=go) → 後退，逐漸遠離
ex: But these estuaries would also affect the mudflats, those areas of mud that normally are exposed when the tide recedes.
但這些河口也會影響泥灘，即潮水退去之後常常暴露在外的泥地。
deriv: recession n. 經濟衰退；退後，撤回
words.en: to move back from a previous position

words.zh: 1. 時間的 2. 世俗的
words.mnem: tempor (=time) + -al → 時間的
ex: By following the fossils, Smith was able to put all the strata of England's earth into relative temporal sequence.
通過追蹤化石，Smith 得以將英國範圍內所有的地層以相對時間順序進行排序。
words.en: relating to time

words.zh: 地球上的，陸地的，陸生的
words.mnem: terr (=earth) + estr + -ial → 地球上的，陸地的
ex: Coastal terrestrial sediments contained similar fossils across continents.
各大陸的沿海陸地沉積物中含有相似的化石。
words.en: relating to the earth or land

words.zh: 1. 極地的，兩極的 2. 對立的
words.mnem: pol (=axis) + -ar → 極地的
ex: Continental drift caused Antarctica to move apart from the landmass of South America and to drift into the Southern Polar Region.
大陸漂移使得南極洲與南美大陸分離，並漂移至南極地區。
deriv: polarize v. 使兩極化，截然對立
words.en: relating to the North or South Pole

words.zh: 陰天的，陰暗的
words.mnem: over- (=above) + cast (=throw) → 扔在上面，覆蓋 → 陰天的，陰暗的
ex: Conversely, on many overcast or windy nights the temperature differential approached zero degrees.
相反，在許多陰天或有風的夜晚，溫差接近零攝氏度。
words.en: covered with clouds

words.zh: v. [kəmˈpækt] 壓緊，壓縮；a. [kəmˈpækt / ˈkɑːmpækt] 1. 緊密的，緊湊的 2. 小型的，袖珍的；n. [ˈkɑːmpækt] 1. 帶鏡小粉盒 2. 小汽車
words.mnem: com- (=together) + pact (=fasten) → 緊密結合在一起 → 壓緊，壓縮
ex: As sedimentary rocks are buried more deeply, they become increasingly compacted and their pores filled with minerals.
隨著沉積岩被埋藏得越來越深，它們變得越來越致密，其孔隙也被礦物質填充。
deriv: compactness n. 密度；小巧；緊湊
words.en: small and closely packed; to press together

words.zh: 1. 地層 2. 階層（複數 strata）
words.mnem: strat (=spread) + -um → 展開，鋪設 → 地層；階層
ex: Ever since people had begun to catalog the strata in particular outcrops, there had been the hope that these could somehow be used to calculate geological time.
自從人們開始對地層特別是露出地表的岩層進行系統編目以來，人們就希望這些岩層能以某種方式用來計算地質時間。
words.en: a layer of rock or soil; a level of society

words.zh: 1. 下沉，塌陷 2. 平息，消退
words.mnem: sub- (=under) + sid (=sit) + -e → 下沉，塌陷
ex: Hall suggested that materials eroded off the continents accumulated in the adjacent marginal basins causing the basins to subside.
Hall 提出，從大陸侵蝕下來的物質堆積在相鄰的邊緣盆地中，導致這些盆地發生沉降。
words.en: to sink to a lower level; to become less strong

words.zh: n. 1. 地幔 2. 覆蓋物；v. 覆蓋
ex: The process is going on within the earth during that time, the convection of molten rock within Earth's mantle rising to the surface cooling and then sinking again.
在那段時間內，地球內部的對流過程持續進行：地幔中的熔融岩石上升至地表冷卻後下沉循環。
words.en: the layer of the earth between the crust and the core

words.zh: 置於……上面，疊加於
ex: In lowland country, almost any spot on the ground may overlie what was once the bed of a river that has since become buried by soil.
在低地國家，地面上幾乎任何一處都可能曾是河床上方的地層，而這些河床後來被土壤掩埋了。
words.en: to lie on top of something

words.zh: 可溶的
words.mnem: solu (=loosen) + -ble → 鬆開的 → 可溶的
ex: In the central deeper part of the basin, the last of the brine evaporated to precipitate more soluble sodium chloride (salt).
在該盆地中部更深處，最後的鹽水也蒸發了，從而沉澱出水溶性更好的氯化鈉（食鹽）。
words.en: able to be dissolved in liquid

words.zh: 可滲透的，可滲入的
words.mnem: per- (=through) + me (=glide) + -able → 可滲透的，可滲入的
ex: Increases in average winter temperatures have made permafrost permeable to water.
冬季平均氣溫的升高可以使水滲入永久凍土層。
words.en: allowing liquid or gas to pass through

words.zh: 熔化的，熔融的
ex: Instead, they are shield volcanoes—volcanoes with broad, sloping slides formed by molten rock.
相反，這些火山是盾狀火山——一種由熔岩形成的斜面寬闊且坡度平緩的火山。
deriv: melt v. 熔化；融化；溶解
words.en: melted by great heat

words.zh: 小氣候
ex: It even affects the climate on a very local level (the "microclimate") by influencing light intensity, humidity, and both the range and extremes of temperature.
它甚至通過影響光照強度、濕度、溫度的變化範圍與極端值來影響非常局部的氣候（即「小氣候」）。
words.en: the climate of a small area

words.zh: 改變……的形狀（或結構），重塑，改組
ex: It was possible to determine past movements of Earth's continents and how these slow movements have reshaped Earth's features at different times.
我們有可能判斷出過去地球大陸的運動方式，以及這些緩慢的運動如何在不同時期重塑了地球的特徵。
words.en: to change the shape or structure of something

words.zh: 1.（指空氣或水）洶湧的，狂暴的 2. 騷亂的，暴亂的
words.mnem: turb (=disturb) + ul + -ent → 狂暴的；騷亂的
ex: Then the difference in temperature inside the air mass creates instability, an unstable and turbulent situation in the atmosphere.
然後，氣團內部的溫差引發大氣的不穩定狀態，造成大氣層的動蕩紊亂。
deriv: turbulence n. 湍流；騷亂，混亂
words.en: violent and uncontrolled

words.zh: （植物或動物的）自然色彩，自然花紋
ex: When a mineral, such as quartz, exhibits a variety of colors, it is said to possess exotic coloration.
當一種礦物，比如石英，呈現出多種顏色時，就稱其具有特殊的色彩現象。
words.en: the colors or pattern of colors of something

words.zh: 1. 海峽 2. 困境
ex: Now imagine these sheets of ice floating down the strait.
現在想象一下，這些冰層順著海峽漂流而下。
words.en: a narrow area of water connecting two seas

words.zh: v. [ˈpɑːstʃuleɪt] 假定，假設；n. [ˈpɑːstʃələt] 假定，假設
ex: One theory postulated that sedimentary rock forming at the edge of continents first sank under its own weight, then rose to form mountains.
一種理論假設，在大陸邊緣形成的沉積岩先因其自身重量下沉，然後上升形成山脈。
words.en: to suggest that something is true as a basis for argument

words.zh: 週期的，定期的
words.mnem: peri- (=round) + od (=way) + -ic → 路程，引申為階段 → 週期的，定期的
ex: Over the course of geological history, there would be a continual interchange of land and sea, a periodic rearrangement of the landmasses.
在地質歷史進程中，陸地和海洋會不斷地交替變遷，陸塊也會週期性地重新排列。
words.en: happening at regular intervals

words.zh: 內生的，內源性的
words.mnem: endo- (=inside) + gen (=produce) + -ous → 內生的
ex: Regularly flowing rivers and streams that originate within arid lands are known as "endogenous."
發源於乾旱區且常年有水流動的河流和小溪被稱為「內源性河流」。
words.en: growing or originating from within

words.zh: 時期，時代，新紀元
ex: Researchers study sediment in order to learn about the characteristics of past geologic epochs.
研究人員對沉積物進行研究，以了解過去地質時期的特點。
deriv: epochal a. 劃時代的，開創新紀元的
words.en: a period of time in history

words.zh: 礫石，沙礫
ex: Runoff produces large gravel deposits.
徑流會產生大量礫石沉積物。
deriv: gravelly a. 含碎石的；（噪音）低沉而沙啞的
words.en: small stones used for paths and roads

words.zh: 1. 基岩 2. 基本事實，基本原則
ex: So it pushes up and away from the bedrock layer beneath it.
所以它向上移動並遠離其下方的基岩層。
words.en: the solid rock under the soil

words.zh: （使）沉沒，淹沒
words.mnem: sub- (=under) + merg (=sink) + -e →（使）沉沒，淹沒
ex: Some parts of the estuary are exposed as the tides go in and out, but other parts are always submerged.
河口的部分區域會隨著潮水的漲退露出，但其他部分總是被淹沒著。
words.en: to cover something with water; to go under water

words.zh: n. 泥漿，稀泥；v.（使）滲出，洩漏
ex: Soon a layer of oceanic ooze began to accumulate above the old hard layer.
不久，海洋軟泥便開始堆積在原來的硬層上。
colloc: ooze from/out of... 從……中滲出，緩慢流出
words.en: to flow slowly out; thick wet mud

words.zh: n. 淤泥；v.（使）淤塞
ex: The large amount of silt causes the river to dry up.
大量的淤泥導致河流乾涸。
deriv: silty a. 塞滿了淤泥的
words.en: fine sand or clay carried by water

words.zh: 上升氣流
ex: Then updraft wind currents carry the light, positively charged ice crystals up to the top of the cloud.
然後，上升氣流會將輕盈且帶正電的冰晶帶到雲層頂端。
words.en: an upward current of air

words.zh: v. 1. 解凍，融化 2.（關係等）緩和；n. 1. 解凍時期 2.（關係等）緩和
ex: Then when the ground warms up in the spring when it thaws, everything contracts.
然後，當春天地面升溫解凍時，所有東西都會收縮。
words.en: to melt after being frozen

words.zh: 1. 重要的，顯著的 2. 可測量的
ex: There is a growing body of opinion that both these physical variations have a measurable impact on the climate.
越來越多的觀點認為，這兩種物理變化都對氣候有著重要的影響。
deriv: immeasurable a. 不可估量的，無限的
words.en: able to be measured

words.zh: 外生的，外源的
words.mnem: exo- (=outside) + gen (=produce) + -ous → 外生的
ex: These rivers and river systems are known as "exogenous" because their sources lie outside the arid zone.
這些河流和河流水系被稱為「外源性河流」，因為它們的源頭都位於乾旱帶之外。
words.en: growing or originating from outside

words.zh: 砂岩
ex: This has been so since ancient times, partly due to the geology of the area, which is mostly limestone and sandstone.
自古以來就是這樣，部分原因在於該地的地質，這裡的地質以石灰岩和砂岩為主。
words.en: a type of rock made from sand

words.zh: n. 露出地面的岩層；v.（岩石等）露出地表
ex: This job gave Smith an opportunity to study the fresh rock outcrops created by the newly dug canal.
這項工作使得 Smith 有機會對那些因運河開掘而露出地面的新鮮岩層進行研究。
words.en: a piece of rock that sticks out of the ground

words.zh: 潮濕的，濕潤的
ex: Those long roots are able to reach down to the moist soil that lies beneath the dry desert surface.
那些長長的根系能夠延伸到乾旱沙漠地表之下的濕潤土壤中。
words.en: slightly wet

words.zh: 外流，流出量
ex: Two types of flow features are seen: runoff channels and outflow channels.
我們可以看到兩種類型的流動特徵：徑流通道和外流通道。
words.en: the movement of water or people out of a place

words.zh: 乾涸，枯竭
words.mnem: de- (=thoroughly) + sicc (=dry) + -ation → 乾涸，枯竭
ex: Their migration may have been set in motion by an increase in population caused by a movement of peoples fleeing the desiccation, or drying up, of the Sahara.
他們的遷徙可能是由人口激增引起的，而這種人口增長則是人們為躲避撒哈拉沙漠地區的乾涸而進行遷徙所致。
deriv: desiccated a. 脫水的；乾涸的
words.en: the process of drying out completely

words.zh: 不動的，靜止的
words.mnem: im- (=not) + mobile (=move) → 不動的，靜止的
ex: Water does not remain immobile in an aquifer but can seep out as springs or leak into other aquifers.
蓄水層中的水並不是靜止不動的，而是能夠以泉水的形式滲出，或是滲透到其他蓄水層中去。
words.en: not moving or not able to move

words.zh: 不切實際的，虛幻的
ex: It was very unrealistic of Oparin and Miller to think that they could identify the precise methane-rich mixture that made up the early atmosphere.
Oparin 和 Miller 認為他們能夠確定構成早期大氣中富含甲烷的確切混合物，這種想法是非常不現實的。
deriv: unrealistically ad. 不切實際地，不現實地
words.en: not sensible or practical

words.zh: 地磁的，地磁氣的
words.mnem: geo- (=earth) + magnet (=magnet) + -ic → 地磁的
